Gen: Ekucaleni Nkulunkulu wadala lizulu nemhlaba.
Umhlaba bewungenasimo futsi ungenalutfo. Bumnyama bebumbonye emanti lajulile, futsi Umoya waNkulunkulu bewuhamba ngetulu kwemanti.
Nkulunkulu wase utsi: "Akube khona kukhanya." Kukhanya kwase kuba khona.
Nkulunkulu wabona kutsi kukhanya kuhle. Wehlukanisa kukhanya nebumnyama.
Nkulunkulu wabita kukhanya ngekutsi "semini", bumnyama wabubita ngekutsi "ebusuku". Kwaba kuhlwa, kwaba kusa. Bekulilanga lekucala.
Nkulunkulu wase utsi: "Akube khona sikhala lesivulekile emkhatsini wemanti, sehlukanise emanti kube tincenye letimbili."
Ngako Nkulunkulu wenta sikhala lesivulekile. Wehlukanisa emanti langaphansi kwaso nemanti langetulu kwaso. Kwaba njengobe asho.
Nkulunkulu wabita sikhala lesivulekile ngekutsi "sibhakabhaka". Kwaba kuhlwa, kwaba kusa. Bekulilanga lesibili.
Nkulunkulu wase utsi: "Emanti langaphansi kwesibhakabhaka akahlangane endzaweni yinye, kute kubonakale umhlaba lowomile." Kwaba njengobe asho.
Nkulunkulu wabita umhlaba lowomile ngekutsi "live", emanti lahlanganisiwe wawabita ngekutsi "tilwandle". Nkulunkulu wabona kutsi kuhle.
Nkulunkulu wase utsi: "Live alimilise timila: timila letiluhlata letiveta imbewu, netihlahla letitsela titselo letinembewu ngekhatsi, ngulesinye nalesinye ngenhlobo yaso." Kwaba njengobe asho.
Live lamilisa timila letiveta imbewu, ngulesinye nalesinye ngenhlobo yaso, netihlahla letitsela titselo letinembewu ngekhatsi, ngulesinye nalesinye ngenhlobo yaso. Nkulunkulu wabona kutsi kuhle.
Kwaba kuhlwa, kwaba kusa. Bekulilanga lesitsatfu.
Nkulunkulu wase utsi: "Akube khona tibane esibhakabhakeni tehlukanise imini nebusuku. Atibe timphawu letikhombisa tikhatsi temnyaka, emalanga neminyaka.
Atikhanye esibhakabhakeni tiniketa umhlaba kukhanya." Kwaba njengobe asho.
Nkulunkulu wenta tibane letimbili letinkhulu: lesikhulu sibuse imini, lesincane sibuse busuku. Wenta netinkhanyeti.
Nkulunkulu watibeka esibhakabhakeni kutsi tiniketa umhlaba kukhanya,
tibuse imini nebusuku, futsi tehlukanise kukhanya nebumnyama. Nkulunkulu wabona kutsi kuhle.
Kwaba kuhlwa, kwaba kusa. Bekulilanga lesine.
Nkulunkulu wase utsi: "Emanti akagcwale tidalwa letiphilako, futsi tinyoni atindize ngetulu kwemhlaba esibhakabhakeni lesivulekile."
Ngako Nkulunkulu wadala tidalwa letinkhulu telwandle netinhlobo tonkhe tetintfo letiphilako letihamba emantini. Wadala netinhlobo tonkhe tetinyoni. Nkulunkulu wabona kutsi kuhle.
Nkulunkulu watibusisa watsi: "Telanani nande. Gcwalisani emanti etilwandle, futsi tinyoni atande emhlabeni."
Kwaba kuhlwa, kwaba kusa. Bekulilanga lesihlanu.
Nkulunkulu wase utsi: "Live alivete tidalwa letiphilako, ngulesinye nalesinye ngenhlobo yaso: timfuyo, tidalwa letincane letihamba ngesisu emhlabatsini, netilwane tesiganga." Kwaba njengobe asho.
Nkulunkulu wenta tilwane tesiganga, timfuyo netidalwa tonkhe letincane letihamba ngesisu emhlabatsini, ngulesinye nalesinye ngenhlobo yaso. Nkulunkulu wabona kutsi kuhle.

Nkulunkulu wase utsi: "Asente bantfu ngemfanekiso wetfu, bafanane natsi. Abaphatse tinhlanti telwandle, tinyoni tesibhakabhaka, timfuyo, umhlaba wonkhe, netidalwa tonkhe letincane letihamba ngesisu emhlabatsini."
Ngako Nkulunkulu wadala bantfu ngemfanekiso wakhe. Wabadala ngemfanekiso waNkulunkulu. Wabadala bayindvodza nemfati.

Nkulunkulu wababusisa watsi kubo: "Tselani bantfwana nande. Gcwalisani umhlaba, niwunakekele futsi niwuphatse. Phatsani tinhlanti telwandle, tinyoni tesibhakabhaka netidalwa tonkhe letiphilako letihamba emhlabeni."
Nkulunkulu wase utsi: "Bukani! Senginiphe timila tonkhe emhlabeni wonkhe letiveta imbewu, netihlahla tonkhe letitsela titselo letinembewu. Titawuba kudla kwenu.

Futsi kutilwane tonkhe temhlaba, etinyonini tonkhe tesibhakabhaka nakutidalwa tonkhe letihamba ngesisu emhlabatsini, kuto tonkhe letinemphefumulo wekuphila, nginika timila tonkhe letiluhlata kutsi tibe kudla." Kwaba njengobe asho.
Nkulunkulu wabuka konkhe labekwentile, futsi bekuhle kakhulu. Kwaba kuhlwa, kwaba kusa. Bekulilanga lesitfupha.
Ngako lizulu nemhlaba kwaphetfwa, kanye nako konkhe lokukuko.
Ngelilanga lesikhombisa Nkulunkulu bese aphetse umsebenti labewenta. Ngako ngelilanga lesikhombisa waphumula kuwo wonkhe umsebenti wakhe.
Nkulunkulu walibusisa lilanga lesikhombisa walenta laba lingcwele, ngobe ngalelo langa waphumula kuwo wonkhe umsebenti wekudala labewentile.
Lena yindzaba yelizulu nemhlaba nakudalwa, ngesikhatsi Simakadze Nkulunkulu enta umhlaba nelizulu.
Bekungekho sihlahlana emhlabeni, futsi bekungekho sitjalo lebesimilile emasimini. Simakadze Nkulunkulu bekasengakanisi imvula emhlabeni, futsi bekungekho muntfu wekulima umhlabatsi.
Kodvwa inkungu yenyuka emhlabeni yanisela wonkhe umhlabatsi.
Simakadze Nkulunkulu wase ubumba indvodza ngelutfuli lwemhlabatsi. Waphefumulela umoya wekuphila emakhaleni endvodza, yase indvodza iba sidalwa lesiphilako.
Simakadze Nkulunkulu watjala ingadze ngasemphumalanga, e-Edeni. Lapho wabeka indvodza labeyibumbile.
Simakadze Nkulunkulu wamilisa tinhlobo tonkhe tetihlahla emhlabatsini. Betinhle kubukeka futsi tilungele kudliwa. Emkhatsini wengadze bekume sihlahla sekuphila nesihlahla sekwati lokuhle nalokubi.
Umfula bewugeleta uphuma e-Edeni kutsi unisele ingadze. Kusuka lapho wahlukana waba yimifula lemine.
Umfula wekucala ubitwa ngekutsi nguPhishoni. Ugeleta uzungeleta lonkhe live laseHavila, lapho kunegolide khona.
Ligolide lalelo live lihlanzekile. Kutfolakala nenhlaka lenuka kamnandzi nelitje leliligugu le-onikisi.
Umfula wesibili ubitwa ngekutsi nguGihoni. Ugeleta uzungeleta lonkhe live laseKhushi.
Umfula wesitsatfu ubitwa ngekutsi nguTigrisi. Ugeleta ngasemphumalanga ye-Asiriya. Umfula wesine ngu-Ewufrathe.
Simakadze Nkulunkulu watsatsa indvodza wayibeka engadzeni yase-Edeni kutsi ilime umhlabatsi futsi iwunakekele.
Simakadze Nkulunkulu waniketa indvodza lomyalo: "Ukhululekile kudla kunoma ngusiphi sihlahla engadzeni,
kodvwa ungadli esihlahleni sekwati lokuhle nalokubi. Ngelilanga lotawudla kuso, ngempela utawufa."
Simakadze Nkulunkulu wase utsi: "Akukuhle kutsi indvodza ibe yodvwa. Ngitawuyentela umsiti loyifanele ngempela."

Ngemhlabatsi Simakadze Nkulunkulu wabumba tilwane tonkhe tesiganga netinyoni tonkhe tesibhakabhaka. Watiletsa endvodzeni kutsi abone kutsi itawutetsa maphi emagama. Noma ngumaphi libito indvodza leyalinika sidalwa ngasinye lesiphilako, laba libito laso.
Ngako indvodza yetsa timfuyo tonkhe emagama, netinyoni tesibhakabhaka netilwane tonkhe tesiganga. Kodvwa Adamu bekete umsiti lomfanele ngempela.
Ngako Simakadze Nkulunkulu walalisa indvodza butfongo lobukhulu. Ngesikhatsi isalele, Nkulunkulu watsatsa lolunye lwetimbambo tendvodza, wavala leyo ndzawo ngenyama.
Simakadze Nkulunkulu wase wenta umfati ngembambo labeyikhiphe endvodzeni, wamletsa endvodzeni.
Indvodza yatsi: "Ekugcineni! Lona ngumuntfu longulitsambo lematsambo ami nenyama yenyama yami. Utawubitwa ngekutsi 'ngumfati', ngobe utsetfwe endvodzeni."
Ngako-ke indvodza ishiya uyise nenina, inamatsele kumfati wayo, futsi bobabili baba nyama yinye.
Indvodza nemfati wayo bobabili bebanchunu, kodvwa bebangeva emahloni.
Inyoka beyihlakaniphe kwendlula tonkhe tilwane tesiganga Simakadze Nkulunkulu labetentile. Yatsi kumfati: "Kantsi ngempela Nkulunkulu utsite, 'Ningadli kunoma ngusiphi sihlahla engadzeni'?"
Umfati waphendvula inyoka watsi: "Singadla titselo tetihlahla letisengadzeni.
Kodvwa ngesihlahla lesisemkhatsini wengadze, Nkulunkulu utsite: 'Ningadli titselo taso. Ningasitsintsi nekusitsintsa, kuze ningafi.'"
Inyoka yatsi kumfati: "Anitawufa!
Nkulunkulu uyati kutsi nanidla kuso, emehlo enu atawuvuleka. Nitawufanana naNkulunkulu, nati lokuhle nalokubi."

Umfati wabona kutsi sitselo sesihlahla sasilungele kudliwa futsi sasihle kubukeka, nekutsi sasifiseka ngobe singenta umuntfu abe nekuhlakanipha. Ngako watsatsa letinye titselo wadla. Waphindze wanika nendvodza yakhe lebeyinaye, nayo yadla.
Emehlo abo bobabili avuleka, base babona kutsi banchunu. Ngako batfunga emahlamvu emkhiwa betentela tembatfo.
Ngesikhatsi lesipholile selilanga, beva umsindvo waSimakadze Nkulunkulu ahamba engadzeni. Indvodza nemfati wayo bacasha Simakadze Nkulunkulu emkhatsini wetihlahla tengadze.
Kodvwa Simakadze Nkulunkulu wabita indvodza watsi: "Uphi?"
Yaphendvula yatsi: "Ngikuvile engadzeni, ngesaba ngobe nginchunu. Ngako ngicashile."
Nkulunkulu wabuta watsi: "Ngubani lokutjele kutsi unchunu? Kantsi udlile esihlahleni lebengikuyale kutsi ungadli kuso?"
Indvodza yatsi: "Umfati lombeke lapha nami ungiphe sitselo sesihlahla, ngadla."
Simakadze Nkulunkulu wase utsi kumfati: "Yini lena loyentile?" Umfati watsi: "Inyoka ingikhohlisile, ngadla."

Ngako Simakadze Nkulunkulu watsi kunyoka: "Ngobe wente loku, uchalekisiwe kwendlula tonkhe timfuyo netilwane tonkhe tesiganga. Utawuhamba ngesisu sakho, futsi utawudla lutfuli onkhe emalanga ekuphila kwakho.
Ngitawenta kutsi wena nemfati nibe titsa, netitukulwane takho netitukulwane takhe tibe titsa. Yena utawuchoboza inhloko yakho, wena utawuluma situlwana sakhe."
Kumfati watsi: "Ngitawandza kakhulu buhlungu bakho nawukhulelwe. Utawutala bantfwana ngebuhlungu. Utawufisa indvodza yakho, yona itawukubusa."

Ku-Adamu watsi: "Ulalele umfati wakho wadla sitselo sesihlahla lebengikuyale kutsi ungadli kuso. Ngako umhlabatsi uchalekisiwe ngenca yakho. Onkhe emalanga ekuphila kwakho utawufanele usebente kamatima kute utfole kudla kuwo.
Utawukumilisela emeva netihlahla letinemeva, futsi utawudla timila tesiganga.
Utawujuluka kute utfole sinkhwa sakho kuze ubuyele emhlabatsini, ngobe utsetfwe kuwo. Ulutfuli, futsi utawubuyela elutfulini."
Adamu wetsa umfati wakhe libito lekutsi ngu-Eva, ngobe bekatawuba ngunina wabo bonkhe labaphilako.
Simakadze Nkulunkulu wentela Adamu nemfati wakhe timphahla ngetikhumba tetilwane, wabembatsisa.

Simakadze Nkulunkulu wase utsi: "Buka, nyalo umuntfu sewufanana nalomunye wetfu, ngekwati lokuhle nalokubi. Akufanele avunyelwe kwelula sandla sakhe, atsatse nesitselo sesihlahla sekuphila, asidle bese uphila kuze kube phakadze."
Ngako Simakadze Nkulunkulu wamcosha engadzeni yase-Edeni kutsi alime umhlabatsi labetsetfwe kuwo.

Ngemuva kwekucosha umuntfu, wabeka emakherubhi, tidalwa telizulu letinemandla, ngasemphumalanga wengadze yase-Edeni. Wabeka nenkemba levutsako lebeyikhatsimula iya ngapha nangapha, kute igade indlela leya esihlahleni sekuphila.
U-Adami wahlangana ne-Eva lowesifazane wakhe, wakhulelwa, wazala uKaini, watsi: "Ngithole muntfu kuNkulunkulu."
Wazala naHabeli, umngane wakhe; Habeli waba ngumhlambi wewenja, kepha Kaini waba ngummbila.
Watsi sekudlule sikhatsi, Kaini wanikela ngemnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, ekudlaneni kwemhlaba.
Abeli naye wanikelao, wanikela ngekudla lokuhle kakhulu lokusuka emihlambini yakhe; Simakadze wamukela Abeli kanye nemnikelo wakhe.

Nakho Simakadze wathi kuKaini: "Ngubani na lo msindo wakho, yini na lemilomo yakho emnyama?
Uma ukwenta lokulungile, ngabe angeke uvumeleke? kepha uma ukwenta lokubi, khona-ke isono sikhona emnyango wakho njengenyama yemhlabatsini; lifuna kukulawula, kodwa wena kufanele uyikhonze.
Watsi Kaini wakhuluma Aerobi, typu外li wakhe, watsi: "Thinge siphume emhlabatsini." Nalapho bebengasemhlabatsini Ἀβελ, uKaina wehla kuAbeli, umntakwabo, wambulala.
USimakadze watsi kuKayini: "Uphi Abeli, umngane wakho?" Waphendvula watsi: "Ngingazi; ngabe ngingeke ngiwubone umngane wami?"
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Ngubani lowenza lokhu? Lingisa, lilanga lenkosi yakho liphuma emhlabatsini licela kum.
Ngaleso sikhathi utawulahleka emhlabatsini, lewuvule umlomo wayo kutsi uyithathe igazi lomngane wakho ngesandla sakho.
Uma uvuna mhlaba, angeke uyinike imbewu yakho engcono; wena utawuhlala ungakhululekanga emhlabeni.
Kaini watsi kuSimakadze: "Icala lami likhulu kakhulu kunalo lokungivumelekile.
Namuhla, kubuka, ungikhuphe emhlabatsini, ngiyawufihla buso bakho, ngibe ngumkhwenyana emhlabeni; kanye nalowo longeke am FNASI, utawumibulala.
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Kungeke kube njalo; kepha lowo loszonela uKayini, kumele agwenywe ngemashumi lasikhombisa." Ngako Nkulunkulu wabeka uphawu kuKayini, kutsi wonke lowo umtholayo angawususe.
Waphuma ke Kaine phambi kweSimakadze, wahlala emhlabatsini saseNodi, emaphandleni eEden.
Kayine wahlangana nemkakhe, yena wakhulelwa, wazala uHenokhi; wasungula khona idolobhana, watsi kulelo dolobhana igama lalowo mntwana wakhe, Henoko.
Irad wazalwa Methushael, Methushael wazalwa Methushael, futhi Methushael wazalwa Lamech.
Lamekhe waba nemadvodza lamibili; igama lomnye lafantiwe nga-Ada, igama lomnye lafantiwe ngu-Zila.
Adada wazala Jabali; yena waba ngumnyaka wa lani labahlala etintenteni, laba nemhlambi wetikilo.
Igama lomkhuluwa wakhe lakunguJubali; yena waba nguMengameli walabo bonke labadlala i-harpa ne-flauta.
Sila wadzala naTobula-Kayini, umfana wakhe; yena waba ngumkhiqizi wemathuluzi lahlukene esiliva negolide. Umngane wakhe uNaama.
Lamekhe watsi kumadzimate akhe: "Ade naZila, nikhulume nami; nimakhosikazi eLamekhe, nilalele amazwi ami! Ngibulala lomuntu ngenxaογραφa yami, nendodana ngenxa yebuhlungu bami.
Kayine ungeke agwenywe kanye, neLamekhi ungeke agwenywe kabili, nemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa nesihlanu.
U-Adami wabuyela emndenini wakhe, waba nendvodzakati yakhe, yazala unyana, wayikhipha igama lakhe lalinguSeti; ngobe watsi: "Nkulunkulu القطعني ذرية أخرى بدلا من هابيل لأن كاين قتله".
Sete, naye wazala unyana, watsi kuye igama lakhe nguEnosi; ngaleso sikhatsi batsibonkhe la elihle.

Wabenta la mafi otyantyambocokotsi, wabhala kubo: "Abantu" lapho bakhiwa sıro qozona.
Apentsa Adami iminyaka lelikhulu nemashumi lasitfupha, wadzala lomuntfu Ibhayibhile ikhuluma kutsi: "Adami waba ngumnyaka wesihlanu lapho ezalwa khona uSete.
Adami wahlala iminyaka lengema-800 ngemuva kwekuzalwa kweSete, waba nemadvodzana nemadvodzakati.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu labaphila iminyaka lemashumi lamane nesikhombisa namakhulu lasitfupha, bafa.
Sete waphila iminyaka lengema-105, waba ngumzali waEnoshi.
Sete waphila ngemuva kwekuzedwa kweEnosi iminyaka-867, waba nemadvodzana kanye ne kadayakwabomamadvodzakati lalongabakwati.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu beminyaka lemashumi lamane nemahlanu nalabalishumi elinambili, baphila.
Enosi wahlala iminyaka lemashumi lamane nesikhombisa, wazala Kenani.
Na-Enosi waphila, ngemuva kwekutfunywa kwe-Kenani, iminyaka lengemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; wazalelwa khona bantfu labafile.
Nabo bonke iminyaka yekuphila kweEnosi yaba yiminyaka lemashumi lamane nemahlanu, wafa.
Kenani waphila iminyaka lengema-70, waba ngumzali kaMahalaleli.
Nase-Enoki wa файда iminyaka lengema-300, waba nemadvodzana nemadvodzakati lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu labaphila iminyaka lemashumi lamane namakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, bafa.
Mahalaleli abeneminyaka lemashumi lamane ne Siyasihlanu, wazala uJaredi.
Mahalaleli wahlala iminyaka emashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, ngemuva kokufa kweSirayeli, watsi: "Ngizalelwa ngu-Eloyimu!"
Nabo bonkhe bantfu labaphila eMahalaleli babeminyaka lemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, bafa.
Yared wahlala iminyaka lelikhulu, nemashumi lamane nambili, wazala Henoki.
Yared waphila ngemuva kwekutazala kwaEnoki iminyaka lemashumi lamane nesikhombisa, wadzala ngemadvodzana nemadvodzakati.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu labaphila iminyaka lemashumi lamane nesikhombisa namashumi lamabili nesihlanu, bafa.
Enokhi wahlala iminyaka lemashumi lamane nesihlanu,нущe Methuselah.
Enoki wahamba noNkulunkulu iminyakadijodvo, ngemuva kokuzalwa kukaMethushela; wazala amadoda nabafazi ababili.
Naleminyaka yonke yekuphila kweHenokhi yaba ngumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nesihlanu.
UHenoki wahamba naSimakadze, watsi: "Asekho," ngobe Simakadze abemthathe.
Methusela waphila iminyaka lemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa nasitfupha, waba ngumzali waLameke.
NaMatusala waphila, ngemuva kwekuzalwa kweLameki, iminyaka lengemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, wadzala ngemadvodzana nemadvodzana.
Nabo bonke iminyaka yekuphila kweMethusela be intereste lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu eminyaka, wafa.
Lameke wahlala iminyaka lemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, wazala umsa.
Wayibiza igama lakhe nguNowa, Abraha, watsi: "Lowo utawusikhulula ekusebenzelenini kwethu kanye nendlala yesandla sethu, ngenxa yemhlaba lowo Nkulunkulu abewulahla."
Lamekhe wahlala iminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesihlanu, ngemuva kwekuzala kwaNowa; waba nemadvodzana nemadvodzakati.
Lamadvodza laLamekhi ahlala iminyaka lemashumi interesthimbili nesikhombisa nesishiyagalolunye, wafa.
Nowa wahlala iminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesihlanu, wazala Shem, naHami, naYafeti.
Batsi: "Lenani labantu liqale likhule phezu kwemhlaba, bazalwa nemadvodzana.
Lamadvodza laNkulunkulu abona kutsi tindzalo tebantfu tihle, waphindze wahlala nawo, abe nemadvodzana kanye nemadvodzana akhe.
USimakadze watsi: "Umphefumulo wami awungeke uhlale emuntu kuze kube sekupheleni, ngobe yena ngumhlaba; iminyaka yakhe itawuba yiminyaka lemakhulu lamashumi lamabili."

Ngaleso sikhathi kwabekhona emhlaba labakhulu, ababizwa ngokuthi nguNefilim; basuka kubo-ke lamadodana kaNkulunkulu abulale nemadvodzakati labantu, wavula nabo abantwana. alatinyenti lelive lasendulo lamabhishobhi, kanye nalabo baseाचार्य.
Simakadze wabona kutsi umhlaba wawubi kakhulu, kanye nemibono yabo yonke emphefumulweni wabo beyibuhlungu njalo-njalo.
UNkulunkulu wahlupheka kakhulu, watsi: "Ngibela nguNkulunkulu lowenza umuntu emhlabatsini, ngobe uvaldwe nguMoya Longcwele.
Watsi uSimakadze: "Ngizowususa emhlabeni wonke umuntu loyawudala, kanye nenyama lephilayo, nezinto ezihamba phansi, nezinyoni zesibhakabhaka; ngobe sengikhohliwe kutsi ngabakwenza."
Nakho uNowa waba nekuthula emehloni taSimakadze.
Lowo ngumlando waNowa kanye nendlu yakhe. Nowa waba ngumntu lolungile, ehamba ngendlela lefanele; akazange afune lutho lokubi kubo bonkhe bantfu beminyaka yakhe. Wahamba kahle naNkulunkulu.
NaNowa waba nemadvodzana lamabili:Shem, naHamu, naJafeti.

Sifike, sitawubaphatha ngendlela lefanele, ngobe bayawukhula kakhulu. Uma kungenwa umkhosi, bangase bahlangane nalababi bethu, babute nathi, baphume kulelizwe."
Bami-Israyeli babeka ema-Egyptian phezu kwabo, kutsi basebenze nabo ngemisebenzi emikhulu; ngobe babulale ePithoni neRaamshesi, imijikelo yemikhumbi yeFaro.
Lase-Egipta, ngaleso sikhatsi lapho bebaphazamisa khona, bakhulela kakhulu, babe netfufu; kodvwa labaseGibhithe baleva bantfu bakaSirayeli.
LaSirayeli basebentisa ema-Egipta kutsi basebenze ngemandla.
Bebaphazamisa kuphila kwabo ngemisebenzi emikhulu, bekwenza igolide, nesiliva, neminye imisebenzi yasemhlabatsini; ema-Egipta akazange abonise kubo inhlonipho kuleyo misebenzi yabo yonke.
Watsi ukumkani waseMisri wakhuluma ema-Amori, abegama lomunye wabo bekunguShifra, negama lolunye bekunguPua, labazange babulawe;

Wathi kubo: "Lokoku, lapho nikhuluma emaHebhere kutsi bakhulelwe, nibabona embhedeni wabo lokhulelwa, uma bekufanele kube ngumntwana wesifazane, bulala; kepha uma bekufanele kube ngumntwana wesilisa, ahlale."
Labaphambukeli bakholwa kuNkulunkulu, batsi: "Asikuvumeleni kutsi sihambe, ngobe unkhosi yaseGibhithe itsi: 'Uyawufa.'"
Wayibiza inkhosi yaseMisri, yatsi kubo: "Ngubani na lokwenta lokhu, kutsi nigcine lamadodana emadvodzana aphila?"
Baphendvula batsi kuFaro: "Lemadvodza laHebhere angeke abe njengama-Egipta; labo besifazane banamandla kakhulu; ngaphambi kokuba umkhwenyana afike kubo, bayazala."
ANkulunkulu wabambisana kahle netibondza, kodvwa laba bantu bakhule bakhula, baphindze bakhulule kakhulu.
Ngako-ke, njengobe letibondza belibalekela kuNkulunkulu, wabanika nemindeni.
UFarao waletsa bonke bantfu bakhe, watsi: "Lowo muntfu lozalwa eHebroni lomnyaka mncane niwufake emfuleni i-Nile, kepha lowo muntfu lomnyaka mncane niyawuhlala naye."
Waba khona umfana wesifazane waseLevi, watsi: "Ngubani na loyawuhlala nami?"
Waye wakhulelwa, wazala unyana; ngobe akubona kutsi ubukeka kahle, wamfihla iminyaka lemithathu.

Waye angeke amfihla kuze kube kuphele iminyaka lemibili, watsi: "Njengomfana loncane, ngitakulethela ibhodlela lelihlanganisiwe netinsika, ngalibeka nge-tar, kutsi amanzi angangeni kulo; wamisa khona umntwana, wamfaka phakathi kwetimbali letiphakeme emgwaqeni.
Indvodzakati yakhe yahlala eduze kutsi ibone kutsi yini lekumele ibe khona.
Wafika unyana kaFaro, waphuma waya emfuleni kutsi ahlanzwe; lamakhosikazi akhe abehamba ecaleni lomfula. Wabona ibhokisi likhona emehlweni, wathumela umkhonzi wakhe, watsi: "Thina-ke siyithole."
Wayivula, yabona umntwana ulele; wahlupheka kakhulu, watsi: "Lowo ngumunye webantfu labaHebhere."
Watsi udzimate wakhe: "Ngayaphi kutsi ngikufune umkhwenyana waseHebhere, loyawukudlalisa lomnyaka mncane?"
Wayiphendvula, watsi: "Yakho, hlala lapha." Wahamba lowesifazane, wakhipha umkakhe.
Wathi kuye intombi yaFaro: "Thintela lomuntfu, umphile kimi; ngitakulethela inhlawulo yakho." Lowesifazane watsi: "Thintela lomuntfu, umphile!"
Wakhula lomuntfu, waphuma waya kumkhwenyana ka-Farao, waba ngumntwana wakhe, wayibiza igama lakhe ngokuthi uMosese; ngobe yatsi: "Ngiwukhipha emanzini."
UMosesi, lapho ekhula khona, wasuka waya emaHebhere, wababona lomsebenzi wabo; wabona umSirayeli ebulala umHebrhe, lowo owayengumSirayeli.
UMosese wabheka lapha nalaphaya, watsi: "Asekho muntfu lokubona," wabulala umSirayeli, wawufihla etinhlanyeni.
Waphuma ngelilanga lesibili, wabona lamadoda lababili eHebhere abulalana; watsi kuye lowo abengeke abe necala: "Ngini na udlalela umfana wakho waseHebhere?"

Waphendvula watsi: "Ngubani lakwenta wena ube nguMengameli kanye nesikhulu sethu? Ufuna yini kutsi ungibulala, njengobe wabulala loMsiripi?" Mosesi waloba, watsi: "Kungeke kube khona bufakazi bokuthi ngiyakwenza yini.
UFaro wakhuluma ngalolu daba, wafuna ukumbulala uMosi; kodvwa uMosese wehla ebusweni beFaro, waya emhlabatsini weMidyani, wahlala khona eduze kwefulethi.
Umnikelo wesono waseMidiyani ubenemadvodza lasikhombisa; bafika bekhipha amanzi, batsi: "Thintela emabhodlela okudlidliza imindeni yababa bethu."
Befika labaphatsimandla, baphuma nabo; kodvwa Mose wavuka, wabavikela, wadlalisa imindeni yabo.
Bafike kuReuheli, ubaba babo, watsi kubo: "Ngubani na loyawufika namuhla ngelilanga lekucala?"
Wathi kubo: "UmSirayeli lothile wasisivikela ema-Egipta, watfumisa namanzi ethu, wageza nemindeni yethu."
Watsi kubo: "Akhona phi? Ningabe nimushiye khona? Ncelani kutsi afike abe nekudla nathi."
Musa wavuma kutsi ahlale naye, kodvwa yena wamnika intombi yakhe iSepora ukuba abe ngumfazi wakhe.
Wazala unyana, watsi: "Mosese wakhipha igama lakhe ku-Gershoni, ngobe watsi: 'Ngibe ngumhlali ezweni lelingelinye.'
Bafike badlula iminyaka leminingi, wafa ukumkani waseMisri; kodvwa bantfu beSirayeli baphuca ngenxa yemsebenti wabo wekusebentisa, batsi: "UNkulunkulu utawusivikela!"
ANkulunkulu walalela kugwazeka kwabo, wakhumbula umhlangano wakhe naAbrahama, naIsakha, naYakobi.
Nkulunkulu wababona bantfu beSirayeli, watsi: "UNkulunkulu uyakubona lokudla kwabo kanye nekudla kwabo.
Mosese wahlala ekudlaleni imindeni yemadvodzana akhe, eJethro, umLevi waseMidyani; watsi lamadvodza ayawuhamba nemindeni yabo kuze kufike emfuleni waNkulunkulu, eHoreb.
Wabonakala kuye umkhonzi waSimakadze, emlilo womlilo losuka emiphakathini yentaba-mlilo; wabheka, wabona kutsi intaba-mlilo iphuma emlonyeni wayo, kodvwa ayiyi kushiswa.
Mozesi watsi: "Ngiya kungena ngibone lesi sibonakaliso esihle, kutsi yini lembudzi ingeke icwe.
Simakadze wabona kutsi uMosese wehla ekubona, watsi kuye Nkulunkulu kusuka esiphelweni setfu: "Mosi, Mosi!" UMosese wathi: "Ngikhona."
Simakadze watsi: "Ungase ufike lapha; khipha tinyawo takho, ngobe indawo lapho uhlala khona yimhlaba longcwele."
Watsi: "Ngiye uNkulunkulu wababa bakho, uThixo kaAbrahama, uThixo kaIsake, noNkulunkulu kaYakobi."UMoses wafihla ubuso bakhe, ngobe wayekhathazekile kutsi abheke kuSimakadze.
Simakadze watsi: "Ngikubone kahle kuhlupheka kwebantfu bami labase-Egipta, ngikuvile buhlungu babo ngenxa yalabo ababalawulayo; ngobe ngiyawaqonda.

Ngiye ngaphuma ngiwasuse ema-Egipta, ngiwasuse kulelizwe, ngiyawubeka ezweni lelihle nelivukile, ezweni elihlanganisiwe nemmbila nejusi, lapho behlala khona bo-Kanana, ne-Hethi, ne-Amori, ne-Perizi, ne-Hivi, ne-Jebusi.
"Betsi, kuyawufika kuye umsindo walabaSirayeli, nalapho ngibona khona nebuhlungu labaMijipi bebabubeka kubo.
Ngakho-ke, uya; ngikuthumela kuFaro, nawe uyawukhipha abantu bami, bantfu bakaSirayeli, eYiputa.
Musa watsi kuNkulunkulu: "Ngibani na, kutsi ngiye kuFaro, nome kutsi ngiphumelisarozi beSirayeli eMijiphu?"
Watsi: "Ngiya kuba nawe; kanye naleso sibonakaliso kutsi ngiyakuthumela, kutsi lapho uphuma khona labantfu eMijiphu, niyawukhonza Simakadze kulo mfula."
Musa watsi kuNkulunkulu: "Beka, lapho ngiya kuboSirayeli, ngitsi kubo: 'Simakadze Nkulunkulu wabotata benu, ungithumela kuwe.' Bathi kimi: 'Iyini inombolo yakhe?' Ngitawubatshela yini?
Nkulunkulu watsi kuMosesi: "Ngiye lowo ngiye; ngale ndlela utawuti kutsi kuboSirayeli, 'Ngiye lowo ngiye utfumele kuwe.'"

ANkulunkulu watsi kuMosesi: "Uyawukhuluma kuboSirayeli ngokuthi, 'Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uThixo wababa bakho, uThixo kaAbrahama, uThixo kaIsake, noNkulunkulu kaYakobi, ungithumela kuwe.' Lena ligama lami kuze kube sekupheleni; lena ligama labo labangeke bamikhumbula ngalo kuze kube sekupheleni.

"Thumela, uhlanganise labaholi bakaSirayeli, uye kubo: 'Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uNkulunkulu wababa bakho, uThixo kaAbrahama, uNkulunkulu kaIsake, noNkulunkulu kaYakobi, ungibonakalisile, watsi: 'Ngikuboneni, ngikubona konke lokunikezwa kwenu eMisri.
Nami ngithi, Ngitakulethela phezulu kusuka ekuhluphekeni kwenu eMisri, kuze nifike ezweni lama-Kanana, nama-Heti, nama-Amori, nama-Perizi, nama-Hivi, nalama-Jebusi, ilizwe elihlanganisiwe nemmbila.

Uya ku Samariya, ufike ku Hezekiya, Yehoyada mwana wa Yozabadi, ukumkani wa Misri, nawe ufike ku Hezekiya, Yehoyada mwana wa Yozabadi, ukumkani wa Misri, ukamwambie kuti: 'Simakadze, Thixou wa Mahebrai, akanye natwe.
Ngiyazi kutsi Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, akakuvumeleni kutsi nihambe, ngaphandle kwekunesandla esinamandla.
ngobe ngitawutfusa isandla sami, nebulala eMijiphu ngato tonkhe tive letimfihlakalo letiyawuzenza kuwo; emva kwalokho utawukuvumeleni.
Nami ngitawubanika abantu bami inhlonipho kulabo baseMijiphu; lapho niphuma khona, ngeke nihambe ningabi nesandla sengcu.

Lowesifazane ngamunye utawucela umshayeli wakhe, nalowo ohlala ekhaya lakhe, izinto zesiliva negolide, kanye nemihlobiso; niyigqoke lamadodana enu namakhosikazi enu. Niyawukhipha impahla yabase-Egypti.
Mose waphendula watsi: "Kungeke kutsi bakholwa kimi, bangamitsi; bangathi: 'UNkulunkulu akakubonakalisi.' "
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Iyini leyo esandlani sakho?" UMosese watsi: "Intambo."
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Yitfusa phansi!" UMosesi wayitfusa phansi, wabuye waba ngudlovukazi; uMosesi wehla waya kuyo.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thinda isandla sakho, ubambe umlenze wayo." UMosesi wehlisa isandla sakhe, wawuthatha, wabuye waba yintambo esandlani sakhe.
Watsi Simakadze: "Yenza lokhu, ukuze bakholwa ukuthi uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wabonakala kuwe, uNkulunkulu wa-Abrahama, uThixo wa-Isake, noNkulunkulu wa-Yakobi.

Simakadze watsi kuye: "Thipha isandla sakho emlonyeni wakho." UMosese wehlisa isandla sakhe emlonyeni wakhe, wakhipha isandla sakhe emlonyeni wakhe, wabona kutsi isandla sakhe sabe simhlophe njengethebhu.

Watsi: "Thipha phansi isandla sakho emlenzeni wakho." UMosese watsi: "Thipha phansi isandla sakho emlenzeni wakho," wamisa isandla sakhe emlenzeni wakhe, wayikhipha, wayibona ibuye ibe mhlophe njengesikhumba sakhe.
USimakadze watsi: "Uma bekungakukholwa, bese bengeke bacabangele imfihlakalo yokuqala, bangakukholwa nemfihlakalo yesibili.

"Uma besingakukholwa naleso sibonakaliso lesimbili, noma besingakulalela wena, khona-ke utawukhipha amanzi emfula iNil, uyawuwufafaza emhlabatsini; bese umhwamuko wamanzi lawo okwehlisa emhlabatsini ubuye ube yigazi.

UMosese watsi kuSimakadze, utsi: "Aye, Nkosi yami, ngiyabonga, ngobe sengingeke ngikhulume kahle, kuze kube talamuhla nalesosikhathi lapho ukhuluma khona nami, umkhonzi wakho; ngingashonga kahle, nelimlomo lwami luhle.

USimakadze watsi kuye: "Ngubani na lowo wabeka umlomo kubo? Ngubani na lowo loyawubamisa, noma lowo loyawubakhipha emlonyeni wabo? Ngubani na lowo loyawubavumela ukuba babone, noma lowo loyawubafihla emehlo abo? Angeke ngibe ngimi yini, Simakadze?
Lakho, hlala uhambe; ngitakusiza kutsi ukhulume, ngitakufundisa kutsi ukhuluma yini.
Musa watsi: "Ngikucela, Nkulunkulu, thumela omunye."
USimakadze wehlalele uMosese, watsi: "Awukho na-Aron, lomkhuluwa wakho, umLevi? Ngiyazi ukuthi ukhuluma kahle; bona, uyakuhlangana nawe; utawujabula uma ekubona.
Uyawukhuluma naye, utawutsi kutsi yini lokufanele akhulume; ngobe ngitakunika sandla sakho sokukhuluma, nesandla sami sitawukusifundisa kutsi yini lokufanele uyenze.
Uyawukhuluma nawe kulabo bantu; yena utawuba njengendlebe yakho, wena utawuba kuye njengeNkulunkulu.
Lesandla lesi sifike esandla sakho, ukuze uyenze lemiqondiso ngayo."
UMosi wabuyela ku-Yethro, umyeni wakhe, watsi kuye: "Nceda uvumele ngibuye emindenini yami yaseMijiphu, ngibone ngabe kukhona laphilayo kubo."Jethro watsi kuMosesi: "Hamba, ube nekuthula nawe."
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi eMidyani: "Thiba ubuye e-Egypt, ngobe bonke labo labafuna kuphila kwakho bafa."
UMosese wabeka indodana yakhe kanye nendvodzakati yakhe emgodini, wabuyela ezweni laseMijiphu; uMosese wafaka isandla sakhe esitsheni saNkulunkulu.

Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Uma ubuyela eYiputa, qaphela ukuthi ukwenze phambi kweFaro zonke lezi zinto ezimangalisako lapho ngikumise khona ngesandla sakho; kodwa mina ngitamisa inhliziyo yakhe, aze avumele abantu bahambe.
"Utakhuluma kuFaro, utsi: Simakadze usho kutsi: "Israyeli ngumwana wami, umzali wami wesifazane.
"Ngikutshele kutsi: 'Lalela umntwana wami ahambe, aze amkhonze.' Kodwa wena ungeke uvumele ahambe; ngobe ngitawubulala lomuntfu wakho wesifazane.
Ngendlela, lapho behlala khona ngebusuku, Simakadze wahlangana naMosese, wafuna ukumbulala.
Sepora wathatha isiliva lelingenamsoco, wamisa ubuso bendvodzakati yakhe, watsi kuMosesi: "Uyindodana yami yegazi."
Ngako-ke Simakadze wamshiya, watsi: "Umfazi wegazi," ngobe akazange acwecwe.
USimakadze watsi ku-Aron: "Thinda ufike uhlangane naMosese emasikweni."U-Aron wehla, wahlangana naMosese emfuleni waNkulunkulu, wamcoca.
UMosese wakhuluma ku-Aron ngaso sonke isandla saSimakadze, lapho abemuthumela khona, nangeso sonke isibonakaliso lesi Simakadze abemwiselayo.
Wahamba uMosesi na-Aron, wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli labakhulu.
Wakhuluma kubo u-Aron, watsi kubo konkhe loko loNkulunkulu abekusho kuMosese; wakwenza naleso sibonakaliso phambi kwebantfu.
Labantfu bakholwa. Beva kutsi uSimakadze ufike wasindisa bantfu beSirayeli, ngobe wababona kuhlupheka kwabo, batsi: "Tsebenta kahle!" Batsi: "Kulungile!
Bafike bakhuluma kuFaro, batsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: 'Lalela abantu bami bahambe, kutsi bagcine liholidi lami emhlabatsini.'"
Watsi uFaro: "UNkulunkulu ngubani, kutsi ngingawulalela, ngivumele laSirayeli bahambe? Ngingamuqondi Simakadze, futhi ngeke ngivumele laSirayeli bahambe."

Batsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wemaHebhere, wahlangana nathi; siyawuhamba ngendlela yezinsuku ezintathu esigabeni semhlabatsini, sitawunikela kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, kutsi asikubise ngendlala noma ngesikhephe.
Watsi ukumkani waseMisri: "Mosese na-Aron, kungani niletsa bantfu ekusebenzeni kwabo? Yiba nemisebenzi yenu!"
Watsi uFaro: "Bona, abantu bakho bakhulu kakhulu kulomhlaba, ngobe nibaletsa kutsi bangasebenzi."
UFaro watsi ngalowo mhla kulabo labaphathako, nalabaphathi bebantfu, kutsi:
Watsi: "Ningeke nibuyeni ninike abantu inkemba, kutsi bayifake emacwecwe, njengobe bekuyinika ngaphambili; bangaya bahlanganise inkemba yabo.

Baye babuye babe nenani lelihlanganisiwe lamacwecwe, njengaleso sangaphambilini; ningawanciphisi lamanani abo, ngobe bangabi namandla. Ngako-ke baphuma betsi: "Thinge sihambe sinikela ngesondlo kuNkulunkulu wethu."
Kube kube nzima kubo msebenzi wabo, kutsi bahlale behlelekile futhi bangalitsi lukhulu lokukhohlisa.
Baphuma khona labaphathi babo nalabaphambukeli babo, bakhuluma kulabo bantu, besithi: Lokho kusho uFaro: Angeke ngikunikeni lilanga.
Yite, nifikeni nifune lilanga lenu lapho ningalithola khona; kepha umsebenzi wenu ngeke ukhokhwe lutho.'
Labantfu basakazeka emhlabatsini weSirayeli, batsi: "Sekungeke kube khona lilanga letfu!"
Batsi: "Thintela umsebenzi wenu nsuku zonke, njengobe nakwenta lapho nine tingulube."

Labaphathi beSirayeli, lababeka kubo, bacutshungulwa ngubaholi bakaFaro, batsi kubo: "Ngubani na lomunye wenu longeke abe nenani lelinye lamagquma, kusasa kanye ngoLwesihlanu, njengendzaba yenu yangaphambilini?
Befika khona labaphathi beSirayeli, batsi kuFaro: "Ngubani na lowenza njalo kubo bonkhe bantfu bakho?
Kutsi sithi: 'Yenza tikhonta.' Nabo abakhonti bakho bacutshungulwa, kodvwa kulabo bantu bakho lobaba necala."
Watsi uFaro: "Niyibabi, niyibabi; ngakho-ke nithi, 'Thinge sihambe sinikeze iminikelo kuSimakadze.'
Namuhla, buyela emsebenzini! Ungeke ukhokhwe nayinye inhlama, kepha kufanele uphinde ube nenani leliphelele letigcawu."
Bebona labaphathi beSirayeli kutsi bangeke babe nenkinga, ngobe kwatsi kubo: "Ningeke ninciphise inombolo yetimkhonto letifanele nizisebenzele ngosuku ngalunye."
Bafike bahlangana naMosi na-Aron, behlala nabo lapho bephuma khona kuFaro.
batsi kubo: "Simakadze abone lokho nikwenzayo, aze akugweme; ngobe nitfubile kuFaro kanye nabangani bakhe, nimise silebhu esandla sabo, kutsi basibulala."
Musa wabuyela kuSimakadze, watsi: "Simakadze, kungani ukwenta lokubi kulabo bantu? Kungani uthumela mina?
Kusuka lapho ngiye kuFaro, ngakhuluma ngegama lakho, wakwenza kahle nalaba bantu; wena ke awuzange usindise labantu bakho.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Namuhla utawubona kutsi ngiyawukwenza yini kuFaro; ngobe ngesandla sami esinamandla, uyaba sulwa; nangesandla sami esinamandla, uyabasusa ezweni lakhe.
Nkulunkulu watsi kuMosesi: "Ngiye Simakadze.
Ngiye ngabonakala kuAbrahama, neIsakha, naYakobi, njengeNkulunkulu Omkhulu; kepha ngegama lami, uSimakadze, angizange ngibe khona kubo.
Nami ngamisa inhlanganiso yami nabo, kutsi ngibanike iNingizimu Afrika, lapho behlala khona njengabahlali basebantwini.
Nami ngitsi: "Ngiye ngalilalela lokungakhululeki kwalabaSirayeli, labaMaegipta bebasebentisa; nami sengikhumbula inkohlakalo yami.

"Uye utsi kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli: 'NginguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu; ngiyawutfumisa nisuka ngaphansi kwemisebenzi leminzima yebantfu be-Egypti, nami ngitawukukhulula kutsi ningabe bakhonzi kwabo, nami ngiyakusindisa ngesandla sami esinamandla, nangenhlolovo enkulu.

Nami ngiyawukuba nguNkulunkulu wenu, nami ngitawuba nguSimakadze longuSomandla wenu, Nkulunkulu wenu, kutsi nizibone, ngobe mina nginguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowo uphumayo ngaphansi kwesandla salabo base-Egypti.
Nami ngiyawukuleta nifike ezweni lapho ngatsi ngesandla sami, kutsi ngitawulinikela ku-Abrahama, ku-Isake, nakwe-Yakobi; nami ngiyakulinika libe yilungelo lenu. Ngiye Simakadze.
Wakhuluma la mazwi kuboSirayeli, kodvwa bangeke bakhulume naMosesi; ngobe bebengaba nemoya lobuhlungu, nemsebenti wabo wawunzima.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi watsi:
Watsi: "Hamba ukhulume naFarao, ukumkani waseMisri, kutsi avumele bantfu baseSirayeli baphume ezweni lakhe."
Musa watsi kuSimakadze, utsi: "Labo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli bangeke bandiслушe; ngobe ngikhuluma lutho lokubi, kungani ke uFaro angamilalela?"
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi na-Aron ngebantfu beSirayeli kanye neFaro, ukumkani waseMijiphu, watsi kubo: "Niphumani nabo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli eMijiphu."
Labo babenemadvodzana aRubhen, lomnyaka wesitsatfu waSirayeli: Hanoki, naFalu, naHezroni, naKarmi; labo babemalunga emindeni yaRubhen.
Lamadvodza laSimeoni: Jemuele, naJamini, naOhadi, naJakini, naTsohari, naShauli, lomnyaka mncane wandvodza yakwaKanana; lawa mamndeni aSimeoni.
Lamagama lamadvodzana aLevi, ngesigaba sabo sokuzalwa:Gershoni, neKehati, naMerari; iminyaka yekuphila kwaLevhi yayiminyaka lemakhulu lamashumi mathathu esikhombisa.
Lamadvodzana aGhershoni, ngemindeni yabo: Libni naShimeyi.
Labantwana bakaKehati: Amrami, ne-Izhari, neHebroni, na-Uziyeli. Kehati wahlala iminyaka lemakhulu lamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu.
Lamadvodza laMerariya: Mahli naMushi; lemihlambi yalabaLevi, ngaleso sigaba sekuboshwa kwabo.
UAmram washada neJokhebedi, umngane wakhe wesifazane; yena wamzala uAron noMosese. Wahlala Amram iminyaka lengema-137 nemashumi lamane nasikhombisa.
Labantwana baka-Izhari: Kora, Nefeg, neZikri.
Lamadvodzana aUziyeli bekunguMishayeli, neElzaphan, naSithri.
Aron washada neElisheba, intombi ka-Aminadabi, umngane ka-Nahshon; yena wazala uNadab, naAbihu, naEleazari, naIthamari.
Labantwana baka-Kora: uAsiri, neElkana, naAbiyasaphe; lalaba ngubo bamndeni wakwa-Korahi.
Eleazari, umsa wa-Aron, waba nendvodzakati yePuthiyeli; yena wamzala Phinehasi; labo babenetinhloko temindeni yalabaLevi, ngemindeni yabo.
Lowo ngu-Aron naMoses, labaSimakadze wabaphendvula watsi: "Thipha lamadvodza aseSirayeli aphuma eMfuleni i-Egipta, ngemindeni yabo, ngamandla abo.
Baye labakhuluma kuFaro, inkhosi yaseMijiphu, kutsi baphumese bantfu baka-Israyeli eMijiphu; loMosesi na-Aron.
Kwatsi lapho Simakadze abekhuluma kuMosese eMijiphu,
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Ngiye Nkulunkulu; khuluma kuFaro, ukumkani waseMijiphu, ngako konke lokusho kuwe."
Musa watsi kuSimakadze, utsi: "Ngingeke ngikhulume kahle; kungani uFaro akhuluma nami?
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Bona, sengikwenta wena ube nguNkulunkulu kuFaro; na-Aron, umngane wakho, uzoba ngumprofeti wakho.
Utawukhuluma naFaro konke longangikwenta kuwe; uAron, umngane wakho, uzokhuluma naFaro, kutsi avumele bantfu baka-Israyeli baphume ezweni lakhe.
Ngaye ngiyawugcoba inhliziyo yeFaro, ngingabambisa imiqondiso yami kanye nemibono yami emazweni ase-Ejipt.
Faro akakulalelani; ngobe ngitawubeka isandla sami eMijiphu, ngiyawukhipha abantu bami, bantfu bakaSirayeli, eMijiphu, ngemandla lamakhulu, ngemindeni yabo.
Bami base-Egypt batawuzi kutsi ngiye Simakadze, lapho ngitfumisa khona isandla sami eMijiphu, ngisuse bantfu bakaSirayeli emiphakathini yabo.
Mosi na-Aaroni bakwenza njengobe Simakadze abewaphendvula watsi:
Musa ubeneminyaka lengema-80 ubudala, naAron waba neminyaka lemashumi lamane nemathathu, lapho bekhuluma kuFarao.
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Aron:
UFaro utawukhuluma nani, watsi: 'Ninikele phawu.' Ngako-ke utsi kuArhoni: 'Thipha isandla sakho, uyifake phambi kweFaro, ibe ngugodzi.'"
Waphuma uMosese na-Aron, wafika ePharao, wakwenza njengobe Simakadze abemwisele kutsi akwenze; u-Aron wehlisa isandla sakhe phambi kwePharao, kanye nenkhosi yakhe, yabuye yaba ngudlovukazi.
UFaro wababiza nabo bonke labo bakholwa kuNkulunkulu, nalabo abafuna ukubulala; nabo bonke labaphazamisayo base-Egipta bakwenza njalo ngemandla abo.
Bakhipha lomunye isandla sakhe, lesandla sakhe sibuye sibe ngugodzi; kepha isandla sika-Aron salisa isandla sabo.
Lakho intliziyo kaFaro yashiswa, akazange abonise kubo, njengobe Simakadze abesho.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Inhliziyo yaFaro icwebile; akafuni kutsi avumele abantu bahambe.
"Thumela kuFaro ngasokudla, lapho ephuma khona ekuseni kwamanzi; hlala kuye emgwaqeni weNdlela, uthathe ngesandla sakho isandla lesishintshiwe sibe ngugodzi.
Watsi kuye: Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wemaHebhere, ungithumela kuwe, ngithi kuwe: Lalela abantu bami bahambe, bamikhonze efulethini; kepha wena ungeke wakhuluma kuze kube manje.
Simakadze utsi: Ngalento utawuzi kutsi ngiye Nkulunkulu; bona, ngiyakubetha amanzi laseNtsabeni ngesandla sami, abuye abe yigazi.
Inhlanzi lekhona emfuleni iyawufa, umfula utawubi nephunga, ngobe laSirayeli bangadlanga amanzi akhe.'

USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Utsi u-Aron, 'Thipha isandla sakho, utsuse icala lakho phezu kwamanzi aseMijiphu, emafuleni abo, imifula yabo, tilwandle zabo kanye naleyo mihlambi yaso yonke, ukuze libuye libe yigazi; kuze kube khona insangu kuwo wonke lamadolobha eMisri, nangemibhoshongo yesiliva negolide.'

Wathi uMosi na-Aron: "Nifikeni, nibuye eGibhithe," Simakadze watsi kubo. 21Mosese ne-Aaroni bakwenza njengobe Nkulunkulu wabawisela kutsi akwenze; waphakamisa isandla sakhe phambi kweFaro kanye nabo bonkhe labakhonzi bakhe, wehlisa amanzi laseNdlongweni, nawo wonke amanzi aseMfula wangena emlonyeni.
Inhlanzi yaseNili yafa, lilanga lafika libi kakhulu, laba-Israyeli bengeke baphuze amanzi aseNili; kwabe khona igazi ezweni lonke la-Israyeli.
Baye bakwenza njalo nalabamangali baseMijiphu ngemicabango yabo; inhliziyo kaFaro yashiywa, akazange abonise kubo, njengobe Simakadze abesho.
UFaro wabuyela emuva, waya ekhaya lakhe, akazange abeke lesi simo engqondweni yakhe.
Batsi bonke bantfu base-Egypte batfusa emaphandleni eNil, befuna amanzi lokudlela; ngobe abengadla amanzi emfula.
Kwaphela lilanga lesitsatfu ngemuva kwekuti Simakadze abewubulala loMfula.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Hamba ufike kuFaro, utsi kuye: 'UNkulunkulu uthe kutsi: 'Laba bantu bami bavumeleni bahambe, bangangikhonza.
Uma ungafuni kutsi bahambe, bona, ngitawuthumela imvu emhlabatsini wakho lonke.

iNdlela leNgcwele izoba likhulu kakhulu, liyawufika endlwini yakho, nesihlalo sakho sokuhlala, nasenhliziyweni yakho; liyawufika emindenini yabaholi bakho, nasebantwaneni bakho, nasezikhungweni zakho, nasetfuleni lakho lokupheka.
Lemihlambi leyawuphuma kuwe, nakubo bonkhe bantfu bakho, nalabaphathi bakho bonke.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thita uAron, utsuse isandla sakho ngesandla sakho sakho phezu kwemifula, emafuleni, nemishado, bese ukhipha tingulube phezulu ezweni leMijiphu."
U-Aron wehlisa isandla sakhe phezu kwamanzi aseMijiphu; netingcosana zaphuma, zagubulela umhlaba.
Baye bakwenza njalo nalabaphambukeli ngemilingo yabo, batsi: "Siyawukhipha tingulube emhlabatsini saseYiputa."
UFarao wababiza uMosi na-Aron, watsi: "Buyiselani kuSimakadze kutsi asuse lemiphiko kumnakho nami nebantfu bami; ngitawuvumela abantu ukuba bahambe banikela ngeminikelo kuNkulunkulu."
Musa watsi kuFaro: "Kukakho wena, yini lapho kufanele ngithandaza khona kuwe, nabangani bakho, nebantfu bakho, kutsi lemihlambi ihambe nawe kanye nemindeni yakho, ibe yiNtsabeni kuphela."
UMosese watsi kuye: "Lakho kumele kube njalo, kutsi ubone ukuthi akukho muntfu lofana naSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu; ngobe akazange afune kutfunywa kwakhe.
Lamakhoboka ayawuphuma kuwe, nemindeni yakho, nalabaphathi bakho, nasebantwaneni bakho; azohlala eNtsabeni yeNdlela kuphela.
Musa na-Aron baphuma kuFaro, watsi: "Mosese wathandaza kuSimakadze mayelana nezinhlanzi, azenzako kuFaro.
Simakadze wakwenza njengobe uMosi akusho; tingulube zafa emindenini, nasemadvolweni, nasetinsimini.
Labantfu babeka emacwecwe lamakhulu kakhulu, ngobe lemhlaba wonke waba nephunga.
LeFarao, lapho ebona khona kutsi lenkinga iphelile, wabeka umphefumulo wakhe ngesandla sakhe esiqinile, watsi: "Angeke ngibalalele," njengobe Simakadze abesho.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Utsi ku-Aron: 'Thinda isandla sakho, uhlasele umhlabathi wemhlaba, ubuye ube yizingulube ngaso sonke saseYiputa.' "
Baye bakwenza njalo. Aharonu wehlisa isandla sakhe ngesandla sakhe, wahlasela umhlabathi wemhlaba, kwafika emakhoyi kumuntu kanye nenyama; wonke umhlabathi wemhlaba wase-Egypt waba makhoyi.
Baye bafuna ukwenza tingulube ngemandla abo, kodvwa bangakwazanga; tingulube zafika kumuntu kanye nenyama yebantfu.
Bathi abamangali kuFaro: "Lena yisandla saNkulunkulu." Kodwa intliziyo kaFaro yagwema, akazange alalele, njengobe Simakadze abesho.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Khangela ekuseni, uhlale phambi kweFaro; lapho ephuma elwandle, ufike utsi kuye: 'UNkulunkulu uthi: Lalela abantu bami bahambe, bangangikhonza.'

"Uma ungeke uvumele abantu bami bahambe, bona, ngiyawuthumela emabhubesi emhlabatsini kuwe, nalabakhonzi bakho, nalabo bantu bakho, nangetindlu zakho; tindlu takwa-Egipta nemhlaba wabo utawuphindwa ngamabhubesi.
Ngaleso sikhathi ngizomisa ilizwe leGosheni, lapho abantu bami behlala khona; kungeke kube khona tingulube letibi; nawe utawuzi kutsi mina, Simakadze, sengiphakathi kwalomhlaba.
Nami ngitawumisa inhlanganiso phakathi kwebantfu bami nebantfu bakho; lesi sibonakaliso siyawuba khona kusasa.
USimakadze wakwenza njalo, kwafika imphiko yezinhlanzi endlwini kaFaro kanye nemindeni yalabo abasebenzela yena; yonke imifula yaseMijiphu yashiswa yinhlanzi.
UFarao watsi kuMosi na-Aron: "Niya, ninikeze tinhlanhla kuNkulunkulu wenu kulelizwe."

Musa watsi: Akufanele kube njalo; ngobe iminikelo lesihlanganiswe nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, iyaba buhlungu kulabo base-Egipta. Uma sinikela ngemnikelo lobuhlungu kubo phambi kwabo, bangatsi batfusa kanjani emacwecwe?
Siyawuhamba ngendlela yelilanga lesikhombisa sifike esigabeni setfu, sanikela ngenhlanhla kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, njengobe akhuluma nathi.
Watsi uFaro: "Ngitakusivumelani kutsi nihambe, nibe nemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu esiqhingini; kepha ungeneni kude kakhulu; thandazani ngami."

Musa watsi: "Njengoku, lapho ngiphuma khona kuwe, ngizothandaza kuSimakadze, kutsi lilanga lesikhombisa lihambe leli gciwane lisuka kuFaro, nakubo labakhonzi bakhe, nebantfu bakhe; kepha iFaro angeke aphinde abusise, angeke avumele abantu baphume, banikela kuSimakadze."
Musa waphuma eFaro, wathandaza kuSimakadze.
Simakadze wakwenza njengobe Mozesi akhuluma; tingulube tasuka kuFaro, nakubo labakhonzi bakhe, nasebantwaneni bakhe; akazange ashiye nelinye.
Lapha-ke uFaro wehlisa umphefumulo wakhe, watsi: "Angeke ngivumele labantfu bahambe."
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Hamba ufike kuFaro, utsi kuye: 'UNkulunkulu weSihebheri uthe kutsi: 'Laba bantu bami bavumeleni bahambe, bangangikhonza.'
Uma ungeke uvumele kutsi bahambe, bese uhlala uhamba nabo,
isandla saSimakadze sitawuba nesifo esibi kakhulu ekudlaleni kwakho, emabhubesi akho, nama-asli akho, nama-engeli akho, namabhokhwe akho, nemindeni yakho.
Simakadze ungeke agcine isilwane sema-Israyeli sifana nesilwane sama-Israyeli aseMijiphu; ngeke siphele nasinye isilwane sema-Israyeli.'
Simakadze wamisa sikhathi, watsi: "Namuhla uSimakadze uzokwenza lokhu kulelizwe."
Nakho Simakadze wakwenza njalo ngelilanga lesibili, naletinye tintfo letiphilako te-Egypt zafa; kodvwa kubantfu beSirayeli asikubi nesinye sitfu.
UFaro wathumela, wababona, ngobe, bona, kuleyo mihlambi yalabaSirayeli, angeke kube nenye lefile; kepha intliziyo kaFaro yayiqinile, akazange avumele labantfu bahambe.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi na-Aron: "Nifikeni nigcwele isandla sam, nithole lilanga lemlilo, uMosesi kumele alifuthe lizulu phambi kweFaro.
Lena ibuye ibe nguthuli oluncane emhlabatsini lonke leNingizimu ye-Egypt, lifike livele libe yisifo lesibulalayo kumuntu kanye nenyama, emhlabatsini lonke leNingizimu ye-Egypt.
Batsi: "Bafike bakhipha iphunga lelifu, bahlala phambi kweFaro; Mozesi wamisa emoya, kwaphuma kulabo bantu naleyo silwane ticubu tesifo lesibulalayo.
Lababhali-mlilo abengazange bahlale phambi kwaMosesi, ngenxa yetinhlayiya; ngobe tinhlayiya tavela kubo lababhali-mlilo kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseEgypt.
USimakadze waletsa intliziyo kaFaro, watsi: "Awuvabali," ngobe uMosi ne-Aron babekhuluma, njengobe Simakadze abesho kuMosese.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Khangela ekuseni, ufike ePharao, utsi kuye: 'UNkulunkulu weSirayeli, Nkulunkulu wemaHebhere, uthe kutsi: 'Laba bantu bami bavumeleni bahambe, bangangikhonza.'
Ngaleso sikhathi ngitawuthumela zonke tifo tami kuwe, nalabakhonzi bakho, nalabo bantu bakho, ukuze ubone ukuthi akukho lofanana nami emhlabeni wonke.
Ngase ngibe sengitawumisa isandla sami, ngakubulala wena nebantfu bakho ngesifo sendlala, kuze uphelele emhlabatsini.
Ngako-ke, ngobe ngifuna kutsi ubone amandla ami, ngakushiya uphile, ukuze igama lami lifundiswe emhlabeni wonke.
Uye uhlala uhamba ngebantfu bami, ungabavumeleni bahambe.
Ngako-ke, ngaleso sikhathi sengitawukhipha imvula lebuhlungu kakhulu, leyawufika eMisri kusukela kulelo langa libe yilizwe kuze kube manje.

Namuhla, khipha umyalo kutsi tilwane takho nezinto tonkhe letikhona emhlabatsini tifakwe emabhokisini; ngobe tinhlaba temvula tiyawugwaca kuwo wonke umuntu kanye netilwane letihlala emhlabatsini, titawufa.'
Bakhona labaphathi beFarao, bakhathazekile ngelizwi laSimakadze, bafike bafaka emakhosa abo kanye nenyama yabo.
Batsi nalabo labangeke bacabangele mtsetfo waSimakadze, babeshiya emakhosa abo nenyama yabo emhlabatsini.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thinda isandla sakho esibhakabhakeni, kube khona umfula-mlilo emhlabatsini waseYiputa, kubo bonkhe bantfu kanye nenyama, nakweso sonke sitshalo semhlabatsini saseYiputa."

UMosesi wehlisa isandla sakhe esibhakabhakeni, uSimakadze watsi: "Cinga mlilo kanye nemvula yamanzi; lilanga letfu lifike libe ngumlilo emhlabatsini. UNkulunkulu wakhipha lilanga lemvula ezweni laseMijiphu."
Waba khona umfula wemvula, nemlilo wehla emhlabatsini; kwakungeke kube khona umfula lomkhulu kunawo onke ema-Egipta kusukela lapho akhulela khona.
Lesikhukhula sabulala yonke into emhlabatsini, emfuleni i-Egipta, kusukela kumuntu kuya esilwaneni; sabulala nesihlahla sonke semhlabatsini, saphula nesihlahla sonke.
Kube khona ndzawo lekahle kuphela lapho kungakabi khona imvula yemlilo, leyo mhlaba weGoshen, lapho bantfu beSirayeli behlala khona.
UFarao wehla wabiza uMosi na-Aron, watsi kubo: "Namuhla sengihlukumekile; Simakadze ulungile, mina nebantfu bami singenabubi.
thandazani kuSimakadze, ngobe sifike sesivuthane nemlilo kanye nemvula; ngitakusivumela kutsi nihambe. Angeke nihlale njalo.
UMosi watsi kuye, "Ngenalapho ngiphuma emizini, ngizophakamisa isandla sami kuSimakadze; lilanga letfu liyawuphela, nemvula yemvula ingabikho, ukuze ubone ukuthi lemhlaba nguwo uSimakadze.
Ngitakubona kutsi wena kanye nalabakhonzi bakho, kuze kube manje, angeke nibikele Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.
Lelindza nelibomvu beluboshwa, ngobe lindza lalinemikhono, lelibovu belibilile.
Kusekungeke kube khona lokubi, ngobe lomhlabatsi kanye ne-spelt akufanele kushiswa.
Waphuma uMosese kuFaro, waya ngaphandle komgwaqo, waphakamisa isandla sakhe kuSimakadze; lilanga nemvula yasita, namanzi akazange abuye afike emhlabatsini.
UFarao, lapho ebona khona kutsi lilanga nemvula kanye nemlilo wetintaba sewuphelile, wabuyela ekubusiseni; waba nenhliziyo ebucayi, yena nalabo abasebenza naye.
UFarao wabeka sandla sakhe enhliziyweni yakhe, akazange avumele lamadvodza aseSirayeli ahambe, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma ngaMosese.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Hamba ufike kuFaro; ngobe ngiyenzile inhliziyo yakhe ibe buhlungu, yena nalabakhonzi bakhe, kutsi ngibeke lamandla ami emiphakathini yabo.

Nakho, ngikwenza lokhu, ukuze ukhulume kumadvodzana akho nemadvodzakati akhe, kutsi yini lengingayenza ema-Egipta, kanye nemfihlakalo yami engiyibonile phakathi kwabo; ngobe ningeke nibone ukuthi ngiSimakadze.

Waphuma ke Musa na-Aron, wafika kuFaro, watsi kuye: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wemaHebhere, utsi: 'Kuyaphi isikhathi lapho awufuni khona kutsi ukhululeke phambi kwami? Lalela abantu bami ukuba bahambe, bangangikhonza.
ngobe, uma ungeke uvumele kutsi bahambe, bona, kusasa ngitawutfusa tingulube emaphandleni akho.
Nalo mhlaba utawugcwaliswa ngato, kuze kungabonakali; nalowo mncane lowushiyeke ngemuva kwemvula yemlilo, nesihlahla sonke esikhulako emhlabatsini sakho, liyawudla.

Ziya kugcwalisa indlu yakho, nendlu yalabo bonke abakhonzi bakho, naleyo yabo bonkhe bantfu baseMijiphu; lokusho kutsi ababuboni botata bakho kanye nabobaba betaba takho lutho lwento lenjalo kusukela ngelilanga labahlala kulomhlaba kuze kube manje.'" Musa wabuyela waya eFaroheni.
Batsi kuye labaphathi beFaro: "Kuyaphi lapho lomuntfu atawuhlala esihluku sethu? Lalela abantu bahambe, babe ngumnikelo waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wabo; awubonanga yini kutsi iMisri iyafa?"
Bayawubuyela kuMosesi na-Aron ePharao, watsi kubo: "Niya, nikhonze uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu; kepha ngitsini kutsi ngubani longeke ahambe.
UMosese watsi: "Siyahamba nalabo abancane nathi kanye nalabakhulu bethu, nemadvodzana ethu nemadvodzakati ethu, nemfuyo yethu kanye nengulube yethu; ngobe sifuna ukwenza iholide kuSimakadze."
Watsi uFaro: "Simakadze angeke abe nawe, uma ngikuvumele uhambe, wena nezingane zakho; ngiyabona kutsi ungenalo liciniso emehlo akho.
Laba madoda kuphela ayawuhamba, abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze; ngobe lokhu sekube yisinqumo senu." Ngako-ke Musa na-Aron baphuma ePharao.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thinda isandla sakho ema-Ejiptheni, kube khona tingulube letiphuma emhlabatsini, tifike zidle yonke imfuyo yemhlabatsini.
UMosesi wehlisa isandla sakhe phezu kweMijiphu, Simakadze wabeka umoya wasenyakatho uphuma ezweni lonke ngalolusuku nelobusuku bonke; kuze kufike ekuseni, umphunga wabangele tingulube.
Bafike bafika emhlabatsini, bahlala kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseYiputa; angeke kube khona lomhlabatsi lokufana nalo, naloko angeke bube khona.

Naye wavala imhlaba wonke, wamisa umhlaba wonke, wadla yonke imfuyo yasemhlabatsini, naleyo mbewu yesihlahla sonke, leyawushiywa ngumlilo; kwatsi kungakabikho lutho lokuluhlaza kulowo mhlahlandlela noma kulowo mhlahlandlela, kuwo onkhe emadolobha ase-Egipta.
UFarao wahamba watsi kuMosesi na-Aron, watsi: "Mine sengihlukumekile kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, nangenu.
Manje-ke, ngiyakucela, vumelani kutsi ngikhululwe kulesi sigubhu, bese nithandaza kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, kutsi asuse lokufa kusuka kum.
Musa waphuma eFaro, wathandaza kuSimakadze.

USimakadze wehlisa umoya waba ngumoya wekwentshonalanga, lonamandla kakhulu, wakhipha tingulube, wawasusa eMfuleni Wesibhakabhaka. Akukho linye lilungu lelingu-100 lahlala emhlabeni waseMijiphu lonke.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wehlisa umphefumulo waFarao, watsi: "Labo baLevi bangabi nalutho lokubashiya."
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thinda isandla sakho esibhakabhakeni, kube nebumnyama eMijiphu, bumnyama obukhulu kakhulu, kutsi bangeke bakwazi kubamba.
Mosese wamisa isandla sakhe esibhakabhakeni, kwafika kumnyama lokukhulu emhlabatsini waseYiputa iminyaka lemibili.
Angeke kube khona lokubonana, kodvwa bonke bantfu baseSirayeli babe nekukhanya lapho behlala khona.
UFaro watsi kuMosi: "Hambani, nikhonze uSimakadze; nabangani benu bangahamba nani; kepha imihlambi yenu nemindeni yenu kumele ihlale lapha."
Simakadze watsi kuMosi: "Ufanele usinike nenyama yemnikelo wesono kanye nesondlo somlilo, kutsi siyinikela kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu.
Nalenyama lethu kumele lihambe nathi, angeke lishiye nesinye isandla sayo; ngobe sitawunikela ngaso kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, kuze sifike khona, asizange sibone kutsi yini ekufanele siyenze.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wehlisa umphefumulo waFarao, watsi: "Ungeke ubavumele bahambe."
Watsi uFaro kuMosi: "Thina, phuma emehlo ami; qiniseka kutsi awuzange ubone buso bam; ngobe ngelilanga lewubona buso bam, uya kufa."
Simakadze watsi kuMosi: "Kungenjalo, ngobe usho kutsi: 'Angeke ngibone buso bakho kuze kube sekupheleni.'
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Ngitakulethela linye ligciwane ePharao naseMijiphu; ngemuva kwalo, utawukuvumeleni nihambe lapha, kuze kube sekuphele kutsi akwati kutsi anifukule.
Utsi kubo: Lomuntu ngamunye, lowesifazane nalowo wesifazane, kumele afune kulabo labangane bakhe ema-Egipta, izinto zesiliva negolide.
Simakadze wabanika laba bantu inhlonipho ema-Egyptians; naMosese wahlala elihle kakhulu e-Egypt, kulabo base-Egipta, kanye nebantfu.
Mosi watsi: "Kuye kutsi Simakadze utsi: Ngasekufeni kwebusuku, ngitahamba eningizimu yeMijiphu.

Nabo bonke labazalwa kuqala ezweni leMijiphu bangafa, kusukela emzali weFaro, lohlala esihlalweni sakhe sebukhosi, kuze kube ngumzali wendvodzakati yakhe, laye egcekeni lakhe, kanye nabo bonke labazalwa kuqala emihlambini.
Kuyawuba khona kugwaca lokukhulu emhlabatsini waseMisri, likhulu kunalelo lelikhe labe likhona nalelo lelingaba nalo.
Kubo bonke bantfu baseSirayeli, nalabo labaphilako, ngisho nesilwane sitawutsi, ukuze nibone kutsi uSimakadze uhlukanisa phakathi kwe-Egypt neSirayeli.
Labo bonke labakhonzi bakho bayawufika ngiyo, baya kuhlangula phambi kwami, bethi, Yiya, wena nebantfu bonke labalandela wena; emva kwalokho ngizophuma. Musa waphuma ePharao, ekhangele ngebuhlungu.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Pharao angeke anivumeli kutsi nikhulume, ngobe ngifuna kwenza imijabuliso yami ezweni leMijiphu."
Musa na-Aron bakwenze lamandla onke enhliziyweni kaFaro; kodvwa uSimakadze waletsa intliziyo kaFaro, ngobe akazange abonise bantfu bakaSirayeli baphume ezweni lakhe.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi na-Aron ezweni la-Ejipta, watsi:
Lomnyaka utawube ngumnyaka wesifazane kuwe; lomnyaka utawuba ngumnyaka wekucala kuwe.
Utsi: "Kuleminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesihlanu yemnyaka lomusha, kuyawufika umnikelo wesono lokushiswa esivumelwaneni saSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.

Uma mndeni uncane kakhulu kutsi udle ingulube legcwele, kumele bahlukanise nenye nalowo lasenyakatho-ntshonalanga wabo, ngokuya ngenombolo yalabo bantu. Hlala ukuthi ingulube leningi yini edingekayo kanye ne okwesibili loyawudla.
Lenyama letawuyikhetha kumele ibe mnyama yemnyaka mncane, ingabi nenkinga nayinye. Ungayithatha ibe yingulube noma ibe yimvu.
Ningeke niyigcine kuze kube ngumhla wesitsatfu lomhlaka-14 walomnyaka, bese bonke bantfu besive semaSirayeli babulala inyama yabo lapho lilanga liphuma khona.
Baphindze bathathe sinye sezicubu, bamise emnyango wendlu lapho badla khona lenyama, kanye nesandla senhloko yemnyango.
Kulelo busuku kumele badle inyama, ephekwe emanzini, kanye nemifino emibi, nemnikelo wekushiswa longeke ucwebe.
Ungayidla inyama ifile noma iphekwe emanzini. Nciphisa lenyama yonke ngemlilo, inhlavu yayo, tinyawo zayo, kanye netinhlayiya.
Ningeke nishiye lutho kuwo kuze kuhlwa; ngobe uma kukhona lokushiwo kuze kuhlwa, nitawukucubha.
Lendlela nitawuyidla ngayo: ubandlulule umlenze wakho, netinwele takho emadolo akho, nesandla senu sisemandleni enu; niyawudla ngaso sikhatsi lesidze, ngoba iPasha yaSimakadze.
Nami ngizohamba ngaleyo busuku eMijiphu, ngiyakubulala sonke lesiqale kutsi sikhule, kusukela kumuntu kuze kube yinyama; nami ngiyakwenza lokubi kubo bonkhe labangcwele beMijiphu. Ngiye Simakadze.
Legazi liyawuba nguphawu kuwe, kuleyo ndlu yenu; ngitakubona legazi, ngobe ngiyakudlula. Angeke kube khona ubhubhiso lobulalayo, lapho ngitibulala khona ema-Egipti.
Lomhla lonjalo kumele ube ngusuku lokuphawula kwenu, niwugcine njengenhlanhla yaSimakadze, kuze kube kufike iminyaka yenu yonke. Kuye kube ngumthetho wokuphila kuze kube sekupheleni.

Ngelilanga lesitsatfu niyawudla umnikelo wekushiswa longeke wehlisiwe. Mhlaka-dvo lwekucala, nitawukhipha umhluzi emindenini yenu; ngobe nalowo lakudla lokuhlanganiswako kusukela mhla wokuqala kuze kube ngumnyaka wasikhombisa, lowo muntu uyasuswa kuSirayeli.

Ngelilanga lekucala nibe nekuhlangana lokungcwele, nangelilanga lesisikhombisa nibe nekuhlangana lokungcwele; ningasebenzi lutho ngalolusuku, ngaphandle kwekulungiselela lokudla lokufanele wonke umuntu. Lokho kulomsoco wenu.

Uyawugcina usuku lwemifino engumquba, ngobe ngalolusuku lwale ngitawukhipha bantfu bakho emhlabatsini waseMisri, ngemindeni yabo; losuku luyawugcinwa kuwo wonke lamadodana akho; ngumthetho wokuphila kuze kube sekuseni.
Kumnyaka wokuqala, kusukela ngelilanga lelishumi nelinesihlanu ekuseni kuya ngelilanga lemashumi lasitfupha nalinye ekuseni, niyawudla inhlanzi lengenakuphekwa.
Kungeke kuboneke ikhofi emindenini yenu iminyaka lesikhombisa; ngobe nalowo lodla ikhofi, lowo muntu sulwa emphakathini waseSirayeli, noma ngabe ungumkhwenyana, noma ngabe ukhulele kulomhlaba.
Ningeke nidle noma yini eyenziwe ngefulawa; emgwaqeni wenu, kumele nidle inyama lengenafulawa.
Mosesi wabiza bonke bomkhuluwa ba-Israyeli, watsi kubo: "Thumelani, nithatheni inkomo ngemindeni yenu, nidle inyama yepasha.

"Nithathe inhlanganisela ye-hysop, niyicwebezele egazini lelingene emgodini, nimise emaphiko emnyango kanye nemilenze yakhe emimbili ngaleyo gazi; namunye wenu angeke aphume engangeni yendlu yakhe kuze kube ngekusasa.

"Simakadze utawuhamba abulala ema-Egipta, bese ubona igazi esigabeni semnyango kanye nesihlalo semgobho, khona-ke Simakadze utawudlula lomnyango, akawuvumele lowo ubulalayo afike enhlanganweni yenu abulala.
Lamandla lawa kumele agcinwe, wena nemadvodzana akho, kutsi kube ngumthetho lohlala njalo.
Uma nifika ezweni leSimakadze utawukunikela ngalo kuwe, njengobe wakusho, gcinani lesi simiso.
Naleso sikhatsi, lapho bantfu bakho bekubuza kutsi: 'Iyini lemicimbi?'

bese ukhuluma kubo, utsi: Kuyimnikelo wekushiswa wePasha kuSimakadze, lowo wadlula emehlweni lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli eMijiphu, lapho abulala khona ema-Egipta, waletsa emakhaya ethu." Lamadodana aSawula na-Ahira bahlangula, bathandaza.
Lamadvodzana a-Israyeli lakwenze njalo, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mosi na-Aron.

Kwaba ngasebusuku, Simakadze wabulala wonke umzali wesifazane eYiputa, kusukela kumzali weFaro, lohlala esihlalweni sakhe, kuze kube kumzali welowo obekwe entolongweni; wabulala nanoma yini lephilayo, yonke inyama.

Waphuma khona uFaro ngaleyo busuku, naye nalabaphathi bakhe bonke, nabo bonkhe bantfu baseMijiphu; kwabe sekukhona umfutho omkhulu eMijiphu, ngobe kwakungeke kubekho indlu lapho kungasekho khona lokufa.
UFarao wabiza uMosi na-Aron ngebusuku, watsi: "Thintwani, phumani kulabo bantu bami, niye nalabaSirayeli; ningabimbi Simakadze, njengoba nitsi.
Niyithathe imindeni yenu kanye netimbuti tenu, njengobe nitsi; uyeni, nami-ke nibambisene nami.
Bami base-Egypti batsi kubo: "Nize niphume ezweni lenu, ngobe sitawufa."
Batsi bantfu bakhipha umhluzi wabo, ngaphambi kokuba ukhishwe, bewubeka emabhodlela abo ekudla emilenzeni yabo, bawufaka emehlweni.
BaLevi bayawukwenza njengobe Mozesi abekhuluma kubo, bacela ema-Egipta izinto zesiliva negolide, kanye netibopho.
Simakadze wabeka kubo isandla sakhe, wabanika ukuthula ebusweni be-Egypt; ngobe bafike babulala lamadodana ase-Egypt.
Baphuma basuka eRameshe befika eSukhothi, laba ngumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane lamadoda ahamba ngenyawo, ngaphandle kwalabancane.
Bahamba nabo nabanye bantfu abaningi, kanye nemindeni lemikhulu yetingulube netilwane.
Baphe lokudla lokucwebezelayo, balungiselela emabhisa, ngekudla lokucwebezelayo lababeka eMfuleni iJordane; ngobe bekuboshwa eMfuleni iJordane, bengeke babe nesikhathi sokulungiselela.
Leminyaka yabo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli labahlala eYiputa yaba iminyaka lemakhulu lamane nemashumi lasitfupha.
Kuphela iminyaka lemashumi lamane nesikhombisa, ngaleso sikhathi, bonke bantfu bakaSimakadze baphuma eYiputa, laba yimikhosi.

Simakadze wagcina lobusuku, kutsi abonise kutsi uyawubakhipha ezweni leMijiphu; ngakho bonke bantfu beSirayeli kumele bagcine lobusuku, ukuze babe nekuthula naSimakadze kuze kube sekupheleni kwemihla yabo.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi na-Aron: "Lemiyalo yepaskha itsi: Akukho mhlali longaphandle layawuyidla.
Umkhonto wakho lothengiswe ngemali uyawudla wona, kodvwa kufanele umcwele.
Lomunye lahlala nawe, noma lowo losebenza nawe ngemali, angeke ayidle.
Lenyama kumele itfolwe endlini leyinye. Ungayikhiphanga ngaphandle kwendlu, noma ngabe yinye yemithambo yayo ungayiphuca.
Lonke libandla le-Isirayeli kumele liyigcine.

""Nasekungeke kube khona umkhwenyana lohlala nawe, efuna ukwenza iPasha kuSimakadze, kumele ahlatjiswe wonke lamadoda endlu yakhe, abe ngumuntfu lozalwa kulomhlaba; kodvwa noma ngubani ongakahlatjisiwe, angayidla.
Lomthetho lowo uyawuba khona kulowo lazalwa kulomhlaba, nakulowo losuka ngaphandle lohlala phakathi kwenu.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli layawukwenza njalo, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose naAron.
Ngalowo busuku uSimakadze wakhipha bantfu beSirayeli emhlabatsini saseMijiphu, ngemikhosi yabo, njengemkhosi.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Sebenzisa kutsi kube ngimi, wonke lomusha lowuvula umlomo wakhe; wonke lomusha lowuvula umlomo wakhe emadvodzana a-Israyeli kumele abe ngimi, noma ngabe ngumuntu noma ngabe yinyama.
UMosese wathi kubo: "Thintela losuku loku, lapho niphuma khona ema-Egypti, kutsi nibe bakhonzi; Simakadze utfumele khona ngesandla sakhe esinamandla. Ningeke nidle noma yini encibilikisiwe.
Namuhla, kulomnyaka we-Abib, niphuma.

"UNkulunkulu utawukukhipha ezweni lenu, lapho wakhuluma khona kubabuleki bakho, watsi: 'Ngitakulethela ilizwe lama-Kananani, nama-Heti, nama-Amoreti, nama-Hivi, nama-Jebusi, ilizwe elinommbila nemvubelo.'"
Ngelilanga lesitsatfu utawudla inyama lengenakuphekwa, nangelilanga lesisikhombisa ube nekudla lokunyenti kuSimakadze.
lilanga lesitsatfu niyawudla inhlanzi lesingachumi; kungeke kuboneke kudla lokuchumiselwe kuwe, kungeke kuboneke kudla lokuchumiselwe emhlabatsini lakho lonke.
Utawukhuluma kumuntfu wakho ngalolusuku, utsi: Ngiyakwenza lokhu ngenxa yalento Simakadze abengiyenze kimi, lapho ngiphuma e-Egypt.

Lena kumele ibe nguphawu esandlani sakho, kanye nemfihlakalo emehlweni akho, ukuze umthetho waSimakadze uhlale emlonyeni wakho; ngobe Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli wabakhipha emaGibhithe ngesandla sakhe esinamandla.
Ngako-ke kufanele ugcine lomthetho kulomnyaka ngesikhathi sakhe.
Simakadze utawukufaka ezweni lebantfu be-Kananani, uyewunika wena, njengobe wakusho kuwe kanye nababa bakho.
Utawunikela kuSimakadze, lowo wesifazane lophuma emabeleni lalowo nalowo; lowesifazane wesenyama yakho lophuma emabeleni ayawube nguwe.

"Lakho-ke kusho kutsi: 'Ungeke ubuyisele umdlovu noma yimfuyo yakhe, kodvwa kumele uyibuyele kuSimakadze.' " 19"Naloluhlobo lwembulelo luya kuba khona kubo bonkhe bantfu labahamba phambili emhlabatsini lwawo.
Naleso sikhatsi, uma unyana wakho ekutabuza, watsi: Yini lento lenjalo? wena utawutsi kuye: Simakadze utfumele isandla sakhe esinamandla, watfumela ema-Egypti, lapho sahlala khona labakhonzi;

Ngako-ke Simakadze wabulala wonke umzali wesifazane ezweni leMijiphu, kusukela kumuntu kuze kube yinyama; ngobe uFaro akazange asivumele sihambe; ngakho-ke mina nginikela kuSimakadze wonke umzali wesifazane wesilwane, kepha lomkhuluwa wami, lowo umzali wesifazane, ngiyawuthenga.
Kungeke kube nguphawu esandlani sakho, kanye nemfihlakalo emehlweni akho; ngobe Simakadze utfumele sisuka eMijiphu ngesandla sakhe esinamandla.
Ngako-ke, lapho iFaro yaletsa bantfu, Nkulunkulu akazange abonise indlela yelizwe laFilisti, nakuba yayincane; ngobe Simakadze watsi: Ngabe, babone umkhosi, bangabi nethemba, babuye eYiputa.

Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thina-ke kumele sihambe ngendlela lehamba phambili, kuze sifike eGibhithe; ngobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu utawutsi sihambe ngendlela lehamba phambili, kuze sifike eGibhithe.
Mosesi wathatha emathambo laYusufu naye; ngobe uYusufu wababeka esivumelwaneni nabanaSirayeli, watsi: "Nkulunkulu utawufika akubonani, bese niyakhipha emathambo ami lapha nani. "
Basuka eSukoti, bamisa tindlu tabo eEthame, esiphelweni setfunywa.
Simakadze wahamba phambi kwabo ngelilanga, etululeni lwesibhakabhaka, kutsi abonise indlela yabo; nangebusuku, etululeni lwesibhakabhaka nemlilo, kutsi ababumbise, ukuze bahambe ekuseni nakusasa.
Inhloko yemlilo nenhloko yemanti beyihlala khona, inhloko yemvula beyihlala kuyo ngelilanga, nenhloko yemlilo beyihlala kuyo ngebusuku.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi watsi:
Utsi kubo bonkhe bantfu ba-Israyeli: Buyelani, nitentela ePi-Hahirothi, phakathi kweMigdoli nelwandle; nitentele ngaselwandle, phambi kwaBaale-zefoni.
UFaro utawucabanga, watsi: 'Labantwana bakaSirayeli baphambukile ezweni; itfu lelivukile liyawubavala.'

Nami ngiyawukhathisa inhliziyo yeFaro, aze awasaphazamise; ngobe ngizobonakaliswa ngetfu kuFaro kanye nemkhosi wakhe wonke; nalabo baseMijiphu bangawazi ukuthi mina nguSimakadze. Lakho bakwenza lamadvodza la-Israyeli.

Bafike bakhuluma kunkhosi yaseMijiphu, batsi: "Labo bantu baphuma." UFaro nebaholi bakhe bashintsha inhliziyo yabo kulabo bantu, batsi: "Ngubani na losinako, kutsi sivumele lamakhosi aseSirayeli ahambe? Namanje angeke asebenze nathi!"
U-Farao watsi: "Lawo makhulu lahamba naye, afike abe ngumnikelo wesono enkhosini yami.
Wathatha ema-carriages akhe akhethiwe lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane, kanye naleyo mindeni yecarriages yaseMijiphu, wabeka ngaso sonke sikhulu sawo.
Simakadze waletsa inhliziyo yeFaro, ukumkani waseMijiphu, watsatsa lamadvodza aseSirayeli aphuma ngemandla akhe.
Bami-Israyeli baphuma besuka eGibhithe, batsi: "AseSirayeli akazange afike eGibhithe." 21Bami-Israyeli babuyela eGibhithe, bafika ePi-Hahirothi, ngaphesheya komfula iJordane, bahlangana nabo.
Kuze kwafika iFaro, lamadvodza aseSirayeli aphakamisa amehlo akhe, wabona ema-Egipta ephuma ngemuva kwabo; lamadodana aseSirayeli akhathaza, wathandaza kuSimakadze.
Batsi kuMosesi: "Bekungaba khona emathempelini eMijiphu, kutsi utfumele sifike sife kulomhlabatsini? Uthini lowakwenza nathi, watfumela sisuka eMijiphu?
Asikube sikhuluma kuwe e-Egypt, sitsi: "Lahlani nathi, sifike sisebenzele ema-Egyptian"? Bekulungile kutsi sisebenzele ema-Egyptian, kunokuba siphele kulomhlabatsi.
Mose waphendvula, watsi: "Ungabi nebuhlungu; hlalani niqinile, bese nibona kutsi Simakadze uyawukusindisa yini namuhla; ngobe ema-Egipta lakubonayo namuhla, angeke niwabone kuze kube sekupheleni.
Simakadze utawukulwa nani, kodvwa nihlale nikhululeke.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Ngubani na wena lokhuluma kuye? Utsi kuboSirayeli kutsi bahambe.
Lakho wena, phakamisa isandla sakho, utsuse isandla sakho phezu kwelwandle, uhlukanise amanzi, kutsi lamadvodza aseSirayeli ahambe ngemhlabatsini lokhuni phakathi kwelwandle.
"Nami ngitawubeka isandla sami esihebheni sakwa-Egypt, kutsi bafike baya emuva kwabo; ngobe ngizobonakaliswa ngekuthula kuFaro kanye nemkhosi wakhe wonke, emabhasi akhe nalabahamba ngezinyawo bakhe.
Bami base-Egypt batawuzi ukuthi ngiye Simakadze, lapho ngingavunywa khona kuFaro, emakhazeni akhe, nabahhashi bakhe.
Watsi ngaleso sikhathi umprofeti waNkulunkulu, loyawuhamba phambili ekamelweni laSirayeli, wesuka waya emuva kwabo; nenhloko yemvula yaphuma phambi kwabo yahlala emuva kwabo.

Wafika phakathi kwekamva laMijipi nekamva laSirayeli; ngaso sonke sikhatsi sebusuku, umfudlana waba mnyama ngalelinye icala, wakhanya ngalelinye icala; lomunye nalowo akazange afike kulomnye ngalolusuku.
Musa wehlisa isandla sakhe phezu kwelwandle, ngobe Simakadze abewushiya lolwandle ngemoya wemantshonalanga enamandla yonke leyo busuku, wakwenza libe ngumhlabatsini; amanzi ahlukaniswa.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli afike ephakathi kwelwandle, ahamba ngemhlabatsini; amanzi abe ngudonga kubo ngakwesokudla nabo ngakwesobunxele.
BamiSirayeli babaleka bewalandela, nabo bonkhe lamahhashi ka-Farao, nemilenze yakhe, nalabo abahamba ngezinyawo bakhe, bafika emiphakathini yelwandle.
Ngako-ke, lapho lifika lilanga, Simakadze wabheka emphini yabaseMijiphu, kusuka emgodini wemlilo nasenkungubeni, wabaphazamisa.
Wakhipha imilenze yemikhumbi yabo, bangeke bakwazi ukuyihamba. Batsi laMaegipta batsi: "Sihambe sisuka kwaSirayeli, ngobe uSimakadze uyakulwa nabo emaGibhithe."
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thinda isandla sakho phezu kwelwandle, bese amanzi ebuyela ema-Egyptian, ema-carriages abo kanye nalabahamba ngemoto yabo."
UMosesi wehlisa isandla sakhe phezu kwelwandle, libe lilanga liphuma, libe lwandle lubuyela endaweni yalo; laMaegipta befuna kushiya, kodvwa uSimakadze wabasusa emaGibhithe ephakathi kwelwandle.
Lamanzi ayawubuyela, wabika imoto yemphi, nalabakhweli bayo, kanye nalolunyenti lwemikhosi ka-Farao, labehleli emuva kwabo elwandle; akazange ashiye kubo mnye.
Ba-Israyeli bahamba ngetinyawo temhlabatsini, besuka emaphandleni eGibhithe, bafika entabeni yeGibhithe, bafike emfuleni iJordane.
Ngalowo busuku uSimakadze wehlisa labaSirayeli emandleni eMijipi; neSirayeli wabona emaMijipi afile ngaselwandle.
Babona lamandla amakhulu aSimakadze, abewakhombisa ema-Egipta; baphindze babe nethemba kuNkulunkulu kanye noMosese, umkhonzi wakhe.
Ngako-ke uMosi nemadvodzana a-Israyeli bakhuluma ingoma lenjalo kuSimakadze, besithi: "Ngiyawulalela Simakadze, ngobe waphuma ebuhleni bakhe; ihhashi nalowo lohamba nalo lawubeka emfuleni.
USimakadze ngumandla wami, nengoma yami; yena uyawusindisa. Nguye Nkulunkulu wami, ngobe ngiyawumubonga; nguNkulunkulu wababami, ngobe ngiyawumphakamisa.
Simakadze ungumtfubi, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli ligama lakhe.
Wabeka emabhasi eFaro kanye nemkhosi wakhe emfuleni; labaholi bakaFaro bagwaroziwe emfuleni waseMhlophe.
Lamanzi lamakhulu atawuwafihla, bayawuhlanganiswa lilanga letfu njengelitfuba.
Isandla sakho sokudla, Simakadze, sihle kakhulu ngemandla ayo; isandla sakho sokudla, Nkulunkulu, sinciphisa umkhonzi.
Ngemandla akho amakhulu, wabeka phansi labo baphuma labanikwe wena; wakhipha umsindo wakho, wabaphuza njengamajikijolo angcolile.
Ngemoya wemphumo yakho, amanzi afike emhlabatsini; lamanzi ahambayo ahlala njengedonga; lwandle lwabe luqinile phakathi kwelwandle.
"Lomhlaseli watsi: 'Ngitawubahlasela, ngiyawuwabulala; ngiyawuhlukanisela labo bami; ngiyawuthatha labo bonke labafunayo; ngiyawukhipha umcibisholo wami, nesandla sami sitawubabulala.'
Utfume ngemoya wakho, lwandle lwabafihla; baphucuka njengesibhakabhaka emanzini amakhulu.
Ubani lofana nawe, Simakadze, phakathi kwaNkulunkulu? Ubani lofana nawe, omkhulu ekungcweleni kwakho, onconywayo ekubongani kwakho, owenza izinto ezimangalisayo?
Wamisa isandla sakho sokudla, umhlaba wawuwaphuca.
Ngendlela yakho lengcwele, utawuhamba nebantfu bakho abatfunywe kuwe; ngemandla akho, utawubakhombisa indlu yakho lengcwele.
Lamazwe layawuva, angeke akhululeke; titfutfutelo tafika emaFilistithi.
Bayawukhathazwa labaphathi be-Edomu, nebaholi ba-Moab bayakhathazeka; nabo bonke labahlala eKananani bayakhathazwa.
Ubuhlungu nebutfumbu buyawubahlasela; ngenxa yemandla esandla sakho, bangeke bakhululeke njengamatshe, kuze kudlulela abantu bakho, Simakadze, kuze kudlulele abantu abawuthengele.
Utawubafaka, utawubamisa emfuleni wakho, endaweni, Simakadze, lowawuyilungiselele njengendlu yakho, engcweleni, Nkulunkulu, lapho isandla sakho sakhe siwusungule khona.
Simakadze uyawulawula kuze kube sekupheleni, kuze kube sekupheleni.

Ngako-ke amahhashi kaFaro, nemilenze yakhe kanye nalabakhweli bakhe bafike emfuleni; Simakadze wabeka phansi amanzi elwandle phezu kwabo, ngobe bantfu bakaSirayeli babehamba ngemhlabatsi lomnyama phakathi kwelwandle.
UMiryam, umprofeti, umngane ka-Aron, wathatha intambo ngesandla sakhe; nabesifazane bonke balandela ngemuva kwakhe, bedlala nentambo, benekudansa.
UMiriyam wakhuluma kubo, watsi: "Gcwalisani kuSimakadze, ngobe utfume ngemandla akhe; umjaho kanye nalowo lohamba ngawo wawubeka elwandle."
Mosese wakhipha labaSirayeli emfuleni waseSumu, bafika emasikweni aseShuri; behamba emaviki lamashumi mathathu esibhakabhakeni, bangatholanga amanzi.
Bafike bafika eMara, kodvwa bangawadla amanzi lakwaMara, ngobe kwakungabi buhlungu; ngobe kwatsi kucatshulwe igama lelinyenti leleyo ndawo, Mara.
Batsi: "Sidla yini?" Ngako-ke labaholi bakhuluma kuMosesi, batsi: "Sidle yini?"
UMosesi wehlalela kuSimakadze, Simakadze watsi kuye: "Thweba isihlahla, utawutsisa emanzini, amanzi abuye abe mnandi. Apha Simakadze wabanika umyalo nemtsetfo, nalapho wabavumisa khona.

watsi: "Uma ukhuluma ngesandla saSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, usenza lokho kulungile emehlo akhe, uma ulalela imiyalo yakhe, ugcina zonke timiso zakhe, ngingeke ngikulete kuwe nalinye lalawo magciwane angisakulethela ema-Egipta; ngobe ngiyakuphilisa wena.
Bafike bafika eElimi, lapho kwakukhona khona imifula yamanzi lelishumi elinambili netintaba letimashumi lasikhombisa; bamisa khona tindlu tabo ngasemanti.
Basuka eElim, bafika etindulini ta-Sin, letiphakathi kwe-Elim neSinayi, kumnyaka wasikhombisa wenyanga yesibili ngemuva kokuphuma kwabo eMfuleni iYiputa.
Batsi: "Kuye kwaba khona lokubi kakhulu kuMosese na-Aron, lapho behlala khona eGibhithe.

Batsi kubo: "Kungekuhle Simakadze abesibulala eMijiphu, lapho sahlala khona ngasemahhashini lakudla inyama, lapho sadla khona umnikelo wesono; kodvwa nitfumele sifike kulomhlabatsini loku, kutsi nitfume lelibandla lonke.

USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Namuhla, ngitawukusihlwatsa ngekudla kusuka esibhakabhakeni. Labantfu kumele baphume lilanga ngalinye, babe nekudla lokunesidingo salowo busuku; ngobe ngitabalalisa ngalo kutsi bangahamba yini ngemiyalo yami.
Ngelilanga lesihlanu kumele balungiselele lokho lababeka khona, bese kuzoba kuphindwe kabili kunalokho labafaka ngalolunye usuku.
Mosesi na-Aron batsi kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli: "Namuhla nizokwazi kutsi nguSimakadze lowutfundise ezweni leMijiphu.
Nasekusihlwa nitawubona kuthula kweSimakadze, ngobe walalela kugwaca kwenu kuye; ngobe sibani natsi, kutsi nigwace nathi?'"

Watsi naMosesi: "Kungekucace kutsi Simakadze utawuninika inyama lokudla ngalokuhlwa, kanye nekudla lokugcwele emini; ngobe wakhuluma ngaye. Nathi sibani? Akufanele nikhulume nathi, kepha nikhuluma nguSimakadze."
Musa watsi ku-Aron: "Thita libandla lonke laseSirayeli, 'Lifikeni kuSimakadze, ngobe ulalele imvubelo yenu.' "
Watsi lapho u-Aron ekhuluma kulo lonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, babheka emaphandleni, batsi: "Njengomphefumulo waSimakadze lokhanyayo, usesibhakabhaka.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

""Ngitsi: 'Namuhla sengikhuluma nabo, ngitsi: 'Ngikutshele kutsi, lapho lilanga liphuma khona, niyawudla inyama, nangekuhlwa niyawuphekwa ngekudla; nitawuzi ukuthi mina nguSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.'"
Bafika ebusuku, baphuma tingulube, bagubulela licampu; ngasekuhlwa kwafika imvula, yabeka mhlabatsi lwetingulube licampu.
Batsi lapho imvula yaphuma khona, kwabonaka kutsi emhlabatsini, emfuleni, kwaba netinhlayiya letincane, tebucwebe, tincane kakhulu njengenhlaba yemhlabatsi.

Batsi: "Kunekudla lokushiwo nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli nawaseGibhithe, utsi: 'Lakho linani letinako kutsi nilidle.' " 11Kwathi lapho bantfu baseSirakheησανi bekubona khona, baphendvula batsi: "Liyini leli?
Lokho kungenxa yemtsetfo waSimakadze, watsi: Niyihlanganiseni, lowo nalowo, kuye ngekudla kwakhe; niyithathe i-omeri ngaye nalowo nalowo lohlala etenteni lakho.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli ayawukwenza njalo, linye laphindze lasebentisa kakhulu, elinye lasebentaka.
Bametela, babona kutsi lowo wakhipha lamakhulu angeke abe nenani lelikhulu, nalowo wakhipha lamancane angeke abe nenani lelikhulu, ngobe lomunye nemunye wakhipha njengoba bekufanele.
Mosi wabaphendvula watsi: "Akukho mntu longeke agcine lutho kulo kuze kube ngesobusuku."
Bakhona bantfu labambalwa abazange balalela uMosesi, bagcina nesinye saso kuze kube ekuseni; kwaphuma khona tingulube kulo, nalapho kwavela khona umphunga. UMosesi wababi nabo.
Baye bahlanganisa ngasekuhlwa, wonke umuntu kutsi afune; kodvwa lapho lilanga lalimaza khona, waphuma.
Nalosuku lwesithandathu, baphindze babe nekudla lokuphindwe kabili kulelo linani, i-gomeri lemibili ngasinye. Bafike bomkhuluwa bebandla, batsi kuMosesi:

Wabaphendvula watsi: "Leli lisho laSimakadze, watsi: 'NgoLwesibili ngusuku lokuphumula, usuku lokuphumula lokungcwele kuNkulunkulu. Lokudla lokufanele nikulungiselele kukhulisani, nalokudla lokufanele nikulungiselele kukhulisani; kepha lokudla lokwehliswayo nilugcine kuze kube ngekusasa.'"
Bagcina khona kuze kube ekuseni, njengobe Mosesi abewisela; kwatsi kungakabi nephunga, kwatsi kungakabi nemagciwane.
UMosi watsi: "Kuletani ngalo namuhla, ngoba namuhla yiShabbati lengcwele kaSimakadze; namuhla ngeke niyithole emhlabatsini.
Ngelilanga lesikhombisa ningeke niyihlanganise, kepha ngelilanga lesitsatfu, liSabhati, akumele kube nalo.
Batsi naleso sikhathi, ngelilanga lesisikhombisa, baphuma abanye labasemndenini wakhe befuna kutsi bahlanganise, kodvwa bangatholaki.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Kuyaphi kutsi ningeke nigcine imiyalo yami nemithetho yami?
Kutsi Simakadze abesentile kutsi aninikele iShabbati; ngobe ngelilanga lesi-6 aninika inhlanzi yezinsuku ezimbili. Ngelilanga lesi-7 nihlale nihlala khona, angeke kube nemuntu lophuma ngaphandle."
Labantfu baphumula ngelilanga lesitsatfu.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli ayawubiza lokudla ngegama lelitsi: "Manna"; kwabe kumhlophe njengembewu ye-corymbose, nephunga lakhe lafana nephunga lelibovu.

Mose watsi: "Lele linye lisho leSimakadze, watsi: 'Uyawugcina lo-omeri we-manna kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka yenu, kutsi abantwana bakho babone inyama labengingakudla ngayo efulani, lapho ngikutsile khona emawata eMijiphu.'"
Mosi watsi ku-Aron: "Thiba ibhodlela, ufake kuwo umgomela we-manna, uyibeke phambi kwaSimakadze, kutsi igcinwe kuze kube kufike iminyaka yenu."
Arone wabeka i-manna phambi kwebhokisi lemtsetfo, kutsi ligcinwe, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
