Labantwana baka-Israyeli badla lemana iminyaka lengema-40, kuze kube befika ezweni labahlala kulo; badla lemana kuze babefike emgwaqeni wemhlaba waseKanana.
I-omeri ilingana nengxenye lelishumi yeefa.

Basuka khona bonke bantfu ba-Israyeli, besuka emfuleni iSin, behamba ngendlela yabo, njengobe Simakadze abewisela umthetho ngayo; bamisa tindlu zabo eRefidim, lapho kwakungaba khona amanzi lamakhosikazi abo angadla kuwo.
Baze baphikisana naMosesi, batsi: "Ninise amanzi kutsi siphuze." UMosi watsi kubo: "Njani nikhuluma nami? Njani niyembisana noSimakadze?"
Batsi baphuma eGibhithe, batsi: "Ngubani na loyawutfumisa ema-Egipta? Ufuna yini kutsi sife nezingane zethu kanye nemfuyo yethu ngesifo sendlala?"
Mozesi watsi kuSimakadze, watsi: "Ngubani longeke ngiyawukwenza nalaba bantu, ngobe bahlala bengishaya ngetinyawo?
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thinda phambi kwalabo bantu, uthathe nawe labaholi bakaSirayeli; nesandla sakho lesitfusa iNfula sifike esandla sakho, uyeke.
Hlala, ngiya kuhlala khona phambi kwakho ngase-Horebhi; bese ushaya inhloko yemlilo, kuze kuphume amanzi kuyo, kutsi bantfu baphuze.' UMosesi wakwenza njalo emehlo labaholi beSirayeli.

Wayibiza lendawo igama elithi Massa, negama elithi Meriba, ngenxa yemphiko yalabaSirayeli, naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme lapho betiwa khona nguSimakadze, batsi: "UNkulunkulu uphakathi kwethu yini, noma akunjalo?"
Bafike bahlasela bantfu beSirayeli eRefidim.
Musa watsi kuYoshuwa: "Khetha lamadoda, ufike ube nekulwa na-Amaleki; ngiya kuhlala ngasekupheleni kwesitembu, nginesandla saNkulunkulu esandla sami."
UJoshua wakwenza njengobe uMosi akazange akhulume naye, waba nekulwa na-Amaleki; kodvwa uMosese na-Aron na-Hure bafike esiphelweni semhlabatsi.
Nalapho Mose ephakamisa khona isandla sakhe, labaSirayeli bayawuphumelela; kodvwa lapho akhipha khona isandla sakhe, labaAmaleki babeyawuphumelela.

Batsi, lapho imilenze kaMosesi ihlupheka khona, bathatha intaba, bayibeka ngaphansi kwakhe, wahlala phezu kwayo; uAron naHure babesekela imilenze yakhe, lomunye ngalelinye icala, nomunye ngalelinye icala. Ngaleyo ndlela imilenze yakhe yahlala iqinile kuze kuphume lizulu.
UJoshua wahlasela ibutfo la-Amaleki ngesandla sakhe.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Bhala lesi sigameko encwadini, kutsi sihlale sitsiwe, bese ukhuluma ngaso kuJoshua; ngobe ngitawucisha lilanga lekukhumbula kwa-Amaleki ngaphansi kwezulu."
Mosesi wakwakha ithempeli, watsi kulelo: "Simakadze ngusibhakabhaka sami."
Watsi: "Simakadze ukhuluma, Simakadze uzoba nekulwa na-Amaleki kuze kube yiminyaka leminingi."
Jethro, umLevi waseMidiyani, loyise waMosese, wava zonke izinto letibekiwe nguNkulunkulu kuMosese nebantfu bakhe baseSirayeli, kutsi Simakadze abewukhuphula lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli eYiputa.
Mosesi waletsa uSipora, indodana yakhe, waya ekhaya lakhe, kodvwa Jethro, umsa wakhe-ke, wamthatha.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu labalishumi nalabahlanu, kanye nemadvodzana akhe lamibili; watsi: "Igama lomunye nguGershoni," ngobe watsi: "Ngibe ngumhlali ezweni lelingelilo."
Igama lomunye lakunguEliyezeri, ngobe watsi: "Nkulunkulu wababami wawungusizo lwami, wangivikela ekuhlaselweni nguFarao."
Jethro, umkakhe uMosese, wafika kuMosese esidlweni setfu, naye nendvodzakati yakhe nabantwana bakhe; ngobe Mosese abesesiteji lakhe emfuleni waNkulunkulu.
UJethro wathumela kuMosi, watsi: "Mine, uJethro, umyeni wakho-ke, ngiya kuwe, kanye nendvodzakati yakho nabantwana bayo bobabili."
UMosese wehla wahlangana noyise wakhe, wehlisa isandla sakhe, wamcokola; bakhuluma nabo, bafika etenteni.

UMosese wakhuluma kuyise wesifazane wakhe zonke izinto labezenza uSimakadze kuFaro kanye nabaseMijiphu, ngenxa yalabaSirayeli; nezinto zonke ezibuhlungu abebabhekene nazo ngendlela, nokuthi Simakadze wabasindise.
Jethro wakhululeka kakhulu, lapho ekhuluma ngayo yonke lento enhle loNkulunkulu abeyenza kuSirayeli, kutsi wabakhulula ema-Egipta.
Watsi Jethro: "Lula uSimakadze, lowo wakutsile ema-Egipta neFaro; lowo wakutsile laba bantu ngaphansi kwesandla sama-Egipta.
Namuhla ngiyazi kutsi uSimakadze umkhulu kunabo bonke labangcwele, ngenxa yalento ayenze kulabo labaseSirayeli labebaphikisa.

Jethro, umyeni wakhe uMosesi, wanikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kanye neminikelo yekushiswa kuNkulunkulu. Wafika na-Aharonu kanye nabo bonkhe labaholi beSirayeli, badla inyama nomkakhe uMosesi phambi kwaSimakadze.
Kutsi kube ngekusasa, Musa wahlala enkantolo yebantfu; ngobe bantfu babekhona phambi kwakhe kusukela ngasemini kuya emveni.

Wabona uyise-ke waMosesi konkhe lokwentako kubo bonkhe bantfu, watsi kuye: "Ngubani na wena lokwenzako nabo bonkhe bantfu? Kungani uhlala wena kuphela utsi ungummeli, kodvwa bonke laba bantu bakhona phambi kwakho kusukela emini kuya emveni?"
Mosesi watsi kuye: "Lebantfu bafika kungibuza, batsi: 'UNkulunkulu uyini?'
Nakwesiphi simo lapho bekhona khona inkinga, bafika kungi, ngobe ngitsi: 'Kulungile.' Ngabafundisa nemithetho kanye nemtsetfo waNkulunkulu.
Wati kuye umyeni wakhe, "Kungeke kube kahle lokho lokwenzayo.
Lakho kungenxa yakho, kanye nalabo labafika kuwe; lemisebenzi inzima kakhulu kuwe, awungeke uyifeze wena kuphela.
Lakho-ke, khuluma nami, ngitakulethela umyalo wakho; Nkulunkulu abe nawe; wena utawukhuluma ngebantfu phambi kwaNkulunkulu, uyawufikela kuye izinkinga zabo.
Bafundise imiyalo yakhe kanye nemtsetfo wakhe, ubabonise indlela labafanele kutsi bahambe ngayo, nemisebenzi yabo labafanele ukuba bayisebenze.

Lakho-ke ukhethe kubo bonke bantfu lamadoda anamandla, elalelayo kuNkulunkulu, abethembekile, abonakele ekuthatheni inhlawulo; uwabeke phezu kwalabo bantu njengabaphathi bamakhulu kanye namashumi lamabili nesihlanu namakhulu.

Labavumeleni kutsi bagweme ticala tebantfu nsuku zonke. Ticala letinzima bangakufikela wena, kepha ticala letilula bangatiphelisa bobabili. Lokhu kutawukususa umthwalo wakho, ngobe bazowuhlanganisa nawe.
Uma ukwenza lokhu, nome Nkulunkulu akusho kuwe, ungeke ube nenkinga, kodvwa laba bantu bonke bayawubuyela ekhaya babo bakhululeke.
Mosesi walalela lomfati wakhe, wakwenza konke lokuye watsi.
Wakhetha lamadoda anamandla kuwo wonke laSirayeli, wababeka njengenhloko yebantfu, abe ngabaholi bamakhulu, namakhulu lamakhulu, namashumi lamakhulu, namashumi lamakhulu.
Bebahlulela abantu nsuku zonke; lemacala anzima bewafaka kuMosese, kepha labo lamancane babeyawuwalungisa bobabili.
UMosi wehlalela uyise-ke, watsi: "Uyahamba; Jethro wabuyela ezweni lakhe."
Ngomnyaka wesithathu ngemuva kokuphuma kwabo eMfuleni i-Egipta, ngalolusuku lolunye bafike esigabeni seSinayi.
Basuka eRefidim, bafika esigabeni seSinayi; bantfu baseSirayeli bamisa tindlu tabo khona esigabeni, ngasemliloni.
UMosese wehla kuSimakadze, Simakadze watsi kuye kusuka emfuleni, watsi: "Ngikukhuluma lokhu emndenini waYakobi, ngikukhulume kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli:
Nibone kutsi ngikwenze yini ema-Egipta, nibona kutsi nganifaka kanjani emilenzeni yengulube, nami sengikulethela.
Ngako-ke, uma nikhuluma ngami ngeqiniso, nigcina umhlangano wami, khona-ke niyawuba ngumnikelo wami wesono phakathi kwazo tonkhe titfunywa; ngobe umhlaba wonke uyini wami.
kodvwa niyawuba bukhosi bami, nebantfu labangcwele. Lokho kulombhalo lowukhuluma kuboSirayeli.' "
Wabuyela uMosese, wahlangana nebaholi bebandla, wabakhuluma kubo yonke lemigaqo Simakadze abemwisele yona.
Labantfu bonke baphendula bobabili, batsi: "Lokho Simakadze akushoyo sonke siyawukwenza." UMosese waveza kuSimakadze impendulo yabantu.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Ngitafika kuwe ekungcotweni kwelanga, kutsi abantu bakhulume nawe, bakubonane nawe nsuku zonke." UMosi wakhuluma kuSimakadze ngemazwi labantu, watsi:
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Hamba ufike kubo bonkhe bantfu, ubangcwele namuhla nekusasa, bahlanze tigqoko tabo,
Nibe sebenekahleni kuze kube ngumhla wesithathu, ngobe ngalolusuku Simakadze utawuphuma phambi kwamehlo labantfu bonkhe eMfuleni iSinayi.

"Lamuhla-ke, ngitsi kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli: "Thintela bantfu kutsi babeke umkhawulo premfula, bese ukhuluma kubo utsi: 'Gcwalisani, ningase nifike emfuleni, noma ningase niwucoce; lowo lowucoca lomfula kumele abulawa.

Angeke kube khona lowo muntu, ngobe kumele ahlaselwe ngemlilo, noma abe nemphiko; ngabe ngumuntu, noma ngabe yinyama, ngeke ihlale iphila. Ngaleso sikhathi lapho kuphucuka khona umsindo lomkhulu, bayawufika emfuleni.
Mosese waphuma emfuleni waya kubantfu, wabangcwele kubo, bahlamba tiingubo zabo.
Watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu: "Benilungiselele ngelilanga lesithathu; ningaba nendoda.

Kuye kwenzeka ngelilanga lesithathu, ngasekuqaleni kwebusuku, kwafika umfutho nemlilo, kanye nemvula encane emfuleni, nakusikhashana kwaphuma umsindo lomkhulu kakhulu wemphimbo; bonke labo labasemgwaqeni batfusa.
Mosese watsi kubo: "Ngubani na loyawuphuma kulo mhlambi, ngobe Simakadze utawuwukhipha emhlabatsini, ube nguSimakadze.
Umfula iSinayi waba nephunga, ngobe Simakadze abewuphumile kuwo ngemlilo; nephunga lakhe lafika phezulu njengephunga lefundza, umfula wonke wehla wajika.
Nalo livi lelibomvu laliba lukhulu kakhulu; Mozesi wakhuluma, Nkulunkulu wamphendvula watsi: "Njengomsindo wemlilo."
Simakadze wehla ekugcineni komfula i-Sinai, watsi kuMosesi: "Thina sifike ekupheleni komfula," waphuma uMosi.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thela, utshele bantfu ukuthi bangabi nenkinga yekutsi bafike babone Nkulunkulu; ngobe labaningi kubo bangafa.
Nalabangcwele, labafikela kuSimakadze, kumele bahlale bengcwele, ngobe Simakadze angeke abe nenkinga nabo.
Mosi watsi kuSimakadze: "Abantu bangasakhuphuka emfuleni iSinayi, ngoba wena utsi usinike bufakazi, utsi: 'Thintela umkhawulo emfuleni, ube ngungcwele kuwo.'"
USimakadze watsi kuye: "Thatha u-Aron nawe, uye phezulu nawe; kepha labaLevi nabaholi babantu kumele bangabi nekhono lokuya kuSimakadze, ngobe angeke abophelela kubo."
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thina-ke sifike enkhosini.
Simakadze wakhuluma onkhe lamagama, watsi:
Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, lowo watfumisa ezweni la-Egypti, kutsi ungeke ube ngumkhonzi.
Angeke ube nabanye bonkulunkulu ngaphandle kwami.
"Ungeke wenze kuwe igolide, noma yini efana nayo, noma yini lekhona emazulu phezulu, noma yini lekhona emhlabeni phansi, noma yini lekhona emanzini ngaphansi kwemhlaba.

Ungeke uzivelele, ungabambisene nabo; ngobe ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, Nkulunkulu wema-Egipta, lobeka isono semadvodzana nemadvodzakati abo, kuze kube ngumnyaka wesithathu kanye nomnyaka wesithupha walelabo labanganikeli.
Nami ngibonisa uthando kulabo labamithanda, nalabo labagcina imiyalo yami, kuze kufike emashumini lamakhulu.
Ungeke usebenzise igama laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ngecala; ngobe Simakadze angeke amvumele lokhuluma igama lakhe ngecala.
Khumbula lilanga leSabhati, ugcine lingcwele.
Nine lilanga lesikhombisa nisebenze, niyenze yonke imisebenzi yenu.

kodwa usuku lwesine ngusuku lokuphumula kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho; ungasebenzisi umsebenzi nhlobo, wena, noma unyana wakho, noma intombi yakho, noma umkhonzi wakho, noma indvodzakati yakho, noma inkomo yakho, noma silwane sakho, noma lowo mhlali wasendlini yakho.

ngobe ngezinsuku letesikhombisa uSimakadze wehlele izulu, nemhlaba, nelwandle, naleyo yonke into ekhona kuwo, waphumula ngosuku lwesine; ngakho-ke uSimakadze wabambisa usuku lweSabhati, watsi lungcwele.
Hlala ubaba wakho nomama wakho, ukuze uhlale uhlala isikhathi eside emhlabatsini loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho utawukunika lona.
Ungabulalanga.
Ungeke ube necala lokubi.
Ungagcobi.
Ungatsi lutho lokubi ngemunye wakho enkantolo.

"Ungeke ufune indlu yenkosi yakho, ungeke ufune indodana yenkhosi yakho, noma umkhonzi wayo, noma indvodzakati yakhe, noma inkomo yakhe, noma idlelo lakhe, noma yini nayinye leyinikwe ngumkhonzi wakho."
Batsi nabo bonkhe bantfu bakubona umsindo, nebucwebe, nemandla emlilo, kanye nemfula lowufuthayo, bakhatsazeka kakhulu, bahlala kude.
Batsi kuMosesi: "Ukhuluma nathi, siyawukulalela; kepha uNkulunkulu angeke akhulume nathi, ngobe sitawufa."
UMosesi watsi kubo: "Hambani nize, ngobe uNkulunkulu wafika kutsi akufuneni kwenu, nalapho kuyawuhlala khona umfutho wakhe emehlo enu, ukuze ningabi nebubi.
Labantfu bahlala eduze, kodvwa Mose wafika kuleyo mthunzi lapho Simakadze abekhona khona.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Uyawutsi kuboSirayeli, 'Nibone ngemehlo enu ukuthi ngikhuluma nani kusuka esibhakabhakeni.
Ungeke uphindze ube nebantfu labafana naSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.

Uyawungilungisa ithempeli lemhlabatsini, uyawunikela khona ngeminikelo yakho yokushiswa, nemnikelo wakho wesono, nemfuyo yakho, nengulube yakho; lapho ngitawubeka khona igama lami, ngiya kuwe, ngikubambise.
Ungeke ufike nemilenze yakho enhliziyweni yami, kutsi ibuso bakho buboneke kuyo.
Lolu mthetho utawuwubeka phambi kwalabo bantu:
Uma uthenga umkhonto waseHebhere, kumele asebenze iminyaka lesikhombisa; kepha kumnyaka wesitsatfu kufanele aphume ekhululekile, ngaphandle kwemali.
Uma efika lomunye, kumele ahambe linye; noma uma abe nendvodza yakhe lapho efika khona, kufanele ahambe naye.
Uma umphathi wakhe atawunika indodana yakhe, bese lendoda idzala ngemadvodzana nemadvodzakati, khona-ke indodana nayo nemadvodzana ayo kumele ibe ngumsebenti waSimakadze; yena kuphela longeke aphume.
Kodwa uma umkhonzi ekhuluma kahle, watsi: "Ngiyawuthanda unkhosi yami, nendvodzakati yami, nabantwana bami; angeke ngikhululeke"
bese umnikazi wakhe ayawuwubeka phambi kwaSimakadze, atawuwubeka emnyango noma enhliziyweni yemnyango, aze avule ndlebe yakhe ngesandla sakhe, abe ngumkhonzi wakhe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Uma umuntu ethengisa letitukulwane sakhe kutsi ibe ngumkhonto, angeke aphume akhululeke njengabakhonti.

""Uma angeke ijabulise umnikazi wakhe, lowo loyawuhlala naye, khona-ke kumele avumele kutsi abuye athengiswe; ngeke abe nelungelo lokumthengisa ebantwaneni bangaphandle, ngobe utawuwuphula umthetho wakhe.
Uma ekhetha yena kutsi abe ngumntwana wakhe, kufanele ahambe naye njengendvodzakati.
"Uma eshada nendvodza leyinye, angeke athathe kuleyo yekucala ukudla kwayo, nemgqomo yayo, namalungelo ayo njengenkhosi.
Uma angeke amnike lezi zinto ezintathu, yena angaphuma ekhululekile ngaphandle kwekukhokha imali.
Wonke lowo lobulala umuntu, kumele agwenywe.
kodvwa uma angeke abe nalo, ngobe Nkulunkulu abewuvumele, khona-ke kumele ahambe afike lapho ngikukhethela khona.
Wonke lowo lobulala ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe kumele abulawa.
Wonke lowo lobulala omunye umuntu kumele agwenywe, noma ngabe wathengisa lomuntu nome uhlala naye.
Lomuntfu loyala ubaba wakhe noma umtfubi wakhe, kumele abulawa.
Kutsi ngabe amadoda lamibili ehlaselana, bese lomunye ebulala lowo wesifazane ngemlilo noma ngemphimbo yakhe. Lowo mkhwenyana akafa, kepha kumele ahlale ebhedini.

"Kungenjalo, uma lomuntfu aphuma emnyango wendlu yakhe bese ehamba ngaphandle ngesandla sakhe, lowo muntu labewudlwengula ungeke abe necala; kodvwa kumele amkhokhele umkhwenyana imali yexesha lakhe lelihlanganisiwe, naye kufanele amukhathalele kuze kube sewuphilisiwe.
Uma umuntu eshaya umkhonto wakhe wesifazane noma wesifazane ngesandla sakhe, bese umkhonto wakhe wesilisa noma wesilisa ebulala khona, lomuntu kumele agwenywe.
Ngako-ke, uma umkhonto evuka ngemuva kwelilanga lelinye noma lembili, umnikazi wakhe angeke agwenywe, ngobe umkhonto uye.

Kutsi ngabe amadoda ahlasela nebulala indoda lekhulelwe, bese yena ebeletha ekuseni kakhulu, kepha kungeke kube khona lokubi kakhulu, lowo owayembulala kufanele akhokhele noma yini lowesifazane wakhe afuna, kanye nalabo bameli.
kepha uma kukhona lokubi kakhulu, kufanele uthathe kuphila ngekuphila,
mehlo ngemehlo, inwele ngeinwele, isandla ngesandla, inyawo ngenyawo,
mlilo ngemlilo, inhlalo ngeinhlalo, umgodzi ngeumgodzi.
Uma umuntu ebulala umkhonto wakhe, mfazi noma mfana, ngemehlo lakhe, bese ewususa, kufanele avumele umkhonto wakhe ahambe akhululeke, abe nemali yemehlo.
Uma ekhipha imilenze yomkhonto wakhe wesifazane noma wesifazane, kufanele avumele umkhonto wakhe ahambe akhululeke aze akhokhele imilene.
Kodwa-ke, uma umnikazi evunyelwa kukhokha imali, kufanele akhokhe noma yini leceliwe kutsi agcine impilo yakhe.
Lomthetho lofanayo usebenza uma inkunzi ihlasele umfana noma indodana.
Uma ingulube ihlasela umkhonto wesifazane noma wesifazane, umnikazi kumele akhokhele lomkhonto impahla yesiliva lemashumi lasitfupha, kanye nengulube kufanele icwecwe.
Kutsi ngabe umuntu uvula ifulegi, noma ufaka linye, kodvwa angeke livule, bese kuphuma khona inkunzi noma umkhwenyana.
Umnikazi wemhlabatsi kumele akhokhele lokulimala; kufanele akhokhise umnini wayo, nesilwane lesifile sibe sakhe.
Uma inkunzi yemuntu ibulala inkunzi yemunye umuntu, kumele bathengise inkunzi lephilayo bahlukanise imali yayo; kufanele bahlukanise nenyama lefile.

Kodwa-ke, uma wonke umuntu ecabanga kutsi lengulube ivame kuhlaselwa, futhi umnikazi wayo akazange ayigcine igcinwe talunge, umnikazi kufanele akhokhele, ngulawe ophilayo ngeleyo efile, kanye nesilwane esifile siyawuba sakhe.
"Uma umuntu ephuca ingulube, noma inkomo, bese uyibulala, nome uyithengisa, kumele abuyisele ingulube lesihlanu ngengulube, noma inkomo lesitfupha ngengulube.
Uma umdlavuza ehlaselwa efika ekhaya ngebusuku bese ebulalaka, lowo loyawumubulala angeke abe necala lokubulawa kwabantu.

"Lakho-ke, uma kwenzeka ngemuva kwekuvuka kwelanga, lowo umbulalayo ungeke abe ngumbulalayo; ngobe umkhweli kumele abuyisele lokudlwengulayo; kepha uma angeke abe nelutho, kufanele athengiswe abe ngumkhonto, aze akhokhelwe lokudlwengulayo.
"Uma isilwane lesicutshungulwe sifunwa siphila naye, noma ngabe yingulube, noma ngabe yidoli, noma ngabe ingulube, kumele abuyisele inhlawulo yaso.
Uma umuntu eshiya tilwane zakhe zidle emahlathini noma emvinini, bese esiyalela kutsi zidla emahlathini labanye, taluphi umsebenti kumele awukhokhele kusuka kumahlathi akhe noma emvini wakhe.
Uma mlilo uphuma uye wasakazeka emaqabunga e-thorn abe ngumphumela wekushiswa kwemifino, noma imifino lehlala ikhona, noma mhlaba wonke, lowo lovulele mlilo kumele akhokhe lokubi.

Uma umuntu enika umngane wakhe imali noma impahla kutsi agcine iphephile, futhi lemali noma impahla icutshungulwa endluni yomngane wakhe, locutshunguli, uma ehlaselwa, kumele abuyisele emuva inhlawulo yembili.
"Lakho-ke, uma umkhonzi angeke afunwe, lowo uyawufika enkantolo yenkhosi, aze abone ukuthi ngabe yena wathatha yini izinto talowo mkhonzi wakhe.

Nakwesiphi na simo sokubambisana, noma kube yingulube, noma ibe ngudlovukazi, noma ibe yinkomo, noma kube ngumgqomo, noma kube yini lelahlekile, lapho umuntu esho khona kutsi: 'Lento yami'; laba babini kumele babe necala labo phambi kwaSimakadze.
Uma umuntu enikela umngane wakhe ngedoli, nengulube, nemvu, noma yinye leminye isilwane kutsi ihlale nayo, ibe iyafa, noma iyidlwengula, noma ithathwa ngaphandle kwanoma ngubani lokubona,
lowo mkhonto kumele aphike phambi kwaSimakadze, kutsi akazange athathe impahla yomkhonto wakhe; umnikazi wakhe kufanele avume lokhu, akudingeki kukhokha.
Kodwa-ke, uma lesilwane sicutshungulwe kusuka kumngane wakhe, kufanele akhokhele umnikazi wayo.
Uma icutshungulwa ngenyama lemnyama, kumele afike abe nesivi sakhe njengebufakazi. Angeke akhokhe noma yini lapho icutshungulwa ngayo.
Uma umuntu efuna isilwane kusuka kumshayeli wakhe, bese sihlaselwa noma sifa lapho umnikazi angeke abe khona, kufanele akhokhe.
Uma umnikazi wesilwane abekhona, lowo okhokhelwa angeke akhokhe, kepha uma isilwane sakhuliswa, imali ekhokhwe kulowo lokhokhelwe iyagcobisa lokubi.
Uma umfana ekhuluma nendvodza lencane kutsi ihlangane naye, futhi yena angeke abe ngumkakhe, kumele akhokhele imali yenkosikazi wakhe aze akwati.
Uma ubaba wakhe ecela kutsi akwati kutsi abe naye, kufanele akhokhe imali legcwele yenkosikazi lekhokhelwa ngumfana.
Angeke uvumele indoda lekhuluma ngemanti ihlale.
Wonke lowo lokhuluma nesilwane kumele agwenywe.
Wonke lowo lonikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kulowo nalowo Nkulunkulu, ngaphandle kweSimakadze, kumele aphelelwe.
Umkhwenyana ungeke umkhonze, ngobe nibengumkhwenyana ezweni laseMijiphu.
Mna-ke, ungeke ube necala lokubi kudzimate noma kuyise.
Uma ukhuluma, bese bathandaza kuye, ngitawulalela lomthandazo wabo.
Nakho ngitawukubulala ngesandla sami, ngobe umsebenti wami awuzange uphele; bese lilanga lemikhosi yami liphuma, nabantwana bakho babuye babe ngumama.
Uma unikela ngemali kumunye webantfu bami, kutsi abe mnyama, angeke uhambe naye ngalendlela yebhizinisi; ngeke ubeke kuye itfu.
Uma uthatha ingubo yemndeni wakho, kutsi uyibuyisele kuwe, kufanele uyibuyisele kuye ngaphambi kokuba lilanga liphume.
Nalo libati lakhe, nalelo likati lakhe; ngobe libati lakhe kuphela lelimcamelako ebusweni bakhe; yini leyawuyihlala ngayo? Nalapho akhuluma ngami, ngitawumulalela, ngobe nginekuthula.
Ungeke ukhulume lutho lokubi kuNkulunkulu, nome ubeke livi lomholi webantfu bakho.
Ungeke ugcine umhlambi wakho, newayini lakho lesisha, namafutha akho; lomnyaka wesifazane wamadvodzakati akho kufanele unginike.
Nasetinkunzi takho naletingulube takho utawuzenza njalo; kumele zihlale ngelilanga lesishiyagalolunye emama abo, kuze kube ngumhla wesibhozo ungabanikela.
Nibe bantu bami abangcwele; ngobe ningeke nidle inyama yesilwane lesifile emhlabatsini, kodvwa niyawuyifaka emacwecwe.
"Ungasakati imicabango yebugebengu. Ungasisebentisa sigubhutsi ngekusho lokubi enkundleni.
Uma ukhuluma emthethweni, ungaba nesandla semtfubi, ukuze ubeke icala ngelinye icala.
Nakho-ke, uma umtfubi efuna umnikelo wakho, ungawusebentisa kutsi abe ngumtfubi.
Uma ubona ingulube noma umkhwenyana wemphindetsi wakho ehamba, qiniseka kutsi uyawubuyisela kuye.
Uma ubona umkhwenyana welowo lokwephula isandla sakho, ehlala ngaphansi kwengcindezi yakhe, ungayeki kumshiya; sebentisa kuye ngento.
Ungabi nenkinga yekwenta mtsetfo kubantfu labafile emthethweni.
Ungeke ube necala lokubi, ungeke wabulala lowo muntfu longenacala, ngobe ngingeke ngivumele lowo muntfu longenacala akhululeke.
Musa kuthatha umkhonto, ngobe umkhonto ubulala lokubonayo, futhi unciphisa indlebe yalabo abalungile.
Mna-ke ningawuphazamisa lomnyama; ngobe niyazi indlela yelowo mnyama, ngobe nibe bomnyama ezweni leMijiphu.
Ngeminyaka lelishumi nesihlanu utawumisa imifula yakho, uyawuvuna intfo yayo.

"Lamuhla-ke, umsebenti wakho awunakupheli; kepha kumnyaka wesitsatfu uyawushiya lemhlabatsi uphumule, ungawutshali, ukuze batfunywa ebantwaneni bakho babe nekudla kulo, bese lokudla kwabo kungadla tilwane temhlabatsi. Nasetinsini takho, nasesitini sethusi sakho, kufanele ukwenze njalo.
Ngelilanga lesixhenxe wenze umsebenzi wakho, kodwa ngelilanga lesisikhombisa uphumule, kutsi ingulube yakho nedombe lakho likhululeke, umkhonzi wakho nalowo mkhwenyana lohlala nawe abe nekuthula.
Nigcineni kutsi nikwenze konkhe loku ngikutshele ngako; ningatsi nitsi igama labanye bantfu labangcwele, nome litsandvo lwakhe lifike kumehlo akho.
Emaviki lasitfupha ngemnyaka kumele ugcine mnikelo wami wesono.

Ligcine liholidi lemifino engumhluzi, udle imifino engumhluzi lilanga lesitsatfu, njengobe ngikuwisela umthetho ngalo, kuleso sikhathi senyanga ye-Abib; ngobe kulo nyaka waphuma eMisri. Angeke afike enhliziyweni yami ngesandla esisha.
Ungeke ugcine usuku lwekuvuna, lokuqala kwekudla kwakho lokudliwe emhlabatsini lakho; kanye nesuku lekuphuza ekupheliseni komnyaka, lapho ungena khona emajikijolo akho emhlabathini wakho.
Lamashumi lamane emnyaka, wonke lowesifazane wakho kumele afike phambi kweSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho.
Ungeke unikela ngegazi lelihlanganisiwe nekudla lokuhlanganisiwe, nome ugcine lokudla lokuhlanganiswe nekudla lokuhlanganisiwe kuze kube ngumantsi.
Uyawunikela ngezinto ezinhle kakhulu zemhlaba wakho endlwini yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho; ungeke unqume ingulube emlilweni wemama wayo.
Bona, ngiyawuthumela umlingisi phambi kwakho, kutsi akugcine ngendlela yakho, nawe ufike endaweni lengingakulungiselela yona.
Landela kuye, ulalele amazwi akhe; ungawuphazamisi, ngobe angeke akhulule lokuphazamisa kwenu, ngobe igama lami likhona kuwo.
Ngako-ke, uma ukhuluma ngaye ngesandla sakho, uyenzile konkhe labekusho kuwe; ngobe ngitawuba ngumdlavuza wamadlavuza akho, nalabo labakudlandza nabo ngiyawubalala.
"Ngitakusikhipha ezweni lenu, ngikususe kulawo matfu, ngikususe kuma-Amori, nama-Hethi, nama-Perizi, nama-Kananani, nama-Hivi, nema-Jebusi; ngobe ngitawubasusa.
Ungeke ubeke phansi, ungabambisene nabo, ungahamba ngendlela yabo; kepha kufanele ubhubhise bonke bonkulunkulu babo, uyetshebe imihlobiso yabo.
Uya kubambisana naSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, nawe uyakubambisana nekudla kwakho kanye nemanti akho; ngiyawususa indlala emehlweni akho.
Angeke kube khona udzimate emhlabatsini lwakho longakabi nabantwana, noma angeke abe nezingane; ngobe ngitakuletisa iminyaka yakho.
Ngitawuthumela umfutho wami phambi kwakho, ngiyawuphazamisa lomhlaba wonke lowuhlangana nawo; ngobe ngitawubeka lamakhulu akho emphini, nabo bonkhe bantfu bakho behamba.
Ngitathumela tingulube phambi kwakho, tiyawukhipha la-Hivi, na-Kanana, na-Hethi, ebusweni bakho.
Angeke ngibakhuphe kulomnyaka lomunye, kutsi lemhlaba ungabi nalutho, nenyama yemhlaba ikhule ibe likhulu kakhulu kuwe.
lilanga nelilanga ngitawubakhipha, kuze nikhule nikhulule, niyithathe lelizwe libe ngumhlaba wenu.

Nami ngitawubeka umkhawulo wakho kusuka elwandle lwesiSundu kuya elwandle lwabaFilisti, nesuka esigabeni setfu kuya emfuleni i-Euphrates; nami ngitakunikela phambi kwenu labahlali balomhlaba, wena utawuwakhipha phambi kwakho.
Musa kwenza sivumelwano nabo, noma nalabangcwele babo.
Akufanele bahlale ezweni lakho, ngobe bangakwenza uhlupheke ngami; bese uhlala ukhonza bonkulunkulu babo, khona-ke lokhu kungeke kube yitfu kuwe.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Suka ufike kuSimakadze, wena ne-Aron, naNadab naAbihu, kanye nalabakhulu baseSirayeli lamashumi lasikhombisa; nize nibuke eduze.
Musa kuphela longeke afike kuSimakadze, kodvwa bona bangafikanga, nalaba bantu bangaphuma naye.
UMosese wafika, wakhuluma kubo bonke lamazwi kaSimakadze kanye nemithetho yakhe; bonkhe bantfu baphendvula batsi: "Lokho Simakadze abekushoyo sonke sitawukwenza."
UMosese wabhala la mazwi aSimakadze, watsi: "Waphuma ekuseni kakhulu, wabambise ithempeli ngaphansi komfula kanye nemihlobiso lelishumi elinambili yetinhloko tamakhosikazi aseSirayeli.
Wathumela nabangani bakhe baseSirayeli, banikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa, banikela ngenkunzi yenkomo njengemnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Mosesi wathatha inhlamvu yegazi, wayibeka emabhodlelani, kanti inhlamvu yesitsatfu yaleyo gazi wayayifafata phezu kwe altar.
Wathatha khona incwadi yesivumelwano, wayibona emlonyeni webantfu. Batsi: "Nawo wonke la mazwi aSimakadze siyawuwalungisa, sitawuwulalela."
Mosesi wakhipha legazi, watsi: "Leli yigazi lesivumelwano, loNkulunkulu abesenzela lona nine mayelana naleyo miyalo yonke."
Waphuma khona Musa na-Aron, neNadab naAbihu, kanye nalabakhulu bakaSirayeli labamashumi lasikhombisa.
Babona Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli; ngaphansi kwenyawo lakhe kwakukhona into efana nemhlabatsi wegolide, lomhlophe njengezulu.
Nkulunkulu akazange aphakamise isandla sakhe kulabo baholi beSirayeli; bakubona Simakadze, badla nabo baphuza.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Suka ufike kumfula, uhlale khona; ngitakunikela ngetibopho tesiliva negolide, nemtsetfo kanye nemyalo labengingawubhalela, kutsi ubafundise.
Waphuma ke Mosi, naJoshua umkhonzi wakhe; watsi Musa wafika emfuleni waNkulunkulu.
Watsi kubo bonkhe bantfu: "Sihlale lapha kuze sibuye kuwe; bona, u-Aron no-Hur bakhona nawe; lowo nalowo longeke abe nenkinga, afike kubo."
Musa waphuma waya emfuleni, umfudlane wawuwufihla.
Ukuthula kweSimakadze kwahlala eMfuleni iSinayi, kanye nelilanga lesishiyagalolunye umfula wawufihla lomhlabatsi. Emini yesikhombisa Simakadze watsi kuMosesi kusuka emigwaqweni yemifudlane.
Lamandla kaSimakadze abonakala emehlo lamadvodza aseSirayeli, njengemlilo lophumayo enhliziyweni yemhlabatsi.
Mosese wafika ekungeneni kwesivunguvungu, wehla emfuleni, wahlala emfuleni emaviki lamashumi mane nelilanga lamashumi mane.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi kuboSirayeli, bafike bamnike mnikelo wesono; kulowo nalowo loyawunikela ngesandla sakhe, wena utawumukela mnikelo waso.
Lolu ngumnikelo wesono lotawuwukhokha kubo: igolide, nesiliva, nesiliva lelibomvu;
isiliva, negolide, nesiliva lelibomvu, nelinen lelihlanganisiwe, nenwele yegodzi;
tingulube letiboshwe mhlophe; lesikhumba lesincanyana; isihlahla se-acacia;
nemafutha e-olive lokuhlobisa, kanye nemakhandlela lokuhlobisa, namafutha ekuphuza kanye netfufu lelibomvu;
kanye nematshe e-onyx, neminye imihlobiso yegolide, kutsi ifakwe ku-ephodni nasenhlalweni senkhosi.
Bangilungiselele khona indawo lengcwele, ngobe ngihlala phakathi kwabo.
Ngendlela lengingakukhombisa yona, uyawuyenza tabernakele kanye naleyo mihlobiso yayo.
Bayakwenza ibhokisi, le ark, yesihlahla se-acacia, ibe nebude bemamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nebubanzi bemamitha lamakhulu lasitfupha, nebude bemamitha lamakhulu lasikhombisa.
Yayigubuta ngegolide lelihle, ngasentfweni nangaphandle, wayenza nemingcambu yegolide yinye.
Uyawuyenza ibe nemingcele lemine yegolide, uyibeke emilenzeni yayo emibili; umngcele lomunye ungeke ube nemngcele lomnye.
Wakha netibondza tesihlahla se-akademu, watiwa ngegolide.
Wabeka tintambo emacwecwe emacala la-arka, kutsi abagcwaliswe ngaso.
Lemikhono kumele ihlale emacwecwe ebhokisini, angeke athathwe ngaphandle.
Wena utawubeka ebhokisini ticwecwe tesivumelwano, lapho ngitakunikela khona.
Uyakwenza isandla segolide lesincibilikile, uyenze ibe yindlu yekuthula; ubude bayo kumele bube ngema-anthi lasitfupha, nebubanzi bawo kufanele bube ngama-anthi lalishumi.
Wayawukwenza netikerubi letimbili tegolide lelihlanganisiwe, tibekwe emaceleni lamacala lasitfupha esipho.
Uyawukhipha kerubu lelinye esiphelweni esisodwa, nekerubu lelinye esiphelweni esisodwa; uyawukhipha lamakerubi kanye nemgodlo-mlilo esinye.
Lama-kerubi angeke abe nemilenze yakhe ivulekile phezulu, kepha kumele abe nemilenze yakhe ephikisa isipho; kufanele abe nemilenze yakhe ibhekene nelinye, bese ubuso bakhe buye kuleso sipho.
Utawubeka isipho sekuthula phezulu ebhokisini, utawubeka ngaphakathi kwebhokisi ticwecwe tesivumelwano, letiyawukupa wena.

Ngitahlangana nawe khona, ngaphesheya kwendlu yekuphumula, phakathi kwama-kerubi mabini abekwe ebhokisini lesinqumo; lapho ngitakhuluma nawe khona ngezinto zonke lozange ngikuvumele ukwenze kuboSirayeli.
"Uyakwenza itafula lelinesihlahla se-acacia, lifike libe ngumanti lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ngebude bayo kanye namatisenti lamakhulu mane nesikhombisa ngesivini sayo.
Yayigubuta ngegolide lelihle, wayenza nemingcambu yegolide ngayinye.
Uyawuyenza imilenze yakhe ibe ngububanzi besandla esisodwa, utawuyibeka phezulu ngegolide.
Wayayenza imilenze lemine yegolide, wabeka imilenze yalegolide emakhoneni lamane, lapho tinyawo letine takhona.
Tigodzi kumele tibekwe eduze kwesokudla, kutsi tibambe tintambo letisetshenziswa ekuthwaleni ibhodi.
Uyakwenza tintambo tesihlahla se-akademu, utawuzibeka ngegolide, kutsi kutfutwe ngazo itafula.
Uyakwenza tibhaka, netinkomishi, netimbhoshongo, namatiko akhe, abe ngugolide lohlanzekile, abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa ngewo.
Lonke lilanga ugcine inhlama lekhethekile embhedeni phambi kwami.
Uyakwenza intambo yekukhanya yegolide lengcwele; uyawuyikhipha ngesandla, nesisekelo sayo kanye nesihlahla sayo; tigodzi taso, netinkomishi taso, netimbali taso, kumele tibe sinye.
Lamandla lasitfupha ayawuphuma emaceleni alo, lasitfupha ecaleni elinye, nalamatsatfu ecaleni elinye.
Lonke linye lamacala lamane kumele libe netipho tesihlanu letifana netinhlamvu te-almond, ngemikhono kanye nemabhiya.
Naleso sibhakabhaka kumele sibe netikombe letintsatfu, letifana nesihlahla se-almond, netinkomishi taso kanye netimbali taso.
Isihlahla singeke sibe ngaphansi kwesinye semaphiko, nesihlahla singeke sibe ngaphansi kwesinye lamaphiko, nesihlahla singeke sibe ngaphansi kwesinye lamaphiko; emaphiko lamane aphuma kulo.
Lamahlombe ayo, nemilenze yakhe, kumele ibe yinye ingxenye yalo; kufanele kube ngumnikelo wekushiswa wegolide lohle.
Uyawuyenza netinhlamvu zayo letintsatfu, utawubeka tinhlamvu zalo kuyo, kutsi tifafaze phandle kwayo.
Lamahhashi ayo kanye naletibhaka-bhaka kumele kwenziwe ngegolide lemhlophe.
Ngegolide lelingenamamitha lamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu, uyawuyenza intambo yemlilo kanye naleyo mpahla.
Ungeke ube nenkinga, uyawuzenza njengesitayela lesitsiwe kuwe emfuleni.
Uyakwenza itabernakele yengcwele ibe netibopho letilishumi, ngelinen lelihlanganisiwe, nesibhakabhaka, nesingwevu, nesingwevu; umculi lomusha kumele afake kuwo ema-kerubi.
Lonke i curtain kumele libe nebukhulu lobufanayo, bungakamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu emasentimitha bude kanye namakhulu lamabili emasentimitha ebanzi.
Lamashumi lasihlanu emafasitela uyawuwahlanganisa linye nelinye, kanye nalabalishumi elinesihlanu nabo.
Uphindze ubeke imilenze yetinhlamvu tesiliva nelesilivere eduze kwesobunxele besigameko sesibili, bese ubeka lesinye sigagameko sesigameko sesibili.
Uyakwenza tigodzi tamashumi lamabili nesihlanu etintiwa lesinye, natigodzi tamashumi lamabili nesihlanu esiphelweni setintiwa lesinye lapho kuhlangatshezwana khona; tigodzi tiyawubhekana.
Wakwenza netinsika tagolide tilishumi lelinesihlanu, wahlanganisa netinsakato letimbili ngetinsakato tegolide, aze abeke itente lengcwele kuyinye.
Uyawukhipha titende temilenze yengulube, ube ngutindlu letingcwele; uyawukhipha titende tamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamacala lalishumi lelinesihlanu kumele abe nebubanzi obufanako, bufike kumamitha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa namakhulu lasitfupha bude kanye namamitha lamibili bubanzi.
Wabeka emafasitela lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emnyango wetenti, nalamafasitela lamakhulu mane emnyango wetenti. Wafaka emafasitela lalishumi nesishiyagalombili enkundleni yetenti.

Uyakwenza tingulube tamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emphemeni wesobunxele lwesigqoko esiseceleni kwesinye sigqoko, kanye natingulube tamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emphemeni wesobunxele sesigqoko esipheleni sesinye.
Wakwenza netingcweti tesiliva lemashumi lamane, wabeka titingcweti kuloo ma-loops kutsi ahlanganise itenti ngalinye nelinye, ibe yisinye.
Lengxenye yesitayela lesisaseleyo kumele sikhonjwe ecaleni lasemuva letente lengcwele.
Letindlu tetenti kumele tibe nemanti lamakhulu lasitfupha emasentimitha, kanye naletindlu tetenti kufanele tibe nemanti lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili emasentimitha.
Letentisa letente ngesikhumba semvu lesimhlophe, nesikhumba sengulube yemphini, bese ufaka phezulu.
Uyawukhipha emabhokisi esiliva negolide, utawuwafaka emgodini wetenti lengcwele.
Ibhokisi ngalinye kumele libe limalunga lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emasentimitha lide kanye nesentimitha lesikhombisa libanzi.
Nale tigodzi letilishumi nembili, kanye naletigodzi letilishumi nembili, kumele tibe nemikhono lemibili; ngaleyo ndlela utawuzenza tonkhe tigodzi tetenti lesingcwele.
Uyakwenza tibhodi letilishumi elinesihlanu kwesobunxele setabernakele.
Wakwenza tinyawo tesiliva lama-40 ngaphansi kwetikhontsi letimashumi lamane, tinyawo letintsatfu phansi kwemkhontsi ngamunye.
Nakwecala lelinye, kwecala lasenyakatho lendlu yasebukhosini, wenze tibhodi letimashumi lamane.
kanye netibondza tesiliva lama-40, tibhotsi letimbili ngaphansi kwelinye ibhokisi.
Wakha netibondza lesixhenxe ekugcineni kwetabernakele, ngasemgwaqeni.
Uyakwenza netingcweti letimbili, kutsi tibekwe emakhoneni lasemva kwetenti lengcwele.
Kuletinhloko letimbili, tintambo kumele tihlukaniswe kusuka phansi kuya phezulu, tigcinwe ngerindzi lelinye. Yenza tinhloko letintsatfu ngendlela lenjalo
Ake kube nemabhodi lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nalabaphansi besiliva lama-16; emabhokisi mabini angaphansi kwalowo mbhede.
Wakha netimbhoshongo tesihlahla se-akademu; timbili kulawo mabhodi ecaleni elinye letentilo,
lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emacwecwe ecaleni lelinye, namakhulu lamabili nesihlanu emacwecwe ecaleni lasenyakatho.
I-crossbar lephakathi kufanele ihambe yonke indlela kusuka kwelinye icala kuya kwelinye, ngaphesheya kwemigca.
Wabeka emabhokisi egolide, wakwenza netingcezu tegolide kutsi tifakwe khona imilenze; wabeka nemilenze yegolide.
Letentisa tabernakele lengcwele, njengobe wabonakaliswa kulo mfula.
Uyakwenza ifasitela lelinemibala yegolide, neyesiliva, neyesibhakabhaka, kanye nelinen elibomvu elincibilikisiwe; umculi lomusha ungeke afake kuwo ema-kerubi.
Wayifaka ngemikhonto yegolide emadolobheni lasitfupha amacembe esihlahla se-akademu, abesakhiwe ngegolide; ibekwe ngaphansi kwetinyawo tesiliva letilishumi.
Wabeka itenti lelingu-150 emasentimitha emamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, wamisa lifasitelo lesikhungweni lesingcwele kanye nalelifasitela lelingama-300 lamasentimitha.
Lapha utawubeka isipho, isipho sekuthula, phezu kwebhokisi lesivumelwano, eNkambu Yekungcwele.
Wabeka ibhokisi lekudla ngaphandle kwetafula, ecaleni lesikhungweni lasenyakatho, wabeka nesitayela semlilo esibhekene nebhokisi lekudla ecaleni lesempumalanga.
Uyakwenza umhlobiso emnyango wetenti, ngegolide, nesiliva, nesilivere, nelinen lelihlanganisiwe; uzoba ngumsebenzi womculi lowenzakalisa.
Uyawuyenza itenti lelinemikhono yegolide, nemilenze emihlanu yesihlahla se-akademu, uyawuyigubungela ngegolide; uyawuyenza namatfuba layo lasihlanu esiliva.
Uyakwakha i altare yesihlahla se-acacia; kufanele ibe lisaka, libe nemamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu lokubude, namakhulu lasitfupha enyawo lobubanzi, nalobukhulu bemitha lesikhombisa.
Uyakwenza tingulube kumacala ayo lamane; tingulube tayo ne altare kumele tihlangane, uyawuyibeka ngesiliva.
Uyawukwenza zonke zinto zalo zibe ngusiliva, netinhlamvu taso lokususa inkungu, netincopho tabo, netimbhoshongo tabo, netibombo tekudla, netibombo temlilo.
Wayayenza intambo yesiliva, leyindilinga yegolide, wayenza nemingcele yegolide emakhoneni lamane entambo.
Utawubeka legridi ngaphansi kwegobolondo lengema-altari, kuze lifike emaphesenti laphansi egolide.
Uyakwenza ema-altare abe tintambo tesihlahla se-akademu, utawuzibeka ngesiliva.
Wabeka tintambo emaringini, kutsi tibe ngasekudla nakwesobunxele kwe altare, lapho ifakwa khona.
Uyawuyenza i altare ibe mnyama, ibe ngetibhodi; njengekuboniswa kuwe emfuleni, njalo-ke utawuyilungisa.
Uyakwenza nesitezi sendlu yasebukhosini, ecaleni lasempumalanga, lifike libe likhulu elinamashumi lamane lamacala, libe nemgodzi yelinen lelihlanganisiwe.
Imiganga yayo ibe yimashumi lamane, netibopho zayo zibe yimashumi lamane esiliva; imimango yabo ibe yigolide, natikhonjiso tabo zibe yigolide.

Icala lasenyakatho liyawuba nemamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ngebude, libe nemihlobiso yayo, netimbhoshongo letilishumi nambili, netibopho tesiliva letilishumi nambili, netigcawu tesilivere kanye netingcezu tetimbhoshongo.
Icala lasenyakatho leliseceleni lomhlabatsi kumele libe limamitha lamashumi lamabili nesitfupha bubanzi, linemihlobiso, netinyawo letilishumi, netibondza letilishumi.
Lengxenye yasempumalanga, ekusingeni kwelanga, kumele ibe nebubanzi bemamitha lamashumi lamabili nambili.
Ngelinye icala lemnyango kumele kube netindlundza letingaphansi kwemamitha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa ngebude, kanye netinyawo tesihlanu netibopho tesitfupha.
Ngelinye icala kutawube khona naletindlundza letingaphansi kwemamitha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa ngetintambo tekucala netinhloko tesihlanu.

Nase uphindze wenze umgodzi wemnyango wemafasitela, wamamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu (45.2 m) ubude kanye namamitha lasitfupha (6.1 m) bubanzi; ube ngusondza wesibhakabhaka, nesibomvu, nesingwevu, nelinen lelihlanganisiwe, ekwenziweni kwayo kube khona lokucwebezelayo; abe nemijovo lengenamakhulu amane (50.7 m), abe nemfudlane lengenamakhulu mane (50.8 m).
Lamandla laleyo ndlu, kanye naleyo ndzawo yekungenelela, kumele ibe netintambo tesiliva, netikhonjiso tegolide, netibopho tesiliva.

Lomhlabatsi kumele bube ngemamitha lamashumi mane nesihlanu ebude kanye nemamitha lamashumi lamabili nalabambili ebukhulu, ngemihlobiso yelineni lelihlanganisiwe liphakeme kakhulu kunemitha lemibili, kanye nesisekelo segolide.
Lamandla lawo, kanye naleyo mpahla leyisetshenziswa ekusebenzeni kwendlu yasengcwele, netinsika tayo, netinsika temphi, kumele tibe zegolide.
Laletsa lamadvodza ase-Israyeli ukuba afike nawe abe nemafutha e-olive ahlanzekile, afakwe emgodini, ukuze umgodo uhlale ukhanya.

Etentini lekuhlangana, ngaphandle kwetibuko elingene phambi kwesigcobo sesivumelwano, u-Aron nemadvodzana akhe kumele bagcine ilanga likhanya kusukela ngasebusuku kuze kube ekuseni phambi kuSimakadze; ngumthetho lohlala njalo kuboSirayeli emijahweni yabo.
"Uyawufikela wena uAron, umngane wakho, kanye nemadvodzana akhe: Nadabu naAbihu, Eleazari naIthamari, kusuka kubantfu beSirayeli, kutsi basebenze kimi njengenkhosi.
"Uyawuhlela nalowo mzalwane wakho, uAron, tigqoko letingcwele, kutsi abe nebucwebe nebuhle.
Utsi: "Ukhulume nalabo bonke labaqeqeshiwe, lami ngibagcwalisele ubuhlakani, ufike balungiselele ingubo ta-Aharonu, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono, abe ngumLevi.

Lolu hlobo lwemigqomo labayawuyenza: intamo, ne-ephod, nebukhazikhazi, nebhande, netinhlavu, nemingcele; bayawuyenza lemigqomo engcwele ka-Aron, umngane wakho, kanye nabana bakhe, kutsi basebenze kimi njengebaLevi.
Baphindze bafake igolide, nesiliva, nesilivere, nalesibhakabhaka, nelinen lelihlanganisiwe.
Bayawuyenza i-ephod yegolide, nesiliva, negolide lelibomvu, nesilivere, nelinen lelihlanganisiwe, bayenze ngesandla semkhondweni.
Kungeke kube nemichilo lemibili yemilenze ekhoneni lembili, ukuze iphindze ibandlwe kanye.
Umlenze wayo kumele ube ngendlela leyo, ibe yinye neleyo; kufanele kube yegolide, intambo lengesibhakabhaka, leluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, neyemnyama, kanye nelinen elibomvu elincibilikile.
"Utathatha titshe letimbili tegolide, utawugravura kuwo lamagama lamadvodzana a-Israyeli.
Babhalela amagama lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emacwecwe alinye, namagama lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa emacwecwe lamanye, ngendlela yabo yekuzalwa.
Uyawugcobisa ematshe lalawa mabini ngemagama emadvodzana a-Israyeli, njengobe umhlobisi wegolide egcobisa isandla sakhe; utawubeka ematshe lalawo emigodini yegolide.

Uya kuzibeka emacwecwe lawo mabini emilenzeni yesandla se-ephod, abe ngamacwecwe lokukhumbula lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli; uAron uyakuba nemagama abo emehlweni kaSimakadze emlenzeni wakhe, abe ngubufakazi.
yenza imihlobiso yegolide,
kanye nemingcambu lemibili yegolide lengcwele, eyenziwe ngesandla; bese ufaka lemingcambu kuloo mabhokisi.
Uyakwenza nesiphambano, lokudlandza lokucwebezelayo; uyawuyenza ngendlela ye-ephod, ngegolide, nesiliva, negolide lelibomvu, nesilivere, nelinen lelihlanganisiwe.
Ifanele ibe yinye, iphindwe kabili, ibe ngemamitha lamashumi lamabili nesitfupha kuya kumakhulu lalishumi nalamahlanu lobukhulu.
Wabeka kuyo tigodzi letintsatfu tegolide, etigcongweni tato wabeka i-azurite, ne-topazite, ne-beryl.
Esigabeni lesitsatfu kubeka i-turquoise, i-sapphire, ne-emerald.
Esigabeni lesithathu babeka i-hyacinth, ne-agate, ne-ametist.
Esigabeni sesine, wabeka i-chrysolite, ne-onyx, ne-jasper; wabeka emacwecwe egolide.
Lamatshe layawuba ngamacwecwe alishumi elinambili, ngalinye lifana negama lemadvodzana a-Isiraheli; lingeke libe nembhalo lobhalwe ngesandla, lifana namagama lamadvodza lalishumi elinambili.
Nase uphindze ubenze emphinjeni yegolide lengcwele, ngetintambo tesiliva nelesiliva.
Wakwenza netinhlanga letimbili tegolide, wazisa emakhoneni lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa ebhokisini.
Lamandla lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-ara, abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa.
Lamanye amacala emilenze lemincane uyawuwafaka kulawo macwecwe lamibili, uyawuwabeka emilenzeni yesandla se-ephod ngaseceleni.
Waye wakwenza nemingcele lemibili yegolide, wababeka emakhoneni lawo mabini esiphambanweni, ngaseceleni kwe-ephod, ngasenceleni.
Uyakwenza nemingcele lemibili yegolide, uyibeke emaceleni emilenze ye-ephod, ngasebunxele kwayo, lapho ihlangana khona naleyo mikhono leyimqoka.
Wabeka imilenze yesifuba emilengeni ye-ephod ngentambo lemnyama, kutsi imilenze yesifuba ihlale phezulu komlenze wegolide, nengeke iphume ngaphandle kwe-ephod.
Arone kumele abambe amagama lamadvodza ase-Israyeli emlonyeni wakhe, ebhokisini lesinqumo, lapho efika khona esingcweleni; kufanele kube ngukumbuso kubo phambi kwaSimakadze njalo.

Utawubeka emphinjeni i-Urim ne-Thummim, ukuze zibe ngaphansi kwenhliziyo ka-Aron lapho ephuma khona kuSimakadze; u-Aron utawuba nesithende semtsetfo samakhosikazi aseSirayeli esingaphansi kwenhliziyo yakhe phambi kwa-Simakadze njalo.
Uyawukhipha intambo yesandla sasekudla, uyenze ibe yigolide.
Kungeke kube nemnyango lowuvulekile wenhloko embindini wayo, kanye nemkhawulo lowungconywa ecaleni lokuvulekayo njengegobolondo, ukuze ungabi nenkinga yekutsi uphuze.
Nase uphindze ubete ema-granates ensimini lemnyama, neyegolide, neyesibhakabhaka, kanye netinhlamvu tegolide phakathi kwato.
Nase uphindze ube netinhlamvu tegolide, netinhlamvu tegranate, netetinhlamvu tegolide, netinhlamvu tegranate, kuleyo mitvo yegobho.
U-Aron utawuyigqoka lapho esebenza khona njengomLevi, kutsi kukhulunywe umsindo wayo lapho efika khona esingcweleni phambi kwaSimakadze, nalapho ephuma khona, ngobe angeke afe.
Uyakwenza iphakheji yegolide elifihliwe, ubhale phezulu, njengekubhalwe ngesandla: Kungcwele kuSimakadze.
Yibeke ngentambo yegolide ecaleni lelinesibhakabhaka.

Kuyawuba ngumnikelo wesono ku-Aron, abe ngumnikelo wesono ku-Aron; uAron uyakuba nesibopho sokudla noma kuphi lokubi ezinto taNkulunkulu letingcwele, lapho bantfu baka-Israyeli benikela khona; ibe ngumnikelo wesono ku-Aron njalo, ukuze iminikelo yabo ivunyelwe kuSimakadze.
Uyawumisa ihembe lelinelimhlophe, uyenze netinhlavu telinen lelibomvu; umlenze wakhe kumele ube ngumsebenzi welowo lohamba ngemihlobiso.
Lamadvodza la-Aron afike eBhetlehema, abe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, watsi:
Utawuzigqoka u-Aron, mzalwane wakho, kanye nemadvodzana akhe, utawuwaphakisa, utawubamisa emandla abo, utawubangcwele, bami babe ngumnikelo wesono.
Uyawubakhipha emabhutsi elinen, abe nemanti abo, afike kulomlomo wakhe kuya emlenzeni.

Aron nemadvodzana akhe kumele abezigqokile lapho bephuma khona etentini lekuhlangana, noma lapho befika khona esithendeni sokushiswa, kutsi basebenze endlwini yasengcwele, ukuze bangabi nesono, baphile; kube ngumthetho wesive se-Aron kanye nesive sakhe ngemuva kwakhe.
Lena yindlela loyawuyenza ngayo umnikelo wekushiswa kwa-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, kutsi basebenze kimi njengenkhosi: uthathe inkunzi yengulube kanye nalabomvu lababini, bangabi necala.
Ngesithelo lesincanyana, esinamafutha ancane, ungeke ube nekudla lokuphekiwe; ungeke ube nekudla lokucwebezelayo lokuhlanganisiwe nephethiloli, kanye nekudla lokuhlanganiswe nephethiloli.
Utawutibeka ebhokisini, utawuzinikela ebhokisini, kanye nengulube kanye nemhlambi wemvu lababini.
Wafike wabeka Aharon nemadvodzana akhe emgwaqeni wetente lekuhlangana, wabahlamba ngamanzi.
"Utathatha lemihlobiso, utawuyisa ku-Aron ihembe, nebukhazikhazi be-ephod, ne-ephod, kanye nemgqomo wemphini; bese utawumisa phansi umlenze we-ephod.
Utawumisa i-turban phezu kwehlavu lakhe, utawubeka ku-turban inkosi lengcwele.
bese uthatha umhluzi wekuphuza, uwufafaze, uwufake phezu kwehlavu lakhe.
Nifike nifikeni nemadvodzana akhe, nibagqoke ngetinti.
"Utabeka umlenze ku-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, utawubeka tingulube kubo; kutsi kube ngumthetho wabo kuze kube sekupheleni; nawe utawubeka isandla sakho ku-Aron nemadvodzakati akhe.
Wafike wabeka isandla sakhe esihlalweni semtsetfo, wamisa isandla sakhe esiswini salowo mhlambi, wamisa isandla sakhe esiswini salowo mhlambi.
Uyawubulala lengulube phambi kwaSimakadze, emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana.
Utathatha negazi lelibomvu, utawulifaka ngesandla sakho emikhondweni ye-altari, bese ukhipha lonke elinye ligazi embhedeni we-altari.
Wafaka naleso sifuba, nalesisu, nesikhumba lesingenhla, nalesisu lesiphansi, nalesisu lesingaphansi, nalesisu lesiphakeme, nalesisu lesiphansi, nalesisu lesiphezulu, nalesisu lesiphansi.
Lenyama yengulube, nesikhumba sayo, nemfuyo yayo, uyawuyibulala ngemlilo ngaphandle kwekhampasi; iyimnikelo wekushiswa.
Utathatha umhlambi wemvu, uAron nemadvodzana akhe batawubeka isandla sabo phezu kwehlavu lemvu.
Uyawuyibulala, utawuthatha igazi layo, utawulifafata ema-altari ngaso sonke sikhatsi.
Utawumisa lomuntfu lomncane, uyawuwususa umlondza wakhe kanye nemilenze yakhe, uyawubeka emacwecwe akhe nenhloko yakhe.
Uyawuwukhipha lomnikelo wesono, uwuba ngumnikelo wesono lokushiswa kuSimakadze, umphunga lomnandi, iminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Tsala lomunye lomkhwenyana, uAron nemadvodzana akhe babeke isandla sabo phezu kwehlavu lomkhwenyane.

Uyawuyibulala, utawukhipha igazi layo, uyewufaka emlonyeni wendlebe yesobunxele ka-Aron, nesemlonyeni wesandla sakhe sokudla, nasenhliziyweni yenyawo lakhe lelibomvu, nawewubabeka kubo; bese uzama lokushisa lokunye kwegazi phezu kwesibambo semlilo ngasogwini.

"Utathatha negazi lelingene enhliziyweni ye altar, namafutha okubhaka, utawuwafafaza ku-Aron, nemilenze yakhe, nabana bakhe, nemilenze yabana bakhe nabo; nawe utawugtigcizelela yena, nebana bakhe, nemilenze yabana bakhe.

Utakhipha lokudla lokushisayo, nemphimbo lelibomvu, nekudla lokushisayo lokujikisa emathunjini, nekudla lokushisayo lokujikisa inhliziyo, nemilenze mibini kanye nekudla lokushisayo lokujikiswa kwayo, nenhloko yesobunxele. Lokudla lokushisayo kuyawubekwa emkhondweni.

Utakhipha ebhokisini lekudla lokunge-lenyama, elibekwe phambi kwaSimakadze, uthathe inkomishi eyodwa yekudla lokunge-lenyama, inkomishi eyodwa yekudla lokunge-oyile, nenkomishi eyodwa yekudla lokunge-oyile.
Lawo onkhe utawuwabeka esandlani sa-Aron, nesandlani samadvodzakati akhe; nabo bayawushaya ngaso phambi kwaSimakadze.
Uyawutikhipha esandlani sabo, utawuzibulala emgodini, phezu kwesondlo sokudla lokushiswayo, ibe yiphunga lelihle kuSimakadze; imnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Utathatha nemphimbo yemvu yemnikelo wekushiswa wa-Aron, uyawuyiphakamisa phambi kwaSimakadze, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; itawube yingxenye yakho.
Nawe utawunikela ngaleyo nyama yemvu, leyimisiwe ku-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, kutsi ibe ngumnikelo wesono, kanye naleso sifuba lesiphakanyiselwe phansi.
Lo mnikelo wesono utawubekwa kuAron nemadvodzana akhe, ube yiminikelo yekushiswa yenkhosi, ibe ngumnikelo wesono losuka kubo-Israyeli, kanye nemnikelo wesono waSimakadze.
Lemigqomo lengcwele ka-Aron itawuba yiyo yabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe ngemuva kwakhe, kutsi bakhonjwe ngaso, babekwe emsebentini wabo.
Loyawuba ngumnikelo wesono ngemuva kwakhe, losuka kumadvodzana akhe, lophuma etentini lekuhlangana, kutsi asebenze esingcweleni, kumele azigqoke lilanga lesitsatfu.
Utawukhipha umhlambi webantfu, uyawumisa inyama yawo endaweni lengcwele.
Arone namadvodzana akhe kumele badle inyama yengulube kanye nekudla lokusekhejini, emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana.
Baye bakudla, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono kubo, lapho bebekwa khona emkhondweni waSimakadze, kutsi babe ngcwele; akukho muntu longaphandle kwabo loyawudla kuwo, ngobe angcwele.
"Nakuba yini nayinye yekudla lokusetshenzisiwe, noma yini nayinye yekudla lokusetshenzisiwe, ihlala kuze kube ngekusasa, kufanele uyicwebeze ngamlilo; kumele ingadlalwanga, ngobe iyingcwele.
Uyawukwenza njalo ku-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, njengobe ngikuwisele umthetho; lilanga lesitsatfu utawubamisa emandla abo.
Utawunikela lilanga ngalinye ngengulube, ibe yimnikelo wekushiswa, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono; uyawulungisa i-altari ngekudla kwayo, uyawuyiphazamisa, ukuze uyingcwele.
Ngelilanga lesitsatfu utawumisa i-altari, uyenze ibe ngcwele; ne-altari iya kuba ngcwele kakhulu; nanoma yini leyicophelela, iya kuba ngcwele.
Lolu mnikelo utawuwunikela ethempelini ngaso sonke sikhatsi: tingulube letintsatfu letineminyaka lemibili.
Lomunye utawuwunikela ekuseni, lomunye utawuwunikela kusasa.
Nalenyama yengulube yekucala utawuyinikela ngekilogremu lelishumi nesihlanu yesiliva, lihlanganisene nelitha lelinye lamafutha e-olive, kanye nelitha lelinye lewayini njengemnikelo wekudla.
Lomunye umkhwenyana uyawuwulungiselela emini, nemnikelo wakhe wekudla kanye nemnikelo wakhe wokudla, njengobe unjalo ekuseni; yiphunga lelihle, imnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa kumele ukhokhwe nsuku zonke, emindenini yenu, emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana, phambi kwaSimakadze; khona ngitahlangana nawe kutsi ngikhulume nawe.
Nalapho ngitawuhlangana khona nemadvodzana a-Israyeli, nendzawo yengcwele iphindze ibe ngcwele ngebukhosi bami.
Nami ngitawungcwelesa itente lekuhlangana ne altare, na-Aron kanye nabomadvodzana akhe ngiyawungcwelesa, kutsi basebenzela kimi njengenkhosi.
Nami ngiyawuhlala emiphakathini yalabaSirayeli, ngibe nguNkulunkulu wabo.
Bayawuzi kutsi ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo, lowawubakhipha ezweni leMijiphu, ukuze ngihlale phakathi kwabo; ngiyabe nguSimakadze Nkulunkulu wabo.
Uyawuhlela ne altare yesihlahla se-acacia, kutsi kube khona umlilo wetfusa.

Ingeke ibe yinye kuphela, ibe nebude besentimitha lemashumi lamane nasihlanu, nebubanzi besentimitha lemashumi lamane nasihlanu, nebude besentimitha lemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa; tingulube tayo kumele zibe linye.
Uyawusifaka ngegolide lelihle, kanye nemilenze yakhe yonke, namahlombe akhe; utawukhipha umbhoshongo wegolide kuwo.
Uyawuyenza nemingcele lemibili yegolide ngezansi kwegobolondo, emaceleni ayo lahlukene, ibe yimijovo yetibondza lokulithwa kwalo.
Lemikhono yenzake ngesihlahla se-akademu, uyicwebeze ngegolide.
Uyibeke phambi kwetibuko lelingaseceleni kwebhokisi lesivumelwano, ebusweni bendlu yasebukhosini; khona ngizohlangana nawe.
U-Aron kufanele afake emakhandlela ephunga lelihle lilanga lonke, lapho elungisa khona tilambu.
Nalapho emisa khona ilanga ekuseni, kufanele afake umlilo wetfunyo; lomlilo wetfunyo kumele ubekwe phambi kwaSimakadze njalo-ke, kuze kube sesukuni lenu.
Mna-ke ningeke ninikeze kuleyo ndawo yekushiswa mnikelo wesono, noma mnikelo wekushiswa, noma mnikelo wekudla, nome mnikelo wekushiswa, noma mnikelo wokudla.

UAron utawuyihlanza lilanga lekucala, afake emikhondweni yayo insangu yesondlo sesono, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono; lokudla kumele kusetjentiswe lilanga lekucala, emashumini lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa eminyaka, kuwo wonke lamasiko akho. Yingcwele kakhulu kuSimakadze.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi watsi:
"Uma ubala bantfu baseSirayeli, kumele wonke umuntu akhokhele kuSimakadze inhlawulo yempilo yakhe, lapho ebalwa khona, ukuze kungabi nendlala phakathi kwabo, lapho ubala khona.
Wonke lowo utawunikela ngaphesheya kweshekeli, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, nge shekeli yesingcwele, lapho i-shekeli ibe yigeretha lemashumi lasitfupha.
Wonke lowo lobhalisiwe, kusukela eneminyaka lemashumi lamane nambili nangaphezulu, utawunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Uma ninikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, kutsi ubuyiselwe kuphila kwenu, lowo umtfubi angeke akhokhe ngaphezu kwephesenti lesinye seshekeli, nalowo lomfubi angeke akhokhe ngaphansi kwayo.
"Thintela lemali kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, uyisebenzisele umsebenzi wetenti lekuhlangana; ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, umnikelo wesondlo salabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi watsi:
"Uyakwenza nelitfuba lesiliva, nesisekelo sayo segolide; uyawumisa phakathi kwetenti lekuhlangana ne altare, utawubeka amanzi kulo.
Aron nemadvodzana akhe kumele bahlanze tinyawo tabo kanye nesandla sabo ngawo.

Kuphela lapho bephuma khona etentini lekuhlangana, kumele bahlanzwe ngamanzi, ukuze bangafa; kanye nalapho befika khona esibhedlela, kufanele bahlanzwe ngamanzi, kutsi basebenzela umnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Bayawuhlamba isandla sabo nenyawo labo, bangafa; kube ngumthetho lohlala njalo ku-Aron kanye nemadvodzana akhe, emindenini yabo.'
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi watsi:
"Thintela tiphunga letihle kakhulu: lilitha lelikhulu lemirha, nephesenti laleyo mirha; lilitha lesitsatfu se-cinnamon, nelitha lesithathu se-cannabis,
nemanti lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamatsatfu esiliva, ngaleso sibalo lesingcwele; namafutha ema-olive angaba ngemalitha lalishumi.
Lawo angeke abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, kepha kumele abe ngumnikelo wesono longcwele, umnikelo wesono longcwele, mnikelo wesono longcwele.
Ngeleyo mafutha utawumisa itente lekuhlangana, nebhokisi lesivumelwano,
letini kanye nezinto zayo zonke, nesibambiso kanye nezinto zayo, ne altare yekufuya,
ne-altari yemnikelo wekushiswa, naletinye tive tayo, nemgodzi kanye netinyawo tayo.
Utawuzinikela kuwo, aze abe ngcwele kakhulu; noma yini leyicophelela kuyo, iya kuba ngcwele.
Utawuwuphakisa u-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, utawubanikela kubo, kutsi basebenze kimi njengenkhosi.
Ukhuluma kuboSirayeli, utsi: Lowungeke ube ngumnikelo wekushiswa longcwele kuSimakadze, kuze kube kufike iminyaka yenu.
Ungeke uyitsuse kulowo muntfu, ngobe ingcwele; nawe kumele uyigcine ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa.
Nalowo nalowo lowenza umnikelo wekushiswa njengewo, nome lowufaka kulowo muntfu longeke abe ngumLevi, lowo muntu kumele ahlukaniswe nebantfu bakhe.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thipha imifino lemihle, i-onika, ne-galbanum, kanye ne-uranium elihlanzekile, yinye ngayinye ngenani lelilingana nalo.
Uyawuyenza ibe ngutfubi, iphunga lelihle, lifana nekudla lokuphekwa ngaso; utawufaka khona umhluzi, uyenze ibe ngcwele.
Uyawudla umnikelo wayo wesono, utawuwufaka phambi kwetibhodi tesivumelwano, etentini lekuhlangana, lapho ngizohlangana khona nawe; ibe yingcwele kakhulu kuwe.
Ningeke nibuyeni nefutfu ngendlela lenjalo; kumele niyigcine ibe ngcwele, ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Nalowo nalowo lowenza intfusa njengeleyo, kutsi abe nephunga layo, lowo muntu kumele aphekwe emiphakathini yakhe.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi watsi:
"Lamuhla-ke, bona, sengibambe ngesandla sami uBesaleheli, umsa waUri, umsa waHuri, emndenini wakwaJuda.
Ngimtfubile ngemoya waNkulunkulu, ngimnike ubuhlakani, nekuqonda, nelwazi, nekhono lokwenza yonke imisebenzi, ngatsi:
Uyakwazi ukwenza imihlobiso ehlelekile, nekusebenza ngegolide, nesiliva, negolide yegolide.
Uyakwazi kutsila kanye nekubeka emacwecwe, ukusika lemtfubi, kanye nokwenza nhlobo yemisebenzi ehleliwe.
Nami ngitawumisa naye Oholiyabi, umsa wa-Ahisamakhi, wasemndenini waDani; nalowo wonke lowo lo talwa ngaye, ngiyamnika khono lokuhlela, kutsi abe nekhono lokuyenza yonke imiyalo lengingakutjela yona:
itenti lekuboshwa, nebhokisi lesivumelwane, kanye nemgodlo walo, naleyo mpahla yonke yetenti,
netenti kanye nezinto takhe, nesitayela segolide lesihle kanye nezinto takhe tonkhe, na-altari yekufuya,
i-altari yemnikelo wekushiswa, nezinto zayo zonke, nelitfusi kanye nesisekelo saso;
kanye netibondza letive, netibondza letingcwele ta-Aron umLevi, netibondza tabona bakhe, lapho besebenza khona njengabaLevi;
namafutha ekuphuza, netfufu lelinephunga lelimnandi lokungcwele kuleyo ndawo ingcwele; kumele bakwenze njalo-ke, njengobe ngikutshele.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi watsi:

"Uye ukhulume nalabaSirayeli, usithi: 'Lemicimbi yami yeSabhati kumele niyigcine; lemicimbi imele inhlamvu phakathi kwami nenu, kuze kube yiminyaka yenu yonke, ukuze nibone ukuthi ngiye Simakadze loyawukungcwele kwenu.
Ligcine liSabhati, ngobe lingcwele kuwe. Lomuntfu loyawuyiphazamisa kumele abulawa; lowo muntfu lowenza noma yini kuleso sikhathi kufanele aphelelwe emndenini wakhe.

Ngelilanga lesine kumele kube khona umsebenzi, kepha ngelilanga lesisikhombisa kufanele kube neSabhati yekuphumula lokugcwele, lingcwele kuSimakadze. Wonke lowo lowenza noma yini msebenzi ngeSabhati kumele abulawa.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli kufanele agcine iSabhati, abe ngumnikelo wesono emindenini yabo; kube ngumnikelo wesono kuze kube sekupheleni.
Kuye kube nguphawu phakathi kwami nemadvodzana a-Isirayeli kuze kuphele; ngobe ngelilanga lesihlanu Simakadze wakwenza izulu nemhlaba, ngalelo langa lesitsatfu waphumula, waphumula.
Watsi uSimakadze, lapho waphela ekhuluma naye emfuleni iSinayi, watsi kuMosesi: "Nceda usinike tibhodi letimbili tesivumelwano, tibhodi tasematshe labhalwe ngesandla saNkulunkulu.

Bekubona bantfu kutsi uMosese unesikhathi esincane sokuphuma emfuleni, bahlangana nabo-Aron, batsi kuye: "Susa, sifake bonkulunkulu labayawuhamba phambi kwethu; ngobe loMosi, lowo muntfu labewutfumisa ezweni leMijiphu, asizange sazi ukuthi sekwenzeke yini.
U-Aron wabaphendvula watsi: "Susa izingcezu zegolide, letibekwe emilenzeni yenu, emlilweni wenu kanye nemlilweni yabantwana benu, nizifikele."
Labantfu bonkhe bakhipha ema-engile abo egolide, batawuwanikela ku-Aron.
Aye aphindze awathatha, wawenza ngesandla sakhe induku lefana nengulube, watsi: "Lowo nguSimakadze longuSomandla wakho, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo wasewukhuphule kusuka eMisri.
U-Aron, lapho ekubona khona, wakwakha ithempeli phambi kwengulube, watsi: "NgoLwesihlanu kuzoba nekudla lokungcwele kuSimakadze."
Bafike baphuma ekuseni, banikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa nemnikelo wesono, bahlala bedla nekudla, baphuza, bavuka batsi: "Sihlelekile kakhulu!"
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thiba, zula; ngobe bantfu bakho, labewakhipha eMijiphu, baphelelwe lukhuni.

Baye bahamba ngejubane, besuka kulokho longangibawisela kuwo; babuye bakha ingulube eyenziwe ngaso, bayawuhlabela kuyo, banikela ngayo, batsi: Lowo nguNkulunkulu wakho, Israele, lowo watfumisa ezweni lase-Egypte.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Ngibabone laba bantu, bona babantu besandla semtfubi.
Namuhla, shiya ngimi, kutsi umsindo wami uvuleke kubo, ngibaphelele; wena ke ngitakwenza ube yinhlanga lelikhulu."
UMosi wathandaza kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakhe, watsi: "UNkulunkulu, yini na lebuhlungu bakho lokudlidliza ebantwini bakho, labewakhipha ema-Egypt ngemandla amakhulu nesandla esinamandla?

Bami-ke baMijipi bangatsi yini, watsi: Wabakhipha kutsi abe nebubi kubo, wababulala emadolobheni abo, wabasusa ebusweni bemhlaba; buyela kutfutfuko lomsindo wakho, ubeke phansi umlomo wakho, ungabi nemonakalo kuloo mhlambi.

Khumbula labakhonzi bakho, uAbrahama, neIsakha na-Isirayeli, labewaphendvula watsi: 'Ngitawubambisana nabo njengamaplanethi asezulu; lelizwe lonke lelitsi ngalikhuluma kubo ngiyawulibanikela kulabakhonzi bakho, ibe yinye yabo kuze kube sekupheleni.'
USimakadze wehlule, watsi: "Angeke afike abengele kubantfu bakhe lobubi lokuye wakusho."
UMosese wabuyela, waphuma emfuleni, enesicwecwe lesimbili sesivumelwano esisemandleni akhe; sabhalwa ngaso sonke simo, ngaphambili nemuva.
Letibondza laba ngumsebenzi waNkulunkulu, nekubhala kwaba kubhala kwaNkulunkulu, kucwecwe etibondza.
UJoshua watsi kuMosesi: "Kusekhona umsindo wekulwa emgwaqeni." 20Watsi uMosi afike eGibhithe, wahlangana nabo.
Mosesi watsi: "Akunaso sicopho sebantfu labashayayo, noma sicopho sebantfu labagulayo; kepha ngitsi: "Sicopho somculo longingawuva." "
Wafika ke Mosesi ekamelweni, wabona ingulube kanye nekudlalwa kwaso; watsi: "Umoya waMosesi utfubile, wehlisa ticwecwe emlenzeni wakhe, wazibabula ngaphansi komfula.
Wathatha lengulube labeyawuyenza, wayibopha emlilweni, wayitsusa ibe ngumhlabatsi, wamisa emacwecwe kuwo amanzi, wawadlalisa lamadvodza ase-Israyeli.
Musa watsi ku-Aron: "Lebantfu bakwenta kuphi kuwe, kutsi utawubabeka enhlitiyweni lekhulu?"
U-Aron watsi: "Lakho, nkosi yami, angeke kube nebuhlungu; wena uwazi kutsi labantfu bangabi nakuhle.
Bathi kuye, Uyawusilungisa loNkulunkulu lotawuhamba phambi kwethu; ngobe loMosese lowo, lowo watfumisa ezweni leMijiphu, asifuni kutsi kube yini kuye.
Nami ngatsi kubo: 'Lone onegolide, ayisethe.' Banginikela ngegolide, ngayifaka emlilweni, waphuma longulube lowo!"
Mose wabona kutsi labantfu baphazanyiswa; ngobe u-Aron wabaphazamisa, watsi: "Baba ngumnikelo wesono kulabo labaphikisayo.
UMosese wahlala ekungeneni kwekhabhinethi, watsi: "Lowo lobe nguNkulunkulu, afike lapha kimi!" Bahlangana naye bonkhe labaLevi.

Wabaphendvula watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utsi: 'Njengcebo yakhe niyibambe emphilweni yenu; nihambe nisuka kwelinye icala lesiteji niye kwelinye, bese nibulala nalowo mzalwana wenu, nalowo mhlobo wenu, nalowo umngane wenu.'"
BaLevi bakwenza njalo, njengobe Mosesi abekhuluma; naleso sikhathi kwafa lamakhulu mathathu ebantfu.
Mozesi watsi: "Namuhla niyawunikela ngesandla kwenu kuSimakadze, ngobe nalowo mkhulu kunalo mntwana wakhe, nalowo mkhulu kunalo lomzalwane wakhe; kodvwa yena utawukunikani namuhla insindiso."
Kutsi kube sekuphele usuku, uMosese watsi kubantfu: "Nine nihlelele isono esikhulu; kepha manje ngizophuma ngifike kuSimakadze, ngobe sengingeke ngibuyele ngaye ngesono sam.
UMosese wabuyela kuSimakadze, watsi: "Asekho! Lebantfu baphumele ebubini lobukhulu; benze kubo Nkulunkulu wesiliva negolide.
Manje-ke, ngiyakucela, khulula isono sabo; kepha uma ungawuphelisi, khipha igama lami encwadini yakho lewubhalela ngayo.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Nalowo nalowo labewudlwengula ngami, ngiyakucisha igama lakhe encwadini yami.
"Ngatsi-ke, hlala uhamba, uye kuleyo ndawo ngikutshele ngayo; ngobe umlingisi wami uyawuhamba phambi kwakho; kepha lapho lifika isikhathi sami sokuvalela kubo, ngitawuvalela kubo isono sabo."
USimakadze wehlisa indlala kulabo bantu, ngenxa yesive sabo, ngobe bekwenzele lengulube leAron abeyisho.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thinda lapha, wena nalaba bantu labewakhipha eMisri, ufike ezweni lapho ngibembise khona uAbrahama, noIsakha, noYakobi, ngitsi: 'Ngiyawubanikela emndenini chenu.'
Ngitathumela sentombi yami phambi kwakho, ngiyawukhipha laSikanani, ne-Amori, ne-Heti, ne-Perizi, ne-Hivi, ne-Jebusi.
nifike ezweni lelivuthayo ummbila nemvu; ngobe ngingeke ngifike phakathi kwenu, ngoba nibantfu bemilebe emikhulu, ngingakubulala ngendlela.
Batsi, lapho bantfu beva lamazwi lawa abuhlungu, bahlupheka kakhulu; kodvwa akukho muntu lobeka ingubo yakhe.

Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Chaza kuboSirayeli kutsi, 'Ningumuntfu lomtfubi; uma ngihamba nani kuze kube ngumnyaka mncane nje, ngingakubhubhisa. Namuhla, khiphani imihlobiso yenu, ngitakubona yini lengingakwenza kwenu.'"
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli asuka emfuleni iHorebhe, wakhipha impahla yakhe yegolide.

UMosesi waba netenti, wayisa ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi emgwaqeni, wayayibiza ngokuthi itente lekuhlangana. Wonke lowo wayefuna ukukhuluma noSimakadze wangena etentweni letehlanganako phandle kwekhabhinethi.
Nalapho Mose ephuma etentini, bonke bantfu baphuma behlala emgwaqeni wetente lelinye lalabo, bese babheka ngemuva kweMosesi kuze afike etindeni.
Nalapho Mosi ephuma etentini, inhloko yemvula yafika yahlala emgwaqeni, ngobe Simakadze abekhuluma naMosi.
Batsi: "Kuye kube njalo, lapho bonke bantfu bebona khona inhloko yemvula ihleli emgwaqeni wetenti, bahlala bese bondza, ngamunye emnyango wetente lakhe.

USimakadze wakhuluma naMosesi buso kubuso, njengobe umuntu ekhuluma nomngane wakhe; watsi: "Musa uyawubuyela esibhedlela; kodwa Joshua, umntwana losebenza naye, unyana ka-Nun, akazange aphume emiphakathini yetente.

UMosesi watsi kuSimakadze, "Uthi kuye: 'Thumela laba bantu,' kepha awuzange ungisitshele ukuthi ngubani lowuyawuthumela nami; ngobe watsi: 'Ngikukhumbula ngegama lakho, futhi uthole inhlonipho ngamehlo ami.'
Namuhla, uma sengithole inhlonipho emehlo akho, ngiyakucela ufundise indlela yakho, ukuze ngikubone, ngifike ngifune inhlonipho emehlo akho; khumbula kutsi lelizwe leli libantu bakho.
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Ngiya kuhamba nawe, ngikuvumele uphumule."
UMosese watsi kuye, "Lakho, uma ungeke uhambe nathi, akufanele usivumele sifike lapha.
Bangeke babone ngekuphi kutsi ungithanda, nami nebantfu bakho, uma usiya nathi; ngobe ngaleso simo ngiyawuhlukaniswa, mina nalaba bantu bakho, kusuka kubo bonkhe bantfu labakhona emhlabeni.'
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Ngiyakwenza lokhu lokushoyo; ngobe utfumele inhlonipho phambi kwami, futhi ngikukhumbula ngegama."
Simakadze watsi kuMosi: "Nceda, bonisa kutsi ungcwele."

Simakadze watsi kuye: "Ngiyakwenza yonke lembindza yami ihambe phambi kwakho, ngiyawukhuluma igama lami, uSimakadze, phambi kwakho; ngitawuba nenhlonipho kulowo engifuna ukumnika inhlonipho naye, ngitawuba nenhlonipho kulowo engifuna ukumnika.
Awungeke ubone buso bami, ngobe akukho muntu loyawungibona ephila.
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Kukhona nendawo lapho ngikhona, bese uhlala khona ngetinyawo zakho.
"Naloku ukuthula kwami kuyawudlula, ngitakubeka emgodini wemlilo, ngikufihla ngesandla sami kuze kube ngidlule.
Lapha ngiyawukhipha isandla sami, nawe utawukubona emuva kwami; kepha buso bam ngeke buboneke.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Cinga itibopho ezimbili zegolide, njengetibopho tangaphambilini; ngizobhalela kubo la mazwi abekhona etibopho tekucala, letiwubhutshuza.
"Sebenzisa umsebenti wakho ngelilanga lekucala, ufike eMfuleni iSinayi, uhlale khona phambi kwami emgwaqeni weMfula.
Angeke kube khona muntfu lophuma nawe, noma lobonakale kulo mfula nakweyiphi na indawo yakhe; ngisho nemfuyo nengulube akufanele idle emaphandleni lalomfula.

UMosese watsi: "Lawo macwecwe lamane esiliva negolide, afana nalawo langaphambilini; uMosi wavuka ekuseni kakhulu, wafika emfuleni iSinayi, njengobe Simakadze abemwisele kutsi akwenze, wafaka emacwecwe lamane egolide esandla sakhe.
USimakadze wehla enyangeni, wahlala khona naye, watsi igama lakhe litsi: "Simakadze."
Simakadze wadlula phambi kwaMosese, watsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uNkulunkulu lowukhulu kakhulu, onekuthula, lobushelelezi, ogcwele inhlonipho neqiniso.

Logcina ukuthula kuye emakhulu, losusa inkohliso, nekuphazamisa, nesono, kepha angeke avumele lowo mkhulule akhululeke; lobulala inkohliso yabafo bakhe kubantwana babo kanye nabangane babo kuze kube ngumnyaka wesithathu noma wesihlanu.
UMosese wehlisa isandla sakhe emhlabatsini, watsi:
watsi: "Simakadze, uma sengithole inhlonipho emehlo akho, fike nathi; ngobe lomuntfu ubuhlungu besandla sakhe. Sikhulule umonakalo wethu kanye nesono sethu, uyenze sibe bantu bakho,

Simakadze watsi: "Beka, ngiyakwenza inhlanganiso nawe; ngase ngikwenze phambi kwebantfu bakho bonke izinto ezimangalisayo letingeke zenziwe nhlobo kunoma yimuphi muntu emhlaba onke. Nabo bonkhe bantfu labangaphandle kwakho bazobona umsebenzi waSimakadze; ngobe lokudla lokungekuhle lona engikusho kuwe.
Thintela kutsi ngikukhulumela namuhla; bona, ngiyakukhipha phambi kwakho i-Amori, ne-Kanana, ne-Heti, ne-Perizi, ne-Hivi, ne-Jebusi.
Hamba ugcine, ungeke ube nesivumelwano nalabahlali belizwe lapho uyawufika khona, ngobe bangaba yitfu phakathi kwakho.
Lemihlobiso yabo niyiphule, netinhlabamkhosi tabo nizibulala, namatindlela abo langcwele niwacoce.
Mna-ke ungeke ube ngunkulunkulu lomunye; ngobe Simakadze, igama lakhe litsi: Lowunendlala, nguye Nkulunkulu onendlala.
"Ungeke ubeke isivumelwano nalabahlali balomhlaba, bese baphazamisa imihlambi yabo, banikela ngesondlo kulabo bonkulunkulu babo, bekubiza wena, nawe utawudla inhlanhla yabo.
Ungeke uthathe emindenini yabo izingane zabo kutsi zibe ngumadodana akho, bese lemadvodzana abo ahamba emgudwini wabo, abe ngabesilisa nabesifazane, nabobantwana bakho bahambe nabo.
Mna-ke, ningaba yimihlaba yesiliva lelitshiswayo.
Ugcine usuku lwemifino lesingafakwanga, udle imifino lesingafakwanga lilanga lesitsatfu, njengobe ngikuwisela umthetho ngalo, kuleso sikhatsi semnyaka wa Abib; ngobe kulomnyaka wawuphuma eMijiphu.
Lonke lilanga lekucala liyawuba lami, kanye nelilanga lekucala lamadodana akho, nalelo langalelinye labantfu bakho.

"Uyawubuyela umkhwenyana, lowo utawubuyela ngemnikelo wesono; kepha uma ungawubuyeli, utawubuyela ngentamo yakhe. Uyawubuyela nalowo mntwana wakho, lowo utawubuyela ngaye. Angeke afike enhliziyweni yami longenalutho.
Ngelilanga lesixhenxe kumele usebenze, kepha ngelilanga lesisikhombisa kufanele uphumule; kuze kube nesikhathi sokulima kanye nesikhathi sekukhulisa kufanele ukhululeke.
Ungeke ugcine usuku lwezinsuku tesikhombisa, nelilanga lekucala lokuvuna imbewu yengulube, kanye nosuku lokuhlangana ekupheleni kwemnyaka.
Emahoreni lasitfupha ngaleso sikhatsi, wonke lowesifazane wakho kumele afike phambi kweSimakadze Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.

ngobe ngitawukhipha ema-Israyeli phambi kwakho, nemhlaba wakho uzoba mkhulu; kodvwa akukho muntu longeke afune ukubamba umhlaba wakho, lapho uphuma khona uvela phambi kweSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, izikhathi ezintathu ngonyaka.

Ungeke unikela ngegazi lelihlanganiswe nekudla lokuhlanganisiwe, nome ngekudla lokuhlanganisiwe nekudla lokuhlanganisiwe, noma ngekudla lokuhlanganisiwe nekudla lokuhlanganisiwe, noma ngekudla lokuhlanganisiwe nekudla lokuhlanganisiweyo.
Lokudla lokukhulu, lokuqala emhlabatsini lwakho, utawukulethela endlwini yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho; ungakucoci ingulube emlonyeni wemama wayo.
Simakadze watsi kuMosese: "Bhalisa la mazwi kuwe; ngobe ngemazwi lawa ngibeke sivumelwano nawe kanye na-Israyeli."
UMosese waba khona naSimakadze lilanga lemine nebusuku bemine, angadla inyama, anidle amanzi; wabhala emacwecwe lamazwi esivumelwaneni, amazwi lamashumi lamabili.
Nalapho Mose ephuma emfuleni iSinai, netibopho letimbili tesivumelwano esandlani sakhe, akazange awazi ukuthi ubuso bakhe bukhanya, ngobe abekhuluma naye.
Aharon nebantfu labanyenti base-Israyeli bakubona uMosese, bona, ibuso bakhe bukhanya; baloba kutsi bafike kubo.
Mosi wababiza, wabuyela kuye uAron kanye nalabakhulu bonke bebandla, watsi nabo.
Bafike nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, watsi kubo konkhe loko loNkulunkulu abemwise ngalo emfuleni iSinayi.
Ngako-ke Mose, lapho ephelela kutsi akhulume nabo, wabeka ingubo emlonyeni wakhe.
Ngako-ke lapho afika khona uMosi kutsi akhulume naye, wakhipha imicabango yakhe kuze afike ephuma; bese ephuma, wakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, lamazwi labeshiwo.
Babona kutsi ibuso bakhe bukhanya, baphinde babeka umgodzi phezu kwebuso bakhe, kuze afike akhuluma naye.
Mose wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, wabaphendvula watsi: "Lezi zinto yizinto loSimakadze akwentela kutsi nizenza.
Ngelilanga lesine kusetjentyelwa umsebenzi, kepha ngelilanga lesitsatfu lingcwele kuwe, ngusuku lokuphumula lokugcwele kuSimakadze; lowo lowenza kuphi nakuphi kusebenza ngalo, kumele abulawa.
"Mna-ke ngitsi kuwe: Lakho lilanga leSabhati lilungile, ngobe lingcwele.
Mosi wakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, watsi: "Lena linye lamazwi laSimakadze atawutsi,
Nifikeni ninike umnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, ngaso sonke isandla lesicelayo, ninike umnikelo wegolide, nesiliva, nesiliva, nensimbi,
isiliva, negolide, nesiliva lelibomvu, nelinen lelihlanganisiwe, nenwele yegodzi;
tingulube letiboshwe mhlophe; lesikhumba lesincanyana; isihlahla se-acacia;
nemafutha e-olive lokuhlobisa, kanye nemakhandlela lokuhlobisa, namafutha ekuphuza kanye netfufu lelibomvu;
kanye nematshe e-onyx, neminye imihlobiso yegolide, kutsi ifakwe ku-ephodni nakwesifuba.
Wonke lowo nguNkulunkulu wakhe, lowaziyo kutsi angakwenza yini, kufanele afike aze ayenze yonke imiyalo yaSimakadze:
itenti lesingcwele, netenti sayo kanye nemgoqo wayo, nemacici ayo, netinhlamvu takhe, namatindlela akhe, netibondza lakhe;
ibhokisi, nemikhono yayo, nemhlobiso wayo, naletibhaka-bhaka letiyifihla;
netenti, netinkomishi taso, naletinye tintfwasato taso, nekudla lokuboshwa;
intambo yekukhanya, nezinto zayo, netinhlamvu zalo, namafutha ekukhanya;
i-altari yekufutfumela, nemikhono yayo, namafutha ekuncibilikisa, nefutsi lelibomvu, nesitayela semnyango wetenti lesingcwele;
i-altari yemnikelo wekushiswa, negreji yayo yesiliva, netimbhoshongo zayo, naletinye tive tayo; kanye nemgobo wekutsiba nesisekelo saso;
tingwevu temphi, netimbhoshongo tazo kanye netibondza tabo, naletibhaka-bhaka letifike emgwaqeni wemphi;
kanye netibondza tetenti lesingcwele, netibondza tendlu yasebukhosini, naletintambo taso;
kanye netibondza letiboshwe lokusebenzela ethempelini, netibondza letingcwele ta-Aron umLevi, netibondza lamadvodzana akhe, lapho besebenza khona njengenkhosi.
Baphuma khona bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli basuka kuMosi.

Wonke lowo umphefumulo wakhe ulungile, nalowo umphefumlo wakhe ulungile, bafike babe nesibopho somnikelo wokudla kuYehova, ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi wesitezi sokuhlangana, nomsebenzi wayo onke, kanye nezigqoko ezingcwele.

Bafika, besifazane namadoda, bonke labafunayo, banikela ngaso sonke sidakambiso segolide, ngemihlobiso ye talwimi, nezingcezu, nezinhlamvu, nezigcawu; wonke umuntu wanikela ngegolide lakhe njengemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Wonke lowo abenayo intambo yegolide, neyesiliva, neyesibhakabhaka, nelineni lelihlanganisiwe, nemilenze yengulube, nesikhumba semvu lesiboshwe mhlophe, nesikhumba senyama, wabanikela.
Wonke lowo wanikela ngesilivere nesiliva, waba nemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze; nalowo nalowo labenamacwecwe esitayela se-akademu lokulungiselela siphi nasinye isenzo, waba nemnikelo wakhe.
Nawo onkhe emadoda ahlakaniphile, abehamba ngesandla sakhe, wanikela ngezinto lakhe lelihlanganisiwe, nesiliva, negolide, nesilivere, nelinen lelingenako.
Nawo onkhe emakhosikazi, labo labafunayo, kanye nalabo labengaba nekhono lokujika, bamisa imilenze yengulube.
Labaholi banikela ngegolide ye-onix, neminye imihlobiso yegolide, kutsi ifakwe efulethini kanye nesandla.
Bafike banikela ngemiphunga, nemafutha e-olive lokuhlobisa, nemafutha ekuphuza, netfufu lelifudumele.

Nabo bonke labaseSirayeli, amadoda namakhosikazi, labo abaholi bemindeni yabo, labanikela ngesandla sabo kuSimakadze, banikela ngenhlanhla yabo, ngaso sonke sinqumo somsebenzi loNkulunkulu abewisela wona uMosesi.
Mosese wathi kubo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli: "Bonani, uSimakadze wakhetha uBezaleleli, umsa ka-Uri, usonkhe wa-Huri, emndenini wakwaJuda.
Wamugcwalisa ngemoya waNkulunkulu, ngenhlonipho, nemcabango, nelwazi, nekhono lokwenza nhlobo lemisebenzi.
Uyakwazi ukwenza imihlobiso ehlelekile, usebenza ngegolide, nesilivere, nesiliva,
bacwebezela ematshe esiliva negolide, bacwebezela emapulangwe, basebentisa isandla sabo ekusebenzeni.
USimakadze wehlule kuye kanye na-Oholiyabi, unyana ka-Ahisamakhi, wasemndenini waDani, umphefumulo wokufundisa.

Wabagcwalisa ngekhono lokuhlela, nekhono lokuhlobisa, nekhono lokuthunga, nekhono lokwenza imihlobiso emhlophe, nesiliva, negolide, nelineni lelihlanganisiwe, kanye nekhono lokusika; bayakwazi ukwenza yonke misebenzi, bakwazi ukwenza imihlobiso.

Besaleleli na-Aholiyabi, kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu labacabanga, labo Simakadze abebeka kubo ubuhlakani nekhono lokucabanga, kutsi bakwazi ukwenza yonke lemisebenzi yekwakha lesingcwele, kumele basebenze kulomsebenzi, njengobe Nkulunkulu wabawisela.

Mozesi watsi kuBesaleleli na-Aholiyabi, kanye nalowo wonke lowo muntfu lohlakaniphile, lapho Simakadze abemise khona ubuhlakani bakhe, nalowo wonke lowo umphefumulo wakhe wawumnikeze kutsi afike asebenze kulomsebenzi.
Bafike bamukela kuMosese yonke leminikelo yekushiswa, yabo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, lababambisene nayo ekusebenzeni kwendlu yasengcwele; nabo baphindze babuye babenze njalo ngekusasa.
Batsi bonke labasebenza kahle, labasebenza kuleyo ndawo ingcwele, baletsa lokusebenza kwabo,
batsi kuMosesi: "Labo bantu banikela kakhulu kunaleyo msebenzi loSimakadze abetawuwurozi kutsi siwusebenze."
Watsi uMosi wabeka umthetho, watsi: "Labo baphuma emkhosini kumele bangabi nemnikelo wesono lapho kungcwele khona, ngisho namadoda namadvodza." Lakho kwaletsa bantfu kutsi bangabi nemnikelo.
ngobe lababeneleyo mpahla bekufanele bayenze yonke lemisebenzi, kodvwa babengenayo.

Nabo bonke labaqeqeshiwe emisebenzini yabo bakhipha itenti lengcwele, beyenza ibe yimihlobiso lelishumi, yelinen lesincibilikisiwe, nelinesibhakabhaka, nelinesiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nelinesibhakabhaka esimnyama, namakerubi, abhalwe ngesandla.
Lemihlobiso lemincane neyelikhulu nemashumi lamane nesihlanu lamasentimitha lide, lemikhulu neyelikhulu nemashumi lamane namasentimitha ibanzi.
Wahlanganisa tingwevu letisihlanu linye nelinye, wakwenza njalo naletinye tingwevu letisihlanu.
Wakwenza tintambo tesiliva nelibomvu ekugcineni kwetinti taso lesinye sihlanganisi, kanye nalapho kungena khona tinti taso lesinye sihlanganisi.
Wakwenza tigodzi tamashumi lamabili nesihlanu etintiwa lesinye, natigodzi tamashumi lamabili nesihlanu esiphelweni setintiwa lokunye lokuhlukaniswa; tigodzi tahlangana yinye nelinye.
Wakwenza netincongolo tegolide tamashumi lamakhulu mane, wahlanganisa netincongolo tingwevu letilishumi lesinye nesinye, kutsi itabernakele ibe ngumnikelo wesono.
Wakwenza tingwevu temilenze yengulube, abe ngutingwevu letilishumi lelinesihlanu, kutsi kube yitendlu yasengcwele.
Lemihlobiso leyilishumi lelinesihlanu yabe ifana ngebukhulu, ibe nebude bemamitha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa namakhulu lasitfupha, nebubanzi bemamitha lasitfupha.
